qe: When the mutinous sepoys fled from Dinapore in July 1857, why was the pursuit not continued beyond the cantonments?
qh: जुलाई 1857 में विद्रोही सिपाहियों के दानापुर से भाग जाने पर उनका पीछा छावनी से आगे क्यों नहीं किया गया?
oe: Because the sepoys had already crossed the Sone
Because a river blocked the way
Because the General was absent and nobody would take responsibility
Because the order came from Calcutta to stop
oh: क्योंकि सिपाही सोन पार कर चुके थे
क्योंकि रास्ते में नदी आ गई
क्योंकि जनरल मौजूद नहीं था और किसी ने जिम्मेदारी लेना स्वीकार नहीं किया
क्योंकि कलकत्ता से रुक जाने का आदेश आ गया
e: July 1857 me Dinapore ki chhawni me sipahiyon ne apne kamandar ka aadesh maanne se inkar kar diya tatha unke hi afsaron par goli chalayi. Angreji (European) sipahi turant mauke par pahunch gaye tatha vidrohi sipahi bhaag khade hue. Lekin unka peechha chhawni se aage nahi kiya gaya; iska karan yah tha ki General us samay maujood nahi tha tatha kisi afsar ne apne aap par zimmedari lena theek nahi samjha. Isi ka parinaam yah hua ki vidrohi sipahiyon ka bada hissa apne hathiyar tatha saamaan le kar Sone nadi paar kar gaya tatha Arrah ke paas Kunwar Singh ke saath ja mila, jisse vidroh ko aur bal mila. Aise ghatnakram se pata chalta hai ki agreji sena ki command me deri tatha zimmedari lene se jhijhak vidroh ko badhane ka bada karan bani. Exam point: July 1857 me Dinapore se bhage vidrohi sipahiyon ka peechha chhawni se aage nahi hua kyunki General maujood nahi tha tatha koi zimmedari lene ko taiyar nahi tha; isi kaaran vidrohi Sone nadi paar kar Arrah ke paas Kunwar Singh ke saath mil gaye.

qe: Four hundred men of which British regiment left Dinapore by steamer on 29 July 1857 for Arrah?
qh: 29 जुलाई 1857 को दानापुर से आरा की ओर स्टीमर से किस ब्रिटिश रेजिमेंट के चार सौ सैनिक रवाना हुए?
e: July 1857 me Dinapore ki chhawni se vidrohi sipahiyon ke bhaagne ke baad Arrah ke paas Kunwar Singh ke saath mile vidrohiyon ka saamna karne ke liye ek abhiyan bheja gaya. 29 July 1857 ko 10th Foot regiment ke chaar sau sipahi Dinapore se steamer par rawana hue. Yah abhiyan bahut buri tarah chalaya gaya; sipahiyon ko raat ke saat baje utara gaya tatha safed garmi ki vardi me andhere me Chapra Ghat road se Arrah ki taraf badhaya gaya. Aadhi raat ko yah toli ghairiyon ke ghaat me phans gayi tatha subah unhe wapas lautna pada; aadhe se zyada sainik peeche reh gaye. Aisi ghatnaon ne dikhaya ki vidroh ke shuruaati mahino me angreji sena ke faisle kitne jaldbaazi tatha laaparwahi se liye ja rahe the. Exam point: 29 July 1857 ko 10th Foot ke chaar sau sipahi Dinapore se steamer par Arrah ke liye rawana hue tatha raat me Chapra Ghat road se chal kar Kunwar Singh ke vidrohiyon ke ghaat me phans gaye; is abhiyan me unhe bahut nuksan uthana pada.

qe: In the Arrah expedition of July 1857 the British troops were landed at 7 p.m. and marched in darkness by which road?
qh: जुलाई 1857 के आरा अभियान में ब्रिटिश सैनिकों को शाम सात बजे उतारा गया तथा अंधेरे में किस सड़क से चलाया गया?
e: Arrah ke abhiyan me 10th Foot ke chaar sau sipahiyon ko Dinapore se steamer par bheja gaya tha. 29 July 1857 ki shaam sat baje unhe utara gaya tatha andhere me safed garmi ki vardi me Chapra Ghat road se Arrah ki taraf badhaya gaya. Andhere me chalna tatha safed vardi dono hi unke liye haanikarak sabit hue, kyunki vidrohi unhe door se dekh sakte the. Aadhi raat ke aas-paas yah toli ghairiyon ke ghaat yaani ambuscade me phans gayi, jahan unhe bhaari nuksan hua; subah unhe wapas lautna pada. Is abhiyan ki asafalta ke kaaran Dinapore me angreji command ki karyapranali par bade sawal uth khade hue. Exam point: Arrah ke liye gaya 10th Foot ka dal shaam saat baje utar kar andhere me Chapra Ghat road se badha tatha ghairiyon ke ghaat me phans gaya; safed garmi ki vardi tatha andhera dono unke liye haanikarak rahe; asafalta ke baad angreji command ki aalochana hui.

qe: Of the four hundred men who went towards Arrah in July 1857, only about how many returned unwounded?
qh: जुलाई 1857 में आरा की ओर गए चार सौ सैनिकों में से लगभग कितने बिना घायल हुए लौट सके?
e: 29 July 1857 ko Dinapore se 10th Foot ke chaar sau sipahi steamer par Arrah ki taraf bheje gaye the. Sipahiyon ko shaam saat baje utara gaya tatha andhere me Chapra Ghat road se chalaya gaya; aadhi raat ko yah toli vidrohiyon ke ghaat me phans gayi. Subah jab unhe wapas lautna pada, to unka aadha se zyada hissa maidan me hi reh gaya tatha bache hue logon me se keval lagbhag pachas sipahi hi bina ghayal hue apni chhawni tak laut sake. Is vipatti ne Patna kshetra me angreji sarkar ki sthiti ko aur kamzor kiya, lekin aage chal kar Punjab se aayi sena tatha sthanik sipahiyon ki madad se vidroh ko dabaya gaya. Aisi asafalta dikhati hai ki jaldbaazi me liye gaye sena-faisle kitne bhaari pad sakte hain. Exam point: Arrah ke liye gaye chaar sau sipahiyon me se lagbhag pachas hi bina ghayal ho kar laute; aadhe se zyada sainik maidan me hi reh gaye; is asafalta se Patna kshetra me angreji sarkar ki sthiti kamzor hui.

qe: Which leader of the 1857 revolt did the mutineers from Dinapore join after crossing the Sone?
qh: सोन नदी पार करने के बाद दानापुर के विद्रोही सिपाही किस 1857 के विद्रोही नेता के साथ जा मिले?
e: July 1857 me Dinapore ki chhawni se vidrohi sipahi bhaage tatha Sone nadi paar kar Arrah ke paas pahunche, jahan woh Jagdishpur ke Kunwar Singh ke saath ja mile. Kunwar Singh bhojpur kshetra ke bade zamindar the tatha 80 saal ki umar me bhi unhone vidroh ka netritva kiya; unke saath aaye sepoys ne unhe apna supreme commander maan liya. Iske baad Patna kshetra me vidrohi toliyan thana todne tatha niji sampatti lootne lagi, tatha shaanti poori tarah 1858 ke shuru me ja kar bahal hui. Aise varnan dikhate hain ki 1857 ka vidroh Patna tatha Bhojpur kshetra ka sanyukt sangharsh ban gaya tha, jisme zamindar tatha sepoys dono shamil the. Exam point: Dinapore se bhage vidrohi Sone nadi paar kar Arrah ke paas Jagdishpur ke Kunwar Singh ke saath mil gaye tatha unhone unhe apna supreme commander maana; vidroh ke dauraan Patna jile me toliyan thana todti tatha lootpat karti rahin; shaanti 1858 ke shuru me bahal hui.

qe: In which period was order generally restored in the Patna district after the disturbances of 1857?
qh: 1857 की गड़बड़ियों के बाद पटना जिले में सामान्य व्यवस्था किस समय बहाल हुई?
e: Arrah ke abhiyan ki asafalta ke baad angreji sarkar ne Patna shahar me do sau British sipahi tatha do topen bhejin, taaki asantusht logon ko daraya ja sake tatha shahar me shaanti rahe. Is kadam ka asar yah hua ki shahar ke logon ne aage koi badi gadbadi nahi ki. Lekin poore jile me vidrohi toliyan saal bhar bhatakti rahin tatha thane todne tatha niji sampatti lootne ki ghatnayein hoti rahin. Is tarah jile me samanya vyavastha 1858 ke shuru me ja kar bahal ho paayi. Aise varnan se pata chalta hai ki vidroh ko dabane me jitna samay laga, usse zyada mushkil kshetra me bharosa tatha vyavastha wapas lane me aayi. Exam point: Arrah ki asafalta ke baad Patna shahar me do sau British sipahi tatha do topen bheji gayin; shahar me badi gadbadi nahi hui, lekin jile me vidrohi toliyan saal bhar sakriy rahin; jile me samanya vyavastha 1858 ke shuru me bahal hui.

qe: On 4 August 1857 which Commissioner of Patna was relieved of his post, a step much debated at the time?
qh: 4 अगस्त 1857 को पटना के किस कमिश्नर को उसके पद से हटा दिया गया, जिस पर उस समय बहस हुई?
e: 1857 me Patna kshetra me vidroh ko dabane ke liye Commissioner William Tayler ne bahut sakht kadam liye the; 18 June ko Maulaviyon ki giraftari tatha saptahon tak kadi karwaiyan unhi ki dekh-rekh me hui. Aisi sakht karwaiyon se shahar me vidroh ka jwala bhadakne se bach gaya, lekin 4 August 1857 ko unhe unke pad se hata diya gaya tatha unka charge doosre adhikari ko diya gaya. Is faisle par us samay tatha baad me bhi bahas hoti rahi; ek vichaar yah tha ki Tayler ne shuruaati khatre ko samay par rok diya, jabki doosra yah ki zarurat khatm hone ke baad bhi unki sakhti jaari rahi. Baad me Samuells ne charge sambhala tatha shahar me shaanti bahal rahi. Exam point: 4 August 1857 ko Patna ke Commissioner William Tayler ko pad se mukti di gayi; unhone vidroh ke shuruaati khatre ko sakht karwaiyon se rok diya tha; unke jaane ke baad Samuells ne charge sambhala; is faisle par kaafi bahas hui.

qe: After the failure of the Arrah expedition in July 1857, what did the Patna district witness during the rest of the year?
qh: आरा की आपदा के बाद शेष 1857 में पटना जिले में क्या देखने को मिला?
oe: A general uprising of the whole countryside
Stray bands of mutineers roaming the district, looting and destroying thanas
oh: दानापुर के पास एक और बड़ी लड़ाई
पूरे ग्रामीण क्षेत्र का सामान्य विद्रोह
भटकती विद्रोही टोलियाँ, जो थाने तोड़ती और लूटपाट करती रहीं
e: Arrah ke abhiyan me 10th Foot ke dal ko bhaari nuksan hua tatha sirf lagbhag pachas sipahi bina ghayal ho kar laute. Iske baad angreji sarkar ne Patna shahar me do sau sipahi tatha do topen bheji, jisse shahar ke asantusht logon ne koi badi gadbadi nahi ki; kintu jile ke anya hisson me haalat theek nahi thi. Saal ke shesh mahino me vidrohi toliyan gaon-gaon me bhatakti rahin, thane (police chowki) todti rahin tatha niji sampatti lootti rahin. Isi kaaran jile me samanya vyavastha 1858 ke shuru me ja kar bahal hui tatha prashasan ko kai mahine lage apna control wapas jamane me. Exam point: Arrah ki haar ke baad Patna shahar me sena bhej kar shaanti rakhi gayi, lekin jile me 1857 ke shesh mahino me vidrohi toliyan bhatakti rahin, thane todti rahin tatha lootpat karti rahin; samanya vyavastha 1858 ke shuru me bahal hui.

qe: The famous victory of Veer Kunwar Singh over Captain Le Grand's British force, celebrated every year as Vijayotsav, took place near which place?
qh: वीर कुंवर सिंह की कैप्टन ले ग्रांड की ब्रिटिश सेना पर प्रसिद्ध विजय, जिसे प्रतिवर्ष विजयोत्सव के रूप में मनाया जाता है, किस स्थान के पास हुई थी?
e: Veer Kunwar Singh Bhojpur (purana Shahabad) jile ke Jagdishpur ke Ujjainiya Parmar Rajput rajavansh se the; unka janm 1777 me hua tha. 1857 ke vidroh me Bihar ka netritva unke haath me raha: Dinapur ke vidrohi sepoys Arrah aakar unhe supreme commander ghoshit kiya, unhone Arrah treasury par kabza kiya tatha Bibiganj, Atraulia tatha Azamgarh jaise maidan-e-jung me angrejon ko haraaya. 23 April 1858 ko Jagdishpur ke paas unki sena ne Captain Le Grand ki British sena ko dharashayi kiya; is vijay ki smriti me Bihar me 23 April ko Vijayotsav manaya jaata hai tatha rajkiya avkash bhi hota hai. Lagbhag 80 varsh ki umar me bhi yudh kaushal dikhane ke karan unhe 'Veer' tatha '80 varshon ka Yuva' kaha gaya. Arrah me Veer Kunwar Singh Vishwavidyalaya (VKSU) tatha unki smriti me vishwavidyalaya aur smarak sthit hain. Exam point: 1857 me Bihar ke neta = Veer Kunwar Singh, kendra = Jagdishpur (Bhojpur), 23 April 1858 ki Le Grand par vijay ab Vijayotsav/rajkiya avkash.

qe: Who led the armed uprising in Patna on 3 July 1857 and was publicly hanged on 7 July 1857?
qh: 3 जुलाई 1857 को पटना में सशस्त्र विद्रोह का नेतृत्व किसने किया तथा 7 जुलाई 1857 को सार्वजनिक रूप से फाँसी दी गई?
e: Pir Ali Khan Patna City ke Mohalla Gurhatta me rehte the aur wahan ek prasiddh kitab-vyapari (book trader) the. Unhone kitabon ke vyapaar ko gupt sanchar (espionage) tatha anti-british patrakon ke vitaran ke liye istemal kiya, jisse Dinapur ke sepoys tatha nagar ki janta ke beech sampark bana. 3 July 1857 ko unke netritva me lagbhag 200 sashastr vidrohiyon ne Patna City me khula vidroh kiya aur Gulzarbag me angrejon par hamla hua; isi sangharsh me Opium Agent Dr. Lyell ki hatya hui. British Commissioner William Tayler ne 7 July 1857 ko unhe Patna me sarvajanik roop se phansi de di. Isi balidan ke karan unhe 'Patna ka Amar Shaheed' kaha jaata hai aur Gandhi Maidan ke samne unke naam par Shaheed Pir Ali Khan Children's Park bana hai. Kunwar Singh Jagdishpur (Bhojpur) ke, Mazharul Haque Champaran-Home Rule ke tatha Raj Kumar Shukla Champaran Satyagraha ke liye jaane jaate hain. Exam point: Patna me 1857 ke vidroh ki shuruat = 3 July 1857, neta Pir Ali Khan; Dr. Lyell ki hatya isi vidroh me hui, phansi 7 July 1857.

qe: Which tribal leader of Bihar killed British Collector Augustus Cleveland with an arrow and is called the first anti-colonial tribal martyr of India?
qh: बिहार के किस आदिवासी नेता ने ब्रिटिश कलेक्टर ऑगस्टस क्लीवलैंड को तीर से मार गिराया तथा भारत के प्रथम उपनिवेश-विरोधी आदिवासी शहीद कहे जाते हैं?
e: Tilka Manjhi (asli aadi-naam Jabra Paharia) ka janam Bhagalpur ke Sultanganj ke paas Tilkapur gaon me ek Santhal-Paharia parivar me hua tha. 1770 ke bhayankar akaal (famine) ke baad unhone Rajmahal tatha Bhagalpur ke janglon ko apna adaa bana kar East India Company ke khilaf organized guerrilla yuddh chheda; yah sangharsh lagbhag 1780 se 1785 tak chala. 1784 me unke ek hamle me British Collector Augustus Cleveland teer se ghayal hokar maara gaya, jisse angrejon me hakaar mach gayi. Aakhir me pakde jaane par 1785 me Bhagalpur me unhe bade bargad ke ped par phansi di gayi. 1857 se lagbhag 70 saal pehle British satta ko khuli sashastr chunauti dene ke karan unhe 'Bharat ka pehla shaheed' tatha 'Aadi Vidrohi' kaha jaata hai; Bhagalpur University ka naam unke samman me Tilka Manjhi Bhagalpur University (TMBU) rakha gaya. Birsa Munda (Ulgulan, 1899-1900), Buddhu Bhagat (Kol vidroh 1831-32) tatha Sidhu Murmu (Santhal Hul 1855-56) baad ke aadivasi aandolanon ke neta the. Exam point: collector Augustus Cleveland ki hatya = Tilka Manjhi (1784), phansi Bhagalpur (1785), unhe 'Aadi Vidrohi' tatha 'Bharat ka pehla shaheed' kaha jaata hai; TMBU unke naam par.

qe: The Santhal Hul (rebellion) of 1855-56, one of the biggest tribal revolts, was led by which brothers, and who were its two famous women leaders?
qh: सबसे बड़े आदिवासी विद्रोहों में एक, 1855-56 का संथाल हूल किन भाइयों के नेतृत्व में हुआ, तथा इसकी दो प्रसिद्ध महिला नेता कौन थीं?
oe: Sidhu and Kanhu Murmu; Phulo and Jhano Murmu
Buddhu Bhagat and Jatra Bhagat; Shanti and Prabhavati
Telanga Kharia and Ganga Narayan Singh; Phulo and Tara
Birsa Munda and Gaya Munda; Saraswati and Prabhavati
oh: सिद्धू तथा कान्हू मुर्मू; फूलो तथा झानो मुर्मू
बुधु भगत तथा जतरा भगत; शांति तथा प्रभावती
तेलंगा खड़िया तथा गंगा नारायण सिंह; फूलो तथा तारा
बिरसा मुंडा तथा गया मुंडा; सरस्वती तथा प्रभावती
e: 1855-56 ka Santhal Hul bharat ke sabse bade aadivasi vidrohon me gina jaata hai. Iska netritva Sidhu, Kanhu, Chand tatha Bhairav Murmu naam ke bhaiyon ne kiya; unke aavhan par hazaron Santhal Sahibganj (Bhognadih) ke aas-paas juthe, jisse angrejon ki satta hil gayi. Is aandolan ki do prasiddh mahila neta Phulo tatha Jhano Murmu thi - Phulo Murmu ne Pasra ke British military camp par sahasik guerrilla hamla karwaya aur angrejon ko bhishan nuksaan pahunchaya. Isi vidroh ke dabaav me British sarkar ne Santhal Pargana naam ka alag prashasanik kshetra banaya tatha Santhalon ke liye kuch suraksha-kanoon banaye. Dhyaan rahe ki Buddhu Bhagat Kol vidroh (1831-32) ke tatha Birsa Munda 'Ulgulan' (1899-1900) ke neta the, isliye woh vikalp alag aadolanon se jude hain. Exam point: Santhal Hul 1855-56 = Sidhu-Kanhu Murmu (Bhognadih), mahila neta Phulo tatha Jhano Murmu; dabaav me Santhal Pargana ka gathan.

qe: Which tribal leader led the Kol uprising of 1831-32, which forced the British to create the South-West Frontier Agency?
qh: 1831-32 के कोल विद्रोह का नेतृत्व किस आदिवासी नेता ने किया, जिसके कारण ब्रिटिश को दक्षिण-पश्चिम सीमांत एजेंसी बनानी पड़ी?
e: Buddhu Bhagat ka janam Ranchi ke Chanho block ke Silagai gaon me ek Oraon aadivasi kisan parivar me hua tha. Us samay Chotanagpur me british sarkar ne gair-aadivasi thekedaron (thikadaron) ko zameen tatha lagan ka kaam saunp diya tha, jisse aadivasi kisanon ka shoshan badha. 1831 me Singhbhum tatha Ranchi kshetra me Kol vidroh bhadak utha, aur Buddhu Bhagat ne Silagai ko sashastr pratirodh ka kendra banaya. Vidroh ko dabane ke liye British ne bhaari sena bheji; February 1832 ke Silagai mane me Captain Impey ki force se ladte hue Buddhu Bhagat veergati ko prapt hue. Is vidroh ke parinaamswaroop angrejon ne prashasanik sudhar kiye tatha South-West Frontier Agency (SWFA) banayi, jisse Chotanagpur ka prashasan alag dhange se dekhne laga. Tilka Manjhi Paharia vidroh (1780-85) ke, Jatra Bhagat Tana Bhagat Andolan (1914) ke tatha Telanga Kharia (Kharia pratirodh, 1850-1880) ke neta the. Exam point: Kol vidroh 1831-32 = Buddhu Bhagat (Silagai, Ranchi); parinaam me South-West Frontier Agency (SWFA) ka gathan.

qe: Who founded the Tana Bhagat movement in 1914, which launched a no-rent campaign and later joined the Gandhian movement?
qh: 1914 में ताना भगत आंदोलन किसने शुरू किया, जिसने लगान-भुगतान से इनकार का अभियान चलाया और बाद में गांधीवादी आंदोलन से जुड़ा?
e: Jatra Bhagat ka janam Gumla jile ke Bishunpur block ke Chingari gaon me ek garib Oraon kisan parivar me hua tha. April 1914 me unhone Tana Bhagat Andolan shuru kiya; 'Tana' ka matlab hai buraiyon ko khinche kar bahar phenkna. Is aandolan me zamindaron ko lagan dena tatha beth-begari (bandhua vetan-shram) karna poorti tarah band kar diya gaya; saath hi shakahar, sharab-mukti tatha ahinsa par aadharit naya aachar-sanhita apnaya gaya. Yah aadivasi samaj ka ek aisa andolan tha jismein spiritual sudhar aur arthik-rajnitik pratirodh dono the. Baad me Tana Bhagat log Mahatma Gandhi ke satyagraha, asahyog andolan tatha 1930 ke namak satyagrah me shaamil hue, isliye yah andolan rashtriya swatantrata sangharsh se jud gaya. Birsa Munda ne 1899-1900 me Ulgulan chalaya tatha Sidhu Murmu ne 1855-56 me Santhal Hul; Gauri Shankar Saran Singh ek krantikari the jo Paharia kshetra se jude the. Exam point: Tana Bhagat Andolan 1914 = Jatra Bhagat (Gumla), lagan tatha beth-begari ka virodh, aage chala kar Gandhi ke asahyog andolan me shaamil.

qe: Who persuaded Mahatma Gandhi to visit Champaran, leading to the Champaran Satyagraha of 1917?
qh: महात्मा गांधी को चंपारण आने के लिए किसने प्रेरित किया, जिसके कारण 1917 का चंपारण सत्याग्रह हुआ?
e: Champaran ke neel (indigo) kisanon par angrej planters ne 'tinkathia' naam ka atyachar lagaya tha - kisan ko apni zameen ka teen kaththa hissa (kul kheti ka 3/20) neel ugana padta tha aur bahut kam daam milta tha. Pandit Raj Kumar Shukla West Champaran ke Murli Bharhawa gaon ke ek aam kisan parivar se the. December 1916 ke Lucknow Congress adhiveshan me unhone Brajkishore Prasad ke saath milkar Champaran ki pira ka mudda uthaya aur wahan unhone Gandhi ji se milkar unhe Champaran chalne ke liye raazi kiya. Gandhi ji 1917 me Champaran pahunche, tinkathia pratha ke khilaf jaanch (enquiry) ki aur sarkar ko majboor kiya ki Tinkathia vyavastha khatm ho; yah bharat me Gandhi ji ka pehla satyagraha mana jaata hai. Raj Kumar Shukla ki niji diary 1914 se 1919 tak ke sangharsh ka din-ba-din record hai, isliye woh itihas ka anmol dastavez hai. Brajkishore Prasad aur Mazharul Haque Champaran ke sahyogi the, lekin Gandhi ji ko bulane ka shrey Shukla ji ko mila. Exam point: Gandhi ji ko Champaran bulane wale = Raj Kumar Shukla (Murli Bharhawa, West Champaran); Champaran Satyagraha 1917 me tinkathia pratha khatm hui.

qe: Which revolutionary from Bihar shot dead the approver Phanindra Nath Ghosh in 1932 to avenge Bhagat Singh, and was hanged in Gaya Jail?
qh: भगत सिंह का बदला लेने के लिए 1932 में मुखबिर फणीन्द्रनाथ घोष को गोली मारने वाला बिहार का क्रांतिकारी कौन था, जिसे गया जेल में फाँसी दी गई?
e: Baikuntha Shukla ka janam Vaishali jile ke Jalalpur gaon (Lalganj) me ek deshbhakt kisan parivar me hua tha; woh krantikari Yogendra Shukla ke bhatije the. Lahore Conspiracy Case me Phanindra Nath Ghosh naam ka vyakti angrejon ka sarkari gawah (approver) ban gaya; uski jhooti gawahi ke aadhaar par Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev tatha Rajguru ko phansi di gayi. Is viswasghat ka badla lene ke liye HSRA ke krantikari Baikuntha Shukla ne 9 November 1932 ko Bettiah me Phanindra Nath Ghosh ko goli mar kar hata diya. Iske baad unhe giraftar kiya gaya aur 14 May 1934 ko Gaya Central Jail me phansi de di gayi; aaj bhi wahan unka Shaheed Smarak bana hua hai. Yogendra Shukla unke chacha the aur khud lambe samay jail me rahe; Batukeshwar Dutt ne Bhagat Singh ke saath Assembly bomb case me bhag liya; Jaglal Chaudhary kisan-gandhi neta the - isliye woh vikalp alag vyaktiyon ke hain. Exam point: approver Phanindra Nath Ghosh ki hatya (9 November 1932, Bettiah) = Baikuntha Shukla, phansi Gaya Jail 14 May 1934.

qe: Which leader from Bihar, known as 'Jan Nayak', implemented the tiered reservation model recommended by the Mungeri Lal Commission and was awarded the Bharat Ratna in 2024?
qh: बिहार के किस नेता को 'जननायक' कहा जाता है, जिन्होंने मुंगेरीलाल आयोग की सिफारिश पर श्रेणीबद्ध आरक्षण लागू किया तथा 2024 में भारत रत्न दिया गया?
e: Karpoori Thakur ka janam Samastipur (purana Darbhanga) ke Pitaunjhia gaon - jo aaj unke samman me 'Karpuri Gram' kehlata hai - me ek garib 'Nai' (barber) samaj ke kisan parivar me hua tha. August 1942 ke Bharat Chhodo Andolan me unhe 26 mahine ki jail kati. Bihar ke mukhyamantri ke roop me unhone November 1978 me Mungeri Lal Commission ki sifarishon par aadharit shrenibaddh (tiered) aarakshan model lagu kiya, jisme OBC ke andar ati-pichhe vargon (EBC) tatha mahilaon ko alag-alag suvidha mili - yahi model aage sambidhanik roop se aur rajyon me bhi adarsh bana. Garibon aur shoshiton ki seva ke karan janta ne unhe 'Jan Nayak' kaha. Unki smriti me Patna me Karpoori Thakur Museum bana hai tatha 2024 me unhe marnoparat Bharat Ratna se sammanit kiya gaya. Basawon Singh ek krantikari tatha Congress Socialist Party ke sahyogi; Jayaprakash Narayan 1974 ke Sampoorna Kranti (Bihar Andolan) ke neta; Bindeshwari Dubey Bihar ke mukhyamantri rahe - isliye woh alag vyakti hain. Exam point: 'Jan Nayak' = Karpoori Thakur, 1978 me Mungeri Lal aayog ki sifarishon par shrenibaddh aarakshan, 2024 me Bharat Ratna; janm-sthal Pitaunjhia ab 'Karpuri Gram' (Samastipur).

qe: Who led the Bhumij revolt of 1832-33 in the Manbhum region, known in colonial records as 'Ganga Narayan ka Hungama'?
qh: 1832-33 के मानभूम क्षेत्र के भूमिज विद्रोह का नेतृत्व किसने किया, जिसे औपनिवेशिक अभिलेखों में 'गंगा नारायण का हंगामा' कहा जाता है?
e: Ganga Narayan Singh ne 1832-33 me Bhumij vidroh (jise angrej abhilekhon me 'Ganga Narayan ka Hungama' likha gaya) ka netritva kiya; yah Manbhum tatha Dhalbhum kshetra (aaj Jharkhand-Paschim Bengal seema) me chala, jo us samay Bihar prant ka hissa tha. Vidroh ka karan angrejon tatha unke thekedaron (diwano) dwara ki jaane wali kathor lagan-vasuli tatha shoshan tha; 2 July 1832 ko unhone Barabazar par kabza kiya tatha British munsif aadalaton tatha khazanon ko lutt liya. Vidroh ko dabane ke baad angrejon ne 1833 me Regulation XIII jaise kanoon banaye, jisse Chotanagpur kshetra me prashasanik tatha jamin sambandhi sudhar karne pade. Buddhu Bhagat Kol vidroh (1831-32), Tilka Manjhi Paharia vidroh (1780-85) tatha Bhukhan Singh Chero vidroh (1800-02) ke neta the - isliye woh sahi vikalp nahi. Exam point: Bhumij vidroh 1832-33 = Ganga Narayan Singh, 'Ganga Narayan ka Hungama', Manbhum kshetra; parinaam me 1833 ka Regulation XIII laaya gaya.

qe: Telanga Kharia, a tribal leader of the Gumla region, is remembered for founding which institution of self-governance?
qh: गुमला क्षेत्र के आदिवासी नेता तेलंगा खड़िया किस स्व-शासन संस्था की स्थापना के लिए याद किए जाते हैं?
e: Telanga Kharia Gumla ke Sisai kshetra ke Murgu gaon se the tatha unhone 1850 se 1880 tak British shasan tatha zamindaron ke khilaf aadivasi pratirodh ka netritva kiya. Unka sabse mahatvapurn sansthagat kaam 'Jodiya Panchayat' ki sthapna thi; 'jodiya' ka arth hai jodi ya saajhedari, yaani is panchayat me gaon ke badon ko nyayik, prashasanik tatha suraksha ke adhikar diye gaye, jisse aadivasi samaj apne faisle khud kar sakta tha tatha british aadalaton par nirbharta kam ho gayi. Unhone lagbhag 13 jodiya panchayaton ka network khada kiya maana jaata hai tatha British nyay-vyavastha ka virodh kiya tatha apne logon ko unki adalat me jaane se roka. Aakhir me 23 April 1880 ko Sisai ke ek training camp me unki shahadat ho gayi; aaj unka samadhi-sthal 'Telanga Toppa Tand' state-protected dharohar hai. Santhal Pargana angrejon ne banaya, Vaishali ki gana sabha prachin Magadha ka ganarajya thi tatha Tana Bhagat Andolan Jatra Bhagat se juda hai - isliye sahi uttar Jodiya Panchayat hai. Exam point: Telanga Kharia = Jodiya Panchayat system ke sansthapak (Gumla-Simdega-Ranchi kshetra), 1850-1880 ka Kharia pratirodh, 23 April 1880 ko Sisai me shahadat.

qe: Bhukhan Singh is remembered as the leader of which uprising in the Palamu region (undivided Bihar) in 1800-1802?
qh: भूखन सिंह अविभाजित बिहार के पलामू क्षेत्र में 1800-1802 के किस विद्रोह के नेता के रूप में याद किए जाते हैं?
e: Bhukhan Singh Palamu kshetra (aaj Jharkhand, tab undivided Bihar) ke Chero kisano ke neta the; 1800 se 1802 ke beech unhone angrej zamin-bandobast tatha thekedaron dwara jameen ki nilami ke khilaf bada vidroh chalaya. Chero log Palamu ke pahadi-jangal kshetra me apne pahadi ilaake me rahte the; angrejon ne wahan naya lagan tatha jameen ka record lagu kiya, jisse unki zameen cheen kar nilam karne ki ghatnayein badhi. Bhukhan Singh ne pahadi kshetra me morche banakar pratirodh kiya tatha kai jagah angrej adhikariyon ko khatam kar diya; vidroh ko dabane ke liye British ko bhaari sena bhejni padi. Isi kshetra me 1857 me Nilambar tatha Pitambar jaise Bhogta netaon ne bhi vidroh ka netritva kiya. Santhal Hul 1855-56 me Sidhu-Kanhu ne, Kol vidroh 1831-32 me Buddhu Bhagat ne tatha Bhumij vidroh 1832-33 me Ganga Narayan Singh ne chalaun - isliye sahi uttar Chero kisan vidroh hai. Exam point: Bhukhan Singh = Chero kisan vidroh (Palamu, 1800-1802) ke neta, angreji jamin-bandobast tatha nilami ke viruddh; 1857 me Palamu me Nilambar-Pitambar (Bhogta) ne bhi bhaag liya.

qe: The 1940 session of the Indian National Congress, held in a place that is today in Jharkhand but was then part of Bihar, was convened at:
qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस का 1940 का अधिवेशन, जो आज झारखंड में है पर उस समय बिहार का हिस्सा था, कहाँ आयोजित हुआ था?
e: 1940 ka Congress adhiveshan Ramgarh me hua tha; Ramgarh us samay Bihar prant me tha tatha aaj yah kshetra Jharkhand me aata hai. Is adhiveshan ki adhyakshta Maulana Abul Kalam Azad ne ki tatha yah adhiveshan apne samay ke rajnitik faislon ke liye mahatvapurn raha; usi daur me angrej sarkar ne bharat ko dusre vishwa-yuddh me shaamil hone ke liye samarthan dene ka dabaav banaya tha. Congress ne is adhiveshan me saaf taur par kaha ki bharat ki janta ki marzi ke bina yuddh me sahyog nahi diya ja sakta, jab tak desh ko swaraj nahi diya jaata; isi stithi ne aage 1942 ke 'Bharat Chhodo' aandolan ki neev taiyar ki. Patna tatha Gaya me Congress ke anya karyakram tatha sammelan hote rahe Muzaffarpur kshetra kisan aandolan tatha anya karyakramon se juda raha, lekin 1940 ka adhiveshan Ramgarh me hua. Exam point: 1940 ka Congress adhiveshan = Ramgarh (tab Bihar, aaj Jharkhand), adhyakshta Maulana Abul Kalam Azad; yahan se 'yuddh me sahyog tab hi jab swaraj mile' ka rukh taya hua.

qe: In the 1857 revolt, which cantonment of Bihar saw the sepoys mutiny and march to Arrah to join Kunwar Singh?
qh: 1857 के विद्रोह में बिहार के किस छावनी में सैनिकों ने विद्रोह करके कुंवर सिंह से मिलने के लिए आरा की ओर कूच किया?
e: 1857 ke vidroh me Dinapur (aaj Danapur, Patna ke paas) ki chhavni ke sepoy garrison ne vidroh kiya tatha Arrah ki taraf kuch kiya; wahan pahunch kar unhone Jagdishpur ke Veer Kunwar Singh ko apna 'supreme commander' ghoshit kiya. Isi sanyukt shakti ne Arrah ke khazane tatha prashasanik vyavastha par kabza kiya tatha angrejon ke khilaf morche banaye; Bibiganj, Atraulia tatha Azamgarh ke maidan-e-jung me angrejon ko kadak chunauti mili. Dinapur ki chhavni bharat ki sabse purani military chhavniyon me ginti hai, isliye wahan ke sepoys ka vidroh poore Bihar me aag ki tarah faila. Munger me Mir Qasim ka kila tha (1760 ke dashak ka), Barh tatha Bhagalpur me aise vidroh ka kendra nahi raha - isliye sahi uttar Dinapur (Danapur) hai. Exam point: 1857 me Bihar me vidroh ka pramukh military kendra = Dinapur (Danapur) chhavni; wahan ke sepoys Arrah pahunch kar Veer Kunwar Singh ko supreme commander banaya; 23 April 1858 ki Jagdishpur vijay Vijayotsav ke roop me manayi jaati hai.

qe: The Salt Satyagraha of 1930 in Bihar was led at Garhpura in Begusarai district by which leader?
qh: 1930 का बिहार में नमक सत्याग्रह बेगूसराय जिले के गरहपुरा में किस नेता के नेतृत्व में हुआ था?
e: 1930 ke Namak Satyagraha (civil disobedience) ke dauran Dr. Sri Krishna Singh, jinhe 'Bihar Kesari' kaha jaata hai, Begusarai jile ke Garhpura me namak kanoon toda tatha unhone khud vidroh ka netritva kiya; police ki lathi bhi unhe rok nahi saki. Unka janm nanihal Garhpura se juda tha tatha woh Begusarai kshetra ke gaon-gaon me jaakar logon ko angreji namak ka virodh karne ke liye prerit karte the. Aage woh Bihar ke pehle Premier (1937) tatha azaadi ke baad pehle Mukhyamantri (1946-1961) bane; unke samay me 1950 ka Bihar Bhumi Sudhar Kanoon aaya jisse zamindari khatm hui. Dr. Rajendra Prasad Champaran tatha samvidhan sabha ke kaam se, Swami Sahajanand kisan aandolan se tatha Maulana Mazharul Haque Home Rule tatha Sadaqat Ashram se jude the - isliye Garhpura ke namak satyagraha ke liye Dr. Sri Krishna Singh hi sahi uttar hain. Exam point: 1930 ke Namak Satyagraha me Garhpura (Begusarai) ka netritva = Dr. Sri Krishna Singh ('Bihar Kesari'); woh Bihar ke pehle Premier tatha pehle Mukhyamantri the; unke samay me Bihar Bhumi Sudhar Kanoon 1950 aaya.

qe: Bihar Vidyapeeth, set up in 1921 for national education during the freedom movement, was founded with the efforts of which leader?
qh: स्वतंत्रता आंदोलन के दौरान राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा के लिए 1921 में स्थापित बिहार विद्यापीठ किस नेता के प्रयासों से स्थापित हुआ?
e: 1921 me Patna ke Sadaqat Ashram kshetra me 'Bihar Vidyapeeth' ki sthapna hui; iska mukhya uddeshya yah tha ki angreji sarkar ke school-college chhodne wale vidyarthiyon ke liye 'rashtriya shiksha' ka vaikalpik system banaya jaye. Iske pramukh sansthapak tatha sanrakshak Dr. Rajendra Prasad the, jinhone aage samvidhan sabha ki adhyakshta tatha rashtrapati ke roop me desh ki seva ki; unhe 'Deshratna' kaha jaata hai. Azaadi ke andolan me jab 'asahyog' ke dauran vidyarthiyon ne sarkari sansthan chhode, tab Vidyapeeth ne unhe hindi, itihas, sanskrit tatha anya vishyon ki padhai di tatha deshbhakti ka paath padhaya. Isi tarah Bihar me Kisan Sabha tatha anya rashtriya sansthaon ne bhi aise kaam kiye. Dr. Sri Krishna Singh mukhyamantri bane, JP ne 1974 ka aandolan chalaun tatha Bindeshwari Dubey bhi mukhyamantri rahe - lekin Bihar Vidyapeeth ka naam Rajendra Babu se sabse zyada juda hai. Exam point: Bihar Vidyapeeth = 1921, Patna (Sadaqat Ashram kshetra), rashtriya shiksha ke liye; pramukh shrey Dr. Rajendra Prasad ('Deshratna') ko, jo samvidhan sabha ke adhyaksh tatha bharat ke pehle Rashtrapati bane.

qe: Mahendra Misir, known as 'Purvi ke Janak', is remembered in the freedom movement for which unusual activity?
qh: 'पूर्वी के जनक' कहे जाने वाले महेंद्र मिसिर स्वतंत्रता आंदोलन में किस अनोखी गतिविधि के लिए याद किए जाते हैं?
oe: Setting up the first Hindi newspaper of Bihar
Writing patriotic songs for the Indian National Army
Printing counterfeit British currency to fund revolutionary activities
Leading a peasant march to Nepal
oh: बिहार के पहले हिंदी समाचार-पत्र की स्थापना
इंडियन नेशनल आर्मी के लिए देशभक्ति गीत लिखना
क्रांतिकारी गतिविधियों के खर्च के लिए अंग्रेजी करेंसी की नकली नोट छापना
नेपाल तक किसान मार्च का नेतृत्व
e: Mahendra Misir ko 'Purvi ke Janak' yaani 'Purvi' lok-gayan shaili ka janm-data kaha jaata hai; woh lok-kavi tatha krantikari dono the. Unke baare me sabse charchit baat yah hai ki unhone angreji sarkar ke khilaf harkat me kharch ke liye nakli (counterfeit) currency tatha stamp chhapne ka kaam kiya; is gair-kanooni kaam ki wajah se unhe sarkar ke nishane par liya gaya tatha jail bhi jaana pada. Lok-kavi hone ke naate unki rachnayein gaon-gaon me suni jaati thi tatha unke geeton me samrajyavad ke khilaf gussa tatha kisanon ki peer dikhti thi; isi tarah ke kavi aandolan ka sanskritik aadhaar banate the. Indian National Army ke geet Subhas Chandra Bose ke aandolan se jude log likhte the, kisan march tatha 'Bihar Bandhu' (bihar ka pehla hindi akhbaar, 1872) Babu Ramkrishna Varma se juda hai - isliye sahi uttar nakli currency chhapna hai. Exam point: Mahendra Misir = 'Purvi ke Janak', lok-kavi tatha krantikari; angreji currency ke nakli not chhapakar aandolan ko paisa pahunchaya; Bihari Hindi patrakarita Babu Ramkrishna Varma ke 'Bihar Bandhu' (1872) se judi hai.

qe: In 1857 the garrison at Dinapore included which European regiment, along with a company of European artillery and a company of Native artillery?
qh: 1857 में दानापुर की छावनी में यूरोपीय तोपखाने की एक कंपनी तथा देशी तोपखाने की एक कंपनी के साथ कौन-सी यूरोपीय रेजिमेंट शामिल थी?
e: 1857 me Dinapore ki chhawni angreji sena ka bada kendra thi. Wahan 10th Foot (ek European regiment) tatha European artillery ki ek company ke saath Native artillery ki ek company tatha Indian infantry ki 7th, 8th tatha 40th battalions rakhi gayi thi. Isi daur me Patna asantusht Muhammadan logon ki saazish ka kendra bana hua tha tatha Commissioner William Tayler ko kshetra ki suraksha sambhalni padi thi. Aage jab halat bigdi, to Lloyd ki sena ko 87th Foot ki do companies se mazboot kiya gaya. Is tarah Patna kshetra me 1857 ke vidroh ka sambandh Dinapore ki chhawni tatha shahar ke saazishkaron dono se tha. Exam point: 1857 me Dinapore ki chhawni me 10th Foot, European artillery ki ek company, Native artillery ki ek company tatha Indian infantry ki 7th, 8th tatha 40th battalions thi; Patna us daur saazish ka kendra tha tatha aage Lloyd ki sena ko 87th Foot ki do companies milin.

qe: On 18 June 1857, Commissioner William Tayler arrested the three Maulavis who were at the head of which body in Patna?
qh: 18 जून 1857 को कमिश्नर विलियम टेलर ने उन तीन मौलवियों को गिरफ्तार किया, जो पटना के किस समूह के प्रमुख थे?
e: 1857 me Patna asantusht Muhammadan logon ki saazish tatha sadyantra ka kendra bana hua tha, isliye Commissioner William Tayler ko kshetra me sakht nigrani rakhni padi thi. 18 June 1857 ko Tayler ne Patna ke Wahabi samuday ke teen Maulaviyon ko, jo us giroh ke pramukh the, giraftar kar liya. Unhe isliye bandi banaya gaya ki unke anuyayi achha vyavhar karein tatha koi bada vidroh na karein; doosre shabdon me unhe bandhak bana kar rakha gaya. Isi daur me 7 June ko Bankipore ke European nivasi suraksha ke liye Chajju Bagh me ikattha hue the tatha 8 June ko Captain Rattray apne Sikh sipahiyon ke saath pahunche the. Exam point: 18 June 1857 ko Commissioner William Tayler ne Patna ke Wahabi samuday ke teen Maulaviyon ko giraftar kar bandhak ke roop me rakha; Patna us samay asantusht Muhammadan logon ki saazish ka kendra tha; 7-8 June ko Bankipore ke European nivasi Chajju Bagh me surakshit hue the.

qe: On 3 July 1857, sixty or seventy men with drums beating and the green flag waving suddenly rushed to attack which building in Patna city?
qh: 3 जुलाई 1857 को ढोल बजाते तथा हरा झंडा लहराते साठ-सत्तर लोग अचानक पटना शहर के किस भवन पर हमला करने दौड़े?
e: 18 June 1857 ko Patna ke Wahabi Maulaviyon ki giraftari ke baad bhi shahar me tanav bana raha. 3 July 1857 ko saath-saath yaani sattar ke aas-paas Muhammadan log, jinke saath dhol baj rahe the tatha hara jhanda lehra raha tha, achanak Patna shahar ke Roman Catholic girjaghar par hamla karne ke liye daude. Commissioner William Tayler ne turant Patna me maujood Captain Rattray ke Sikh sipahiyon ko wahin bheja. Opium Factory ke Superintendent Dr. Lyell ne socha ki unki upasthiti bhid ko dara degi, isliye woh Sikhon se aage badh gaye; unke paas pahunchne par kai goliyaan chalayi gayin tatha woh ghayal ho kar shaheed ho gaye. Us samay halat bahut naazuk thi, lekin Sikh sipahi pahunch gaye tatha bhid ko jaldi bitha diya. Exam point: 3 July 1857 ko dhol tatha hare jhande ke saath sattar ke aas-paas logon ne Patna ke Roman Catholic girjaghar par hamla kiya; Dr. Lyell goli lagne se ghayal ho kar shaheed ho gaye; Rattray ke Sikh sipahiyon ne bhid ko bitha diya.

qe: Which officer, the Superintendent of the Opium Factory at Patna, was mortally wounded on 3 July 1857 while riding ahead to overawe the rioters?
qh: पटना की अफीम फैक्ट्री के अधीक्षक कौन-से अफसर 3 जुलाई 1857 को दंगाइयों को डराने के लिए आगे बढ़ने पर गोली लगने से घायल हो गए?
e: 1857 me Patna kshetra me afim ka vyapar bahut bada tha, isliye yahan Opium Factory ke Superintendent Dr. Lyell ek mahatvapurn adhikari the. 3 July 1857 ko jab dhol tatha hare jhande ke saath sattar ke aas-paas log Roman Catholic girjaghar par hamla karne daude, to Commissioner Tayler ne Captain Rattray ke Sikh sipahiyon ko wahin bheja. Dr. Lyell ne socha ki ek bade adhikari ko dekhte hi bhid piche hat jaayegi, isliye woh Sikhon se aage badh gaye; unke paas pahunchne par goliyaan chalayi gayin tatha woh ghayal ho kar shaheed ho gaye. Keval bharat ke itihas me nahi, balki Patna ke itihas me bhi 1857 ka yah din bahut nirnayak tha, kyunki iske baad shahar me sakht karwaiyan hui. Exam point: 3 July 1857 ko Patna ki Opium Factory ke Superintendent Dr. Lyell ko goli lag kar maut hui, jab woh Sikh sipahiyon se aage badh kar bhid ko daraana chahte the; woh Patna me hamle ka shikar hone wale pramukh angreji adhikari the; Commissioner Tayler ne Rattray ke Sikh bheje the.

qe: The day after the attack on the Roman Catholic church at Patna, letters found in whose house indicated the existence of a widespread conspiracy?
qh: पटना के रोमन कैथोलिक गिरजाघर पर हमले के अगले दिन किसके घर से मिले पत्रों ने एक व्यापक षड्यंत्र का संकेत दिया?
e: 3 July 1857 ko Patna me roman Catholic girjaghar par hamle ke baad Commissioner William Tayler ne sakht karwai shuru ki. Agle din Patna me Pir Ali ke ghar ki talashi se aise khat tatha kagaz mile, jinse pata chala ki shahar tatha kshetra me ek vyapak saazish yaani conspiracy chal rahi thi; yah saazish keval ek chhote hamle tak seemit nahi thi, balki sarkar ke viruddh ek bade vidroh ki yojna ka hissa lagti thi. Isi saazish ke silsile me shahar ke kai mukhya logon ko giraftar kiya gaya tatha mukadme chalaye gaye. Patna ke is daur ke pramukh police daroga Waris Ali bhi giraftar kiye gaye tatha unhe maut ki saza sunai gayi, jiske baad ve faansi par chadhte samay Delhi ke badshah ke naam ka naara lagate rahe. Exam point: girjaghar par hamle ke agle din Pir Ali ke ghar se mile khaton se Patna kshetra me vyapak saazish ka pata chala; Patna ke daroga Waris Ali bhi giraftar huye tatha unhe maut ki saza mili; Commissioner Tayler ne sakht karwaiyan chala kar shaanti bahal ki.

qe: Which of the fourteen persons sentenced to death for the Patna conspiracy of 1857 went to the gallows crying 'To the rescue, all friends of the King of Delhi'?
qh: 1857 के पटना षड्यंत्र के लिए फाँसी की सजा पाने वाले चौदह लोगों में कौन 'दिल्ली के बादशाह के सभी मित्र, बचाव को आओ' का नारा लगाता हुआ फाँसी पर चढ़ा?
e: Patna ke mukadme tatha girahf tariyon ke baad vidroh me shaamil mukhya logon par mukadma chalaya gaya tatha chaudah logon ko maut ki saza sunai gayi. Unme ek pramukh naam Patna ke daroga Waris Ali ka tha; unhe faansi di gayi, lekin faansi par chadhte samay unhone koi pashchatap nahi dikhaya aur Delhi ke badshah ke naam ka naara lagate rahe. Iske saath hi shahar me dabaav tatha saazish ke aise giroh bhi pakde gaye jinke paas hathiyar tatha khaton ke saboot mile the. Dhanapur ki chhawni se Sikh tatha angreji sena ke sahyog se kshetra me shaanti bahal ki gayi tatha Delhi ke vidroh ke saath rishta mitane ke liye sakht kadam liye gaye. Exam point: 1857 ke Patna mukadme me chaudah logon ko maut ki saza mili, jinme patna ke daroga Waris Ali bhi the; unhe faansi hui aur ve Delhi ke badshah ke naam ka naara lagate rahe; is daur me kshetra me anya saazishkaron par bhi mukadme chalaye gaye.

qe: Which force, then posted at Patna, was ordered to the spot and quickly dispersed the crowd of fanatics on 3 July 1857?
qh: 3 जुलाई 1857 को पटना में तैनात कौन-सी टुकड़ी मौके पर भेजी गई, जिसने उपद्रवियों की भीड़ को शीघ्र तितर-बितर कर दिया?
e: 1857 me Patna kshetra me angreji sarkar ke paas apni sena ki sankhya kam thi, isliye sthanik roop se Rattray ke Sikh sipahiyon par bharosa kiya jaata tha. 3 July 1857 ko jab dhol tatha hare jhande ke saath sattar ke aas-paas log Roman Catholic girjaghar par hamla karne daude, to Commissioner William Tayler ne turant Rattray ke Sikh sipahiyon ko mauke par bheja. Sikh sipahi tezi se pahunche tatha bhid ko jaldi bitha diya, chahe usi samay Dr. Lyell goli lagne se ghayal ho chuke the. Inhi Sikh sipahiyon ne 7 June ke baad Bankipore ke European nivasiyon ko bhi suraksha di thi, jab unhe Chajju Bagh me ikattha kiya gaya tha. Exam point: 3 July 1857 ko Patna ke roman Catholic girjaghar par hamle ke samay Captain Rattray ke Sikh sipahiyon ko mauke par bheja gaya tatha unhone bhid ko titar-bitar kar diya; inhi Sikh sipahiyon ne 7-8 June ko Bankipore ke European nivasiyon ki suraksha me bhi madad ki thi.

qe: On the morning of 25 July 1857, which General removed the percussion caps from the magazine to the lines of the British troops at Dinapore?
qh: 25 जुलाई 1857 की सुबह किस जनरल ने दानापुर में मैगज़ीन से पर्कशन कैप्स निकाल कर ब्रिटिश सैनिकों की लाइनों में पहुँचा दिए?
e: Patna me 3 July 1857 ki ghatna ke baad kshetra ki sena ko mazboot kiya gaya tatha General Lloyd ke adheen Dinapore ki chhawni ki command rahi. 25 July 1857 ki subah Lloyd ne ek savdhani ka kadam liya: unke aadesh par magazine me rakhe percussion caps yaani bandook chalane ke liye zaruri cap bahar nikal kar British soldiers ki lines me pahuncha diye gaye, taaki desi sipahi in hathiyaron ka galat istemal na kar sakein. Isi tarah Punjab se aayi sena tatha Rattray ke Sikh sipahiyon ki madad se Patna kshetra me vidroh ko phailne se roka gaya. General Neill aage Bihar kshetra ke abhiyan se jude, Major Adams ne 1763 me Patna ka kila liya tha tatha Colonel Forde ne 1759 ki Bedara ladai ladi thi. Exam point: 25 July 1857 ki subah General Lloyd ne Dinapore me magazine ke percussion caps British sipahiyon ki lines me pahunchwa diye; yah savdhani ka kadam isliye liya gaya ki desi sipahi in caps ka galat istemal na kar sakein; Lloyd ke paas Dinapore chhawni ki command thi.

qe: The Ram Mohan Roy Seminary, an important educational institution of the Brahmo Samaj in Bihar, was located in which city?
qh: ब्रह्मो समाज की बिहार में महत्वपूर्ण शिक्षण संस्था राममोहन राय सेमिनरी किस शहर में स्थित थी?
e: Brahmo Samaj ka prachar Bihar me bhi hua tatha iske mandir tatha sansthaen Patna, Gaya, Bhagalpur, Muzaffarpur tatha Ranchi jaise jilon me sthapit hui; inme sabse pramukh shiksha-sanstha Patna ki 'Ram Mohan Roy Seminary' thi, jise samaj ke sadasyon ne khada kiya. Brahmo Samaj ke pramukh neta Devendra Nath Tagore, Keshav Chandra Sen, Rabindranath Tagore tatha vaigyanik Jagdish Chandra Bose aadi Bihar aaye tatha yahan Brahmo missionaries ne bhi kaam kiya. Brahmo Samaj ne jaati-bhed tatha purdah (parda) ki kathor pratha ka virodh kiya, bal-vivah ka virodh kiya tatha vidhva punarvivah ki wakalat ki; iske prayas se iske anuyayi parivaron me yah sudhar jaldi phaila. Bhagalpur tatha Muzaffarpur me bhi Brahmo Samaj mandir the, lekin Ram Mohan Roy Seminary ka sthal Patna hai - isliye sahi uttar Patna hai. Exam point: Ram Mohan Roy Seminary = Patna (Brahmo Samaj ki shiksha-sanstha); Brahmo Samaj ne jaati-bhed, purdah tatha bal-vivah ka virodh kiya tatha vidhva punarvivah ki wakalat ki; Bihar me iska prabhav Patna, Gaya, Bhagalpur, Muzaffarpur tatha Ranchi tak raha.

qe: The Arya Samaj's educational institutions in Bihar, such as the Dayanand Anglo-Vedic College, were set up to promote reform along with which kind of education?
qh: बिहार में आर्य समाज की शिक्षण संस्थाएँ, जैसे दयानंद एंग्लो-वैदिक कॉलेज, सुधार के साथ किस प्रकार की शिक्षा को बढ़ावा देने के लिए बनाई गईं?
oe: Education combining Vedic teachings with modern English learning
oh: वैदिक शिक्षा के साथ आधुनिक अंग्रेजी शिक्षा का मेल
e: Arya Samaj ki sthapna Pandit Dayanand Saraswati ne 19vein sadi me Punjab me ki tatha uska uddeshya Vedic granthon me bataye gaye marg par Hindu samaj ko sudhar kar andhvishwas tatha karmkand ki adhik kriyayein hata dena tha. Isne murti-puja ka virodh kiya tatha hawan-agnihotra ke saath ek ishwar ki puja par zor diya; jaati-vyavastha ko sveekar nahi kiya tatha nichli jatiyon ko apni or aakarshit kiya. Iske sudhar ke pramukh mudde the - bina dahej ke saral vivah, vidhva punarvivah, purdah ki pratha hataana tatha mahilaon ki shiksha. Isi uddeshya se Dayanand Anglo-Vedic (DAV) College tatha school khade kiye gaye, jahan vedic adhyayan ke saath angreji tatha modern vishay bhi padhaye jaate the, taaki vidyarthi dharm-nishth bhi rahein tatha naukri-yogy bhi ban jayein. Isliye sahi uttar 'Vedic shiksha ke saath adhunik angreji shiksha ka mel' hai. Exam point: Arya Samaj ke sansthapak = Swami Dayanand Saraswati; isne bina dahej saral vivah, vidhva punarvivah, purdah-nivaran tatha mahila shiksha par zor diya; DAV College/school Vedic tatha angreji-modern shiksha ka mel karate hain.

qe: The Theosophical Society, which influenced the English-educated intelligentsia of Bihar, was founded in 1875 with its headquarters at which city?
qh: बिहार के अंग्रेजी-शिक्षित वर्ग को प्रभावित करने वाली थियोसोफिकल सोसाइटी की स्थापना 1875 में हुई थी तथा उसका मुख्यालय किस शहर में था?
e: Theosophical Society ki sthapna 1875 me hui tatha uska mukhyalay Banaras (Varanasi) me tha; iske vicharon ka mukhya hissa yah tha ki prachin bharatiya darshan tatha dharm ki baatein tark tatha vigyan ke aadhaar par samjhayi ja sakein. is society ki kai shakhayein Bihar me sakriya thi tatha iska asar primarily English-educated varg par pada, kyunki unhe yah sanket bhaaya ki bharatiya dhyan tatha adhyatm ko adhunik bhasha me samjha ja sakta hai. Isi daur me Ramakrishna tatha Vivekananda ke vichar bhi phaile tatha Ramakrishna Mission ne Bihar me baadh tatha akal ke samay relief ka kaam kiya, garib vidyarthiyon ki madad ki tatha muft dawa di. Calcutta, Lahore tatha Bombay bhi samaj-sudhar ke bade kendra the, lekin Theosophical Society ka mukhyalay Banaras me tha - isliye sahi uttar Banaras hai. Exam point: Theosophical Society ki sthapna 1875, mukhyalay Banaras; iska asar Bihar ke English-educated varg par; Ramakrishna Mission ne Bihar me baadh-akal relief, garib chhatron ki sahayata tatha muft chikitsa ka kaam kiya.

qe: In the context of Bihar, the Wahabi movement in India is remembered mainly for which revivalist activity?
qh: बिहार के संदर्भ में भारत में वहाबी आंदोलन मुख्यतः किस पुनरुत्थानवादी गतिविधि के लिए याद किया जाता है?
oe: Collecting funds and recruits for a movement in the north-west frontier region
oh: उत्तर-पश्चिमी सीमांत क्षेत्र के आंदोलन के लिए धन तथा भर्ती जुटाना
महिलाओं में पश्चिमी शिक्षा का प्रसार
e: Wahabi movement ka mukhya uddeshya Islam ko uske prarambhik svaroop me lauta kar purane riwaj tatha sanyukt bhakti-karmon ka virodh karna tatha dharma ki raksha ke liye sangharsh karna tha; isi liye iske samarthak khud ko 'ghair-anukarta' (non-imitators) kehte the. is andolan ke pramukh neta Sayyid Ahmad ne lagbhag 1820 me Patna ka daurra kiya tatha us samay se Patna is andolan ka bada kendra ban gaya, jahan se paisa tatha naye sadasya jama karke uttar-pashchim seemant kshetra (North-West Frontier) ke morche par bheje jaate the. Is andolan par sarkar ne sakhti dikhai tatha 1864 me Patna ke wahabiyon par pehla chhaapa pada jisme 11 log giraftar hue; Ahmaddullah (Ahmadullah) ko 27 February 1865 me maut ki saza sunayi gayi, jise High Court ne umar-qaid ke liye badal diya. Aise varnan dikhate hain ki 19vein sadi me Patna rajnitik tatha dharmik gatividhiyon ka sakriya kendra tha. Isliye sahi uttar 'NW frontier ke liye dhan tatha bharti jutana' hai. Exam point: Wahabi andolan ka Patna kendra 1820 se; Sayyid Ahmad ke daure se yahan paisa tatha bhartiyan jama hokar uttar-pashchim seemant kshetra bheji jaati thi; 1864 me pehla chhaapa, Ahmadullah ko 27 Feb 1865 me maut ki saza, jo umar-qaid me badli.

qe: Which phase of the Wahabi movement in Bihar saw the first police raid on the Patna Wahabis, in which eleven persons were arrested?
qh: बिहार में वहाबी आंदोलन के किस चरण में पटना के वहाबियों पर पहला पुलिस छापा पड़ा, जिसमें ग्यारह व्यक्ति गिरफ्तार हुए?
e: Patna me Wahabi andolan ke samarthakon par pahla chhaapa 1864 me pada, jisme 11 vyakti giraftar kiye gaye; inme Ahmaddullah ke bhai tatha bhatije bhi the, jinhe desh-nikala (transportation) ki saza mili. Ahmaddullah khud us samay shak ke daayre me aaya, lekin saboot kam hone ke karan turant giraftar nahi hua; saal ke ant me use giraftar karke Patna ke judge ke saamne mukadma chalaya gaya tatha 27 February 1865 ko maut ki saza sunayi gayi, jise baad me High Court ne umar-qaid me badal diya. Is daur me Patna me paisa tatha bhartiyan jutane ka kaam 1820 se hi chalta aa raha tha, isliye sarkar ki nazar hamesha is shahar par rahti thi. 1857 ke vidroh ka daur is chhape se alag hai tatha 1875 tatha 1890 ki tareekhein is ghatna se mel nahi khati - isliye sahi uttar 1864 ka chhaapa hai. Exam point: Patna ke Wahabiyon par pehla chhaapa = 1864 (11 giraftar, jisme Ahmaddullah ke bhai tatha bhatije bhi); Ahmaddullah ko 27 February 1865 me maut ki saza, jo High Court ne umar-qaid me badli.

qe: The title 'Muleks' was used in Shahabad (Bihar) for a group of Muslim families known for which practice?
qh: शाहाबाद (बिहार) में 'मुलेक्स' शब्द उन मुस्लिम परिवारों के लिए प्रयुक्त होता था, जो किस बात के लिए जाने जाते थे?
oe: Serving as soldiers in the Mughal army
Reciting poetry describing the love of Radha and Krishna
oh: राधा-कृष्ण के प्रेम का वर्णन करने वाली कविता पढ़ना
e: Shahabad (aaj ke Bhojpur-Rohtas kshetra) ke kuch mushlim parivar 'Muleks' kehlate the tatha woh apna samay Radha-Krishna ke prem ka varnan karne wali kavita (poetry) padhne me bitate the; woh kuch sufi santon ki puja tatha unki dargahon par chadhava bhi karte the. Isse pata chalta hai ki Bihar me Hindu-Muslim sanskriti ka aadan-pradan kitna gambhir tha - ek hi mahaul me Ramayan-Mahabharat ki kathaon ke saath Radha-Krishna ki padavali suni-gaayi jaati thi tatha kabhi Moharram ke juloos me Hindu bhi shamil hote the (jab communalism badha to yah saajhedari kam hui). Aise udaharan pariksha me is baat ko samajhne ke liye kaam aate hain ki lok-sanskriti mazhab ki sakht hadon ko todkar chalti thi. Salt-indigo vyapar, Mughal sena tatha madrasa shikshan alag vishay hain - isliye sahi uttar 'Radha-Krishna prem ki kavita padhna' hai. Exam point: 'Muleks' = Shahabad kshetra ke woh mushlim parivar jo Radha-Krishna ke prem ki kavita padhte tatha sufi santon ki dargah par chadhava chadhate the; yah Hindu-Muslim saanjhi lok-sanskriti ka udaharan hai.

qe: After the Hindus, which community was the most numerous single community in Bihar?
qh: हिंदुओं के बाद बिहार का सबसे अधिक संख्या वाला एकल समुदाय कौन था?
e: Bihar me Hindu samuday ke baad sabse bada ekjatiya samuday mushlim tha; unme samajik roop se do mukhya bhed maane jaate the - 'Ashraf' (jinme Syed, Mughal, Irani, Afghan, Pathan log aate the) tatha 'Ajlaf' (jinhe peshe ke naam par Momins, Kunjra, Jolha, Dhunia, Dhobi, Kalal aadi kaha jaata tha). Zyadatar Ajlaf parivar pehle Hindu the tatha baad me mushlim bane, isliye unme kai Hindu riwaz tatha bimari-va bhut-pret se judi manyataein bani rahi. Shia mushlimon ka sabse bada tyohar Moharram (Hasan-Hussain ki shahadat ka smarak) tha, jisme shuru me Hindu log bhi shaamil hote the; Sunni log Shia se kai guna zyada the. Sikh, Isai tatha Jain samuday bhi Bihar me the, lekin Hindu ke baad sarvadhik jansankhya mushlimon ki thi - isliye sahi uttar Muslims hai. Exam point: Hindu ke baad Bihar ka sabse bada samuday = Mushlim; unke do samajik varg Ashraf (Syed, Mughal, Pathan aadi) tatha Ajlaf (peshe ke naam par Momin, Jolha, Kalal aadi), jinme kai parivaron me Hindu riwaz bache rahe.

qe: The position of women in 19th century Bihar was marked chiefly by which of the following practices?
qh: 19वीं सदी के बिहार में महिलाओं की स्थिति मुख्यतः किस प्रथा से चिह्नित थी?
oe: Purdah and restrictions on public appearance
Free education in schools for all girls
oh: पर्दा तथा सार्वजनिक रूप से बाहर न निकल पाना
सभी बालिकाओं के लिए निःशुल्क विद्यालयी शिक्षा
महिलाओं का ग्राम-मुखिया के रूप में कार्य
e: 19vein sadi ke Bihar me purdah ki pratha kathor thi tatha mahilaon ka sarvajanik roop se bahar nikalna mana maana jaata tha; unhe palanquin tatha parde ke peeche rakha jaata tha tatha aisi stithi me angreji adalat bhi unse commission ke zariye ya judge ke saamne pehredari ke beech bayan leti thi. Purdah dhan tatha rutbe ka chinh ban gaya tha, isliye oonchi khandanon ki mahilayein bhi ise apnati thi tatha unka samajik yogdaan parde ke peeche se hi hota tha. Isi daur me S. C. Bose ne lagbhag 1881 me likha tha ki mahila ka jeevan bachpan se budhape tak udaasi tatha upkeksha se bhara rehta hai. Aise varnan dikhate hain ki 19vein sadi ke samaj-sudhar andolan (Brahmo-Arya Samaj aadi) ne mahilaon ki shiksha, purdah-nivaran tatha vidhva punarvivah ko apna mukhya mudda banaya. Compulsory vidhva punarvivah, gram-mukhiya ka pad tatha sabhi balikaon ki muft schooling us samay nahi thi - isliye sahi uttar purdah tatha sarvajanik jeevan se doori hai. Exam point: 19vein sadi ke Bihar me mahilaon ki stithi = kathor purdah tatha sarvajanik jeevan se doori; angreji adalat bhi unka bayan parde ke peeche leti thi; Brahmo tatha Arya Samaj jaise andolanon ne purdah-nivaran, mahila-shiksha tatha vidhva punarvivah par zor diya.

qe: The Wahabi movement of the Patna district took its name from Muhammad Wahab, who was born before the beginning of the eighteenth century in which province of Central Arabia?
qh: पटना जिले का वहाबी आंदोलन मुहम्मद वहाब के नाम पर चला; उनका जन्म अठारहवीं शताब्दी के आरंभ से पूर्व मध्य अरब के किस प्रांत में हुआ था?
e: Wahabi andolan ka naam Muhammad Wahab se pada. Unka janm atharahvin shatabdi ke aarambh se pehle Nejd me hua, jo Central Arabia yaani madhya Arab ka ek prant hai. Unhone ek aise sampraday ki sthapna ki jisme Imams ki tippaniyon ko maanne se inkar kiya gaya, Sultan yaani shasak ki satta ko nahi maana gaya, Muhammad ki satta ko tulnatmak roop se halka maana gaya, kisi paigambar ya sant se prarthna karne ka nishedh kiya gaya tatha avishwasiyon ke virudh yuddh karne ki zaroorat par zor diya gaya. Unnisvin shatabdi ke aarambh me yah soch Mecca ki yatra se lauti teerth-yatriyon ke saath Bharat me pahunchi tatha yahan ise naya netritva mila. Exam point: Wahabi andolan Muhammad Wahab ke naam par hai; unka janm atharahvin shatabdi se pehle Central Arabia ke Nejd prant me hua tatha unke sampraday ne santon-paigambaron se prarthna tatha Sultan ki satta nahi maani.

qe: After the Wahabi doctrines reached India from Mecca, who became the leader of the sect here and in 1820 travelled south from Delhi to preach reform and incite a jihad against the Sikhs?
qh: मक्का से ये सिद्धांत भारत पहुँचने के बाद यहाँ वहाबी संप्रदाय का नेता कौन बना, जिसने 1820 में दिल्ली से दक्षिण की ओर सुधार का उपदेश देने तथा सिखों के विरुद्ध जिहाद भड़काने की यात्रा की?
oe: Saiyid Ahmed Shah of Rai Bareli
e: Unnisvin shatabdi ke aarambh me Wahabi vichar Mecca ki yatra se lauti teerth-yatriyon ke saath Bharat aaye tatha Rai Bareli ke Saiyid Ahmed Shah is sampraday ke neta ban gaye. 1820 me unhone Delhi se dakshin ki or yatra shuru ki. Is yatra ka uddeshya logon ko sudhar ka updesh dena tatha Sikhon ke virudh jihad yaani dharm-yuddh ke liye jodna tha; us samay yah shikayat thi ki Punjab ke Muhammadans par atyachar ho raha hai tatha unhe apne dharm ke palan ki chhoot nahi mil rahi hai. Bengal ki or jaate hue woh Patna bhi pahunche tatha yahin se is andolan ka ek bada kendra khada hua. Exam point: Bharat me Wahabi sampraday ke neta Rai Bareli ke Saiyid Ahmed Shah bane; 1820 me unhone Delhi se dakshin ki or sudhar tatha Sikhon ke virudh jihad ka updesh dene ke liye yatra shuru ki tatha Patna aaye.

qe: When Saiyid Ahmed arrived at Patna on his way to Bengal, he was accompanied by a large fleet of boats carrying upwards of how many enthusiastic disciples?
qh: बंगाल की ओर जाते समय सैयद अहमद बड़े बेड़े में नावों पर सवार होकर पटना पहुँचे थे; उनके साथ कितने से अधिक उत्साही शिष्य थे?
e: 1820 me Saiyid Ahmed Delhi se chale tatha Bengal ki or jaate hue Patna pahunche. Unke saath naavon ka ek bada beda tha, jinme paanch sau se zyada utsahi shishya sawar the. Patna me unke kai logon ne unka saath liya, jinme Wilayat Ali, Inayat Ali, Shah Muhammad Hussain, Wahi Bakhsh tatha Sadikpur ke unke putra Ahmed Ulla shamil the. Calcutta jaane se pehle unhone Shah Muhammad Hussain, Wilayat Ali tatha Inayat Ali ko Patna me apna caliph yaani naib niyukt kiya. In naibon ka kaam unke naam se naye anusariyon ko jodna tatha Sikhon ke virudh yuddh ke liye paisa, hathiyar tatha saman jama karna tha. Exam point: Saiyid Ahmed paanch sau se zyada utsahi shishyon ke saath Patna pahunche tatha Calcutta jaane se pehle Shah Muhammad Hussain, Wilayat Ali tatha Inayat Ali ko Patna me apna caliph yaani naib niyukt kiya.

qe: In accordance with the decisions of the general meeting of his caliphs, which city was fixed as the headquarters of the Wahabi movement in Bengal, with Shah Muhammad Hussain acknowledged as the local chief caliph?
qh: ख़लीफ़ाओं के सामान्य सम्मेलन के निर्णयों के अनुसार बंगाल में वहाबी आंदोलन का मुख्यालय किस शहर को बनाया गया, जहाँ शाह मुहम्मद हुसैन को स्थानीय प्रधान ख़लीफ़ा स्वीकार किया गया?
e: 1823 me Shah Muhammad Hussain ek bade samuh ke saath Saiyid Ahmed se ja mile tatha unke caliphon yaani naibon ki ek general meeting hui. Is meeting me tay hua ki unke abhiyan ke liye purush tatha dhan bheja jayega. Isi nirnay ke aadhar par Bengal me Patna ko mukhyalaya banaya gaya tatha Shah Muhammad Hussain ko local chief caliph yaani pradhan khali fa maana gaya. Is vichar ko phailane ke liye kai parche tatha chhote granth chhape tatha baante gaye, jinme Bharat ke Musalmanon se kaha gaya ki woh ek ho kar desh ki vijay ke liye jihad karen, apne logon ko joden, dhan jama karen tatha Saiyid Ahmed ko Imam Mahdi maane. Isi daur se Patna par sarkar ki nazar tik gayi. Exam point: 1823 ki caliphon ki meeting ke nirnay ke baad Bengal me Patna Wahabi abhiyan ka mukhyalaya bana tatha Shah Muhammad Hussain local chief caliph mane gaye; prachar ke liye parche tatha chhote granth chhape gaye.

qe: Saiyid Ahmed began his jihad against the Sikhs in 1827 with liberal supplies of men and money from Bengal, and Peshawar was taken in 1830; in which year was he killed in a battle against the Sikhs?
qh: सैयद अहमद ने 1827 में सिखों के विरुद्ध जिहाद आरंभ किया, जिसके लिए बंगाल से खूब पुरुष तथा धन भेजा गया, तथा 1830 में पेशावर पर कब्ज़ा हुआ; किस वर्ष सिखों के विरुद्ध लड़ाई में वे मारे गए?
e: 1827 me Saiyid Ahmed ne Sikhon ke virudh jihad shuru kiya. Bengal se unhe purush tatha dhan ki khul kar madad bheji gayi tatha seema par yuddh ki aag bhadak uthi. 1830 me Peshawar par unka kabza ho gaya tatha Punjab ko jitne ke liye ek bade dharm-yuddh ki ghoshna hui, jiske liye Patna se Wahabiyon ka ek jhund seema ki or rawana hua. Lekin 1831 me Sikhon ke virudh hui ek ladaai me Saiyid Ahmed mare gaye. Unki mrityu ke baad Patna ke Wilayat Ali tatha Inayat Ali Wahabiyon ke pramukh neta ban gaye tatha woh seema ki or apna dhyan modne lage. Exam point: 1827 me Sikhon ke virudh jihad shuru hua, 1830 me Peshawar par kabza hua tatha 1831 me Sikhon ke saath ladaai me Saiyid Ahmed mare gaye; uske baad Wilayat Ali tatha Inayat Ali Patna me pramukh neta bane.

qe: After the Wahabis had built up their hold along the left bank of the Indus, Wilayat Ali and Inayat Ali surrendered to the British agent at Haripur in 1847 and at Patna were bound in bail of what amount not to leave their homes for four years?
qh: सिंधु नदी के बाएँ किनारे पर अपना असर जमाने के बाद विलायत अली तथा इनायत अली ने 1847 में हरिपुर के ब्रिटिश एजेंट के सामने आत्मसमर्पण किया तथा पटना में कितनी रक़म के मुचलके पर बाँधा गया कि वे चार वर्ष तक घर से बाहर न जाएँ?
e: Saiyid Ahmed ki mrityu ke baad Wilayat Ali tatha Inayat Ali Wahabiyon ke pramukh neta ban gaye tatha sanyukt kaam se unka adhikar Sindhu nadi ke baein kinare par ek bade bhaag par ho gaya, jo Haripur se Kagan tak tatha Sittana se Kashmir tak phaila tha. Lekin British sarkar ki suraksha me ek nayi Sikh satta banne se unke liye apne kabze banaye rakhna asambhav ho gaya, isliye 1847 me unhone Haripur ke British agent ke saamne aatmasamarpan kar diya. Unhe hirasat me Patna ke unke gharon par bhej diya gaya tatha das hazaar rupaye ke muchalke yaani bail par bandh diya gaya ki woh char varsh tak wahan se nahi jayenge. Exam point: 1847 me Haripur ke British agent ke saamne aatmasamarpan ke baad Wilayat Ali tatha Inayat Ali ko Patna bheja gaya tatha das hazaar rupaye ke muchalke par char varsh ke liye bandh diya gaya.

qe: When letters seized in 1852 by the Punjab authorities showed that an organised conspiracy to tamper with the Native Infantry at Rawalpindi had originated at Patna, what did the Patna Magistrate report about the Wahabi leader Ahmed Ulla?
qh: 1852 में पंजाब के अधिकारियों द्वारा ज़ब्त किए गए कुछ पत्रों से पता चला कि रावलपिंडी की देशी पैदल सेना को बहकाने की संगठित साज़िश पटना से शुरू हुई थी; तब पटना के मजिस्ट्रेट ने वहाबी नेता अहमद उल्ला के बारे में क्या रिपोर्ट किया?
oe: That he had assembled six or seven hundred men and was prepared to resist further enquiry
That he had been made a Deputy Collector
That he had fled to Nepal
That he had abandoned the sect
oh: कि उसने छह-सात सौ आदमी इकट्ठे कर लिए थे तथा आगे की जाँच का विरोध करने को तैयार था
कि उसे डिप्टी कलेक्टर बना दिया गया था
कि वह नेपाल भाग गया था
कि उसने संप्रदाय छोड़ दिया था
e: 1852 me Punjab ke adhikariyon ne kuch patra zabt kiye, jinse pata chala ki Rawalpindi ki desi paidal sena ko behkane yaani apne paksh me karne ki ek sangathit saazish Patna se shuru hui thi. Patna ke Wahabi neta - jinme Ahmed Ulla bhi shamil the, jise kuch jagah Ahmadullah bhi kaha jaata hai - dhan ikattha kar rahe the tatha Sittana me dere daale Wahabiyon ko hathiyar tatha saman bhej rahe the. Patna ke Magistrate ne talash ki, lekin sazishkarata pehle se satark the tatha unke patra nash kar diye gaye. Usne report di ki Wahabi sampraday badh raha hai, uske prachar Wilayat Ali, Ahmed Ulla tatha unke pita Wahi Bakhsh ke gharon me ho raha hai, Wahabi police ke saath mili hui hain, tatha Ahmed Ulla ne chhe-saat sau aadmi ikattha kar liye hain aur woh aage ki jaanch ka virodh karne ko taiyar hai. Exam point: 1852 ki jaanch me pata chala ki Rawalpindi ki desi sena ko behkane ki saazish Patna se chali thi; Patna ke Magistrate ne bataya ki Ahmed Ulla ne chhe-saat sau aadmi ikattha kiye the tatha Wahabi police ke saath mili hui the.

qe: In the creed preached at Patna, every true Musalman was asked to join the leader of the fighters for the faith; by which title, held at that time by Ahmed Ulla, was this leader known?
qh: पटना में प्रचारित मत के अनुसार हर सच्चे मुसलमान को धर्म के योद्धाओं के नेता से जुड़ने को कहा जाता था; उस समय अहमद उल्ला के पास रही इस पदवी का नाम क्या था?
e: Patna me phaile Wahabi mat ke mukhya bindu yah the ki Saiyid Ahmed phir pragat honge, sabhi avishwasiyon ka nash karenge tatha British raj ko ukhad denge. Isliye har sachche Musalman ka pehla kartavya yah bataya gaya ki woh is nek kaam ko apni poori shakti se badhaye tatha jihad me sahayata kare. Usse kaha jaata tha ki woh Amir-ul-mujahid-ud-din yaani dharm ke yoddhaon ke neta se turant jud jaye, jo us samay Ahmed Ulla tha. Is mat me marne wale sipahi ko shahid yaani dharma ke liye ladte hue marne wala, avishwasiyon ko marne wale ko ghazi yaani veer tatha ladai se ji churane wale ko nari yaani dhikkariya kaha jaata tha. Exam point: Patna ke Wahabi mat me sachche Musalman ko Amir-ul-mujahid-ud-din yaani dharm ke yoddhaon ke neta se judne ko kaha jaata tha, jo us samay Ahmed Ulla tha; marne wale ko shahid, avishwasiyon ko marne wale ko ghazi tatha ji churane wale ko nari kaha jaata tha.

qe: In the fresh enquiries of 1868-69 five of the seven men tried at Patna were sentenced to transportation for life with forfeiture of property; which rich banker and money-lender among them was described as the most influential of the conspirators?
qh: 1868-69 की नई जाँचों में पटना में मुक़दमा चलाए गए सात व्यक्तियों में से पाँच को संपत्ति ज़ब्ती के साथ आजीवन निर्वासन की सज़ा मिली; इनमें से सबसे प्रभावशाली बताया गया धनी बैंकर तथा साहूकार कौन था?
e: Ahmed Ulla ko hata dene ke baad bhi Wahabiyon ki gatividhiyan chalti rahin. 1868-69 me phir pata chala ki kuch samay se jihad ka prachar ho raha tha tatha seema par dere daale Wahabiyon ki madad ke liye desh bhar me ek niyamit vyavastha ke tehat dhan ikattha kiya ja raha tha, jiske liye kai jagah agent niyukt the. Patna me saat aadmi giraftar kar ke mukadme ke saamne rakhe gaye, jinme se paanch ko sampatti jabt hone ke saath aajivan nirvasan yaani transportation for life ki saza mili. In paanch me Amir Khan naam ka ek dhani banker tatha sahukar bhi tha, jise sazishkarata me sabse prabhavshali maana gaya. Uske tatha ek anya vyakti ki saza ko High Court me appeal ke baad bhi kayam rakha gaya tatha in mukadmon ne Patna ke Wahabi sangathan ki shakti tod di. Exam point: 1868-69 ke mukadmon me Patna ke saat giraftaron me se paanch ko sampatti jabt ke saath aajivan nirvasan ki saza mili; unme dhani banker tatha sahukar Amir Khan sabse prabhavshali sazishkarata maana gaya.

qe: By what name did the modern representatives of the Wahabi movement prefer to style themselves, after the older designation had become a term of reproach?
qh: वहाबी आंदोलन के आधुनिक प्रतिनिधियों ने पुराना नाम अपमानजनक हो जाने के बाद स्वयं को किस नाम से पुकारना पसंद किया?
e: Wahabi andolan ka purana naam samay ke saath apmaan-janak ho gaya tha, isliye unke adhunik pratinidhiyon ne is naam ko chhod diya tatha apne liye Ahl-i-Hadis naam chun liya. Ahl-i-Hadis ka arth hota hai parampara yaani Hadis wale log. Is sampraday ki mukhya visheshta yah hai ki woh Hadis, yaani Muhammad ke woh kahe huye shabd jo Koran me shamil nahi hain, unki vyakhya svayan karte hain tatha kisi ek vishesh Imam ka anusaran nahi karte. Is tarah yah sampraday apne vicharon me purani Wahabi dhara ko aage badhata raha, lekin naam badal kar apni nayi pahchan banayi. Exam point: Wahabiyon ke adhunik pratinidhi apne aap ko Ahl-i-Hadis kehte the, jiska arth parampara wale log hai; woh Hadis ki vyakhya svayan karte the tatha kisi vishesh Imam ka anusaran nahi karte the.

qe: What was the chief characteristic of the Ahl-i-Hadis creed, which distinguished them from other Muhammadan sects?
qh: अहल-ए-हदीस मत की मुख्य विशेषता क्या थी, जो उन्हें अन्य मुस्लिम संप्रदायों से अलग करती थी?
oe: They accepted the glosses of the Imams as final
They recognised the Sultan's authority in matters of faith
They worshipped at the tombs of saints
They interpreted the Hadis for themselves and followed no particular Imam
oh: वे इमामों की टिप्पणियों को अंतिम मानते थे
वे धर्म के मामलों में सुल्तान की सत्ता मानते थे
वे संतों की मज़ारों पर पूजा करते थे
वे हदीस की व्याख्या स्वयं करते थे तथा किसी विशेष इमाम का अनुसरण नहीं करते थे
e: Ahl-i-Hadis ka arth hai Hadis yaani parampara wale log. Is mat ki sabse badi visheshta yah thi ki log Hadis, yaani Muhammad ke woh kahe gaye shabd jo Koran me shamil nahi hain, ki vyakhya svayan karte the tatha kisi ek vishesh Imam ke kehne par nahi chalte the. Isi vajah se yah sampraday us Wahabi vichardhara ke kareeb maana jaata tha, jo Imams ki tippaniyon ko nahi maanti thi tatha santon ya paigambaron se prarthna karne ka nishedh karti thi. Aise vichar unnisvin shatabdi ke Bharat me sudhar aur punarutthan ki dhara ke roop me phailte rahe tatha Patna jaisa shahar bhi iska kendra bana. Exam point: Ahl-i-Hadis mat ki mukhya visheshta yah thi ki woh Hadis ki vyakhya svayan karte the tatha kisi vishesh Imam ka anusaran nahi karte the; isliye yah Wahabi vichardhara ke kareeb maana jaata tha.

qe: Ghosrawan, a village seven miles south-west of Bihar, was inhabited almost entirely by Babhans, who distinguished themselves in which year by rising, an exploit which ended in the burning of the village?
qh: बिहार से सात मील दक्षिण-पश्चिम स्थित घोसरावाँ गाँव में लगभग पूरी तरह बभन लोग रहते थे, जिन्होंने किस वर्ष विद्रोह करके अपनी पहचान बनाई, जिसका परिणाम गाँव के जल जाने में हुआ?
e: Ghosrawan Bihar subdivision me ek gaon hai, jo Bihar se saat meel dakshin-pashchim me sthit hai. Yah gaon ek purane Bauddh sthan ka hissa tha, jiske avshesh kai teelon ke roop me milte hain. Aaj ka gaon lagbhag poori tarah Babhans se abaad hai. Babhans Patna jile ke pramukh samudayon me gine jaate the tatha khetee tatha gaon ke kaam-kaj me unka prabhutva tha. 1857 me is gaon ke logon ne vidroh kiya tatha isme unhe vishesh pehchan mili. Lekin is vidroh ka ant bura hua - gaon jal kar raakh ho gaya tatha bade hisse me vidrohi logan ko gaon se bhaga diya gaya. Is ghatna se pata chalta hai ki 1857 ka badlav keval bade shahron tak hi nahi raha; chhote gaon bhi usme shamil the tatha unhe badi keemat chukani padi. Exam point: Bihar se saat meel dakshin-pashchim sthit Ghosrawan gaon me 1857 me Babhans ne vidroh kiya; is vidroh ka ant gaon ke jal jaane tatha bade hisse me vidrohiyon ke nikal jaane ke saath hua.

qe: In his stronghold at Jagdishpur, Kunwar Singh established a factory of arms and ammunition and stored provisions enough to feed an army of how many men, and for how long?
qh: जगदीशपुर की अपनी गढ़ी में कुंवर सिंह ने हथियार तथा गोला-बारूद बनाने का कारखाना खोला और कितने सैनिकों के लिए कितने समय का राशन जमा किया था?
oe: Ten thousand men for one year
Fifty thousand men for six months
Five thousand men for one year
Twenty thousand men for six months
oh: दस हज़ार सैनिकों के लिए एक वर्ष का
पचास हज़ार सैनिकों के लिए छह महीने का
पाँच हज़ार सैनिकों के लिए एक वर्ष का
बीस हज़ार सैनिकों के लिए छह महीने का
e: 1857 ke vidroh me Bhojpur (purana Shahabad) ke Jagdishpur gaon Kunwar Singh ka sabse mazboot thikana tha. Is gadi yaani ghar ke aas-paas unhone ek aisa karkhana banaya, jahan hathiyar tatha gola-baarud tayyar hote the. Iske alawa unhone itna anaaj tatha rasad jama kiya, jo bees hazaar sipahiyon ko chhah mahine tak khana khila sake; itni badi taiyari dikhati hai ki yah vidroh kisi chhoti ghatna ke liye nahi, balki lambe sangram ke liye plan kiya gaya tha. Unke saath unke bhai Amar Singh tatha Reethnarayan Singh, unke bhatije Nishan Singh tatha Jaikrishna Singh, Shahabad ke char zamindar tatha ek Muhammadan vakeel bhi jude the. Aise logon ne milkar British sarkar ke khilaf ek vyavasthit morcha khada kiya. Exam point: Jagdishpur me Kunwar Singh ne hathiyar tatha gola-baarud ka karkhana banaya tatha bees hazaar sipahiyon ke liye chhah mahine ka rasad jama kiya tha.

qe: The force of nearly five hundred men sent from Dinapore for the relief of Arrah was defeated on 30 July 1857 under which officer, whose mismanagement was blamed for the disaster?
qh: आरा की सहायता के लिए दीनापुर से भेजी गई लगभग पाँच सौ सैनिकों की टुकड़ी 30 जुलाई 1857 को किस अधिकारी के नेतृत्व में हार गई, जिसकी गलत कमान को इस आपदा का कारण बताया गया?
e: 27 July 1857 ko Dinapore se Aara pahunche vidrohi sipahiyon ke saath mil kar Kunwar Singh ki sena ne Aara me angrejon ko gher liya. Aara ke Magistrate tatha sabhi European logon ne ek alag do-manzila makan me sharan liya tha, jise railway company ke District Engineer ne mazboot banaya tha. Ghere hue angrejon ki madad ke liye Dinapore se Captain Dunbar ke netritva me lagbhag paanch sau European tatha Sikh sipahiyon ki toli bheji gayi, lekin 30 July 1857 ko unhe karari haar ka munh dekhna pada. General Lloyd ne khud is abhiyan ko asafal batate hue kaha ki yah asafalta us adhikari ki galat command ke kaaran hui. Is haar se vidrohiyon ka manobal badha tatha Arrah kshetra me unka adhikar kuchh samay tak bana raha. Exam point: Dinapore se Aara ki sahayata ke liye bheji gayi Captain Dunbar ki lagbhag paanch sau sipahiyon wali toli 30 July 1857 ko har gayi tatha iske liye uski command ki galti batayi gayi.

qe: Towards the end of July 1857, the detachments of which two Native Infantry regiments sent from Patna revolted at Hazaribagh?
qh: जुलाई 1857 के अंत की ओर हजारीबाग में पटना से भेजी गई किन दो नेटिव इन्फैंट्री रेजिमेंटों की टुकड़ियों ने विद्रोह कर दिया?
e: 1857 ke vidroh ke samay Bihar ke nagar tatha chhawaniyan ek-ek kar ke vidrohi sipahiyon ke haath me aane lagin. Hazaribagh me July 1857 me Patna se bheji gayi saatvin tatha aathvin Native Infantry yaani deshi paidal sena ki tukadiyan tainat thi; Ranchi me Ramgarh battalion ka headquarters tatha artillery tha, tatha Chaibasa tatha Purulia me bhi Ramgarh battalion ki tukadiyan thi. July 1857 ke ant me Hazaribagh ki infantry companies ne vidroh kar diya; jis Lieutenant Graham ko Hazaribagh ja kar battalion ko nihathiya karne ka order mila tha, uske saath chalne wali Ramgarh Infantry ki do companies ne bhi turant vidroh kar diya. Hazaribagh ke is vidroh ne Chotanagpur kshetra me angreji hukumat ki jameen hilne lagi. Exam point: Hazaribagh me Patna se bheji gayi saatvin tatha aathvin Native Infantry ki tukadiyon ne July 1857 ke ant me vidroh kiya tha, aur yah vidroh aage Ranchi tatha Doranda tak phaila.

qe: The Ramgarh Infantry, which revolted on the way to disarm the battalions at Hazaribagh, hurried back to Ranchi under the leadership of which Jamadar?
qh: हजारीबाग की बटालियनों को निहत्था करने जाते समय विद्रोह करने वाली रामगढ़ इन्फैंट्री किस जमादार के नेतृत्व में रांची लौट गई?
e: Hazaribagh me vidroh ki khabar phailte hi Lieutenant Graham ko Ramgarh Infantry ki do companies ke saath wahan ja kar battalion ko nihathiya yaani hathiyaron se rahit karne ka aadesh diya gaya. Lekin raaste me hi in companies ne vidroh kar diya tatha Jamadar Madhab Singh ke netritva me wapas Ranchi ki or chal padi, jahan anya vidrohi sipahi unke saath mil gaye. Jamadar ek chhota sainik adhikari hota hai, jo sainikon ki ek chhoti tukadi ki command karta hai, lekin us samay aise hi chhote adhikariyon ne vidroh ka netritva kiya. Ranchi tatha Doranda jaldi hi vidrohi sipahiyon ke haath me aa gaye, jinhone sthaniya sarkari khazane par kabza kar liya tatha jail ke kaidiyon ko riha kar diya. Is tarah Chotanagpur kshetra me bhi Company ki satta ko khula chunauti mili. Exam point: Ramgarh Infantry Jamadar Madhab Singh ke netritva me vidroh karke Ranchi ki or badhi, jahan vidrohi sipahiyon ne Ranchi tatha Doranda par adhikar kar liya.

qe: Which leader guided the sepoys of Doranda when they followed the example of the Ranchi troops in 1857?
qh: 1857 में जब दोरंडा के सिपाहियों ने रांची की सैनिकों का उदाहरण अपनाया, तब उनका नेतृत्व किसने किया?
e: Chotanagpur kshetra me Hazaribagh ke vidroh ka asar turant dikha. Ramgarh Infantry ne Jamadar Madhab Singh ke netritva me vidroh kar diya tatha Ranchi ki or badh padi, aur unke saath anek anya sipahi judte chale gaye. Isi tarah Doranda ki sipahiyon ne bhi vidroh kiya, aur unka netritva Jaimangal Singh ne kiya. Doranda Ranchi ke nikat ek sthal tha, jahan Company ki sena tatha astra-shala tainat thi, isliye us sthal par adhikar karna vidrohiyon ke liye mahatvapurna tha. Ranchi tatha Doranda dono sthal vidrohi sipahiyon ke haath me aane ke baad unhonne sarkari khazane ka dhan apne kabze me kiya tatha jail ke kaidiyon ko chhod diya, jisse angreji hukumat ke liye sankat aur badh gaya. Exam point: Doranda ke sipahiyon ka netritva Jaimangal Singh ne kiya tha, jabki Ramgarh Infantry ka netritva Jamadar Madhab Singh ke haath me tha.

qe: In 1845-46, during the First Anglo-Sikh War, a plot detected at Patna aimed at the destruction of the English and the re-establishment of what?
qh: 1845-46 में प्रथम आंग्ल-सिख युद्ध के दौरान पटना में पकड़ी गई साजिश का उद्देश्य अंग्रेजों को नष्ट करना तथा किसकी पुनःस्थापना करना था?
e: 1845-46 me pratham angrej-sikh yuddh ke samay Company sarkar apne sabhi sadhan seema ke uttar-pashchim morche par laga rahi thi. Is avsar ka labh uthane ke liye Patna me ek sazish rachui gayi, jiska uddeshya angrejon ka vinash tatha British hukumat ko ukhad kar ek Muhammadan rajvansh ki punahsthapna karna tha. Us samay ke angreji adhikariyon ka manna tha ki Patna ki Muhammadan ashl-tabke log deshi adhikariyon tatha Dinapore ki chhawni ke sipahiyon ko bhi apne paksh me karne me safal ho gaye the. Is sazish ka pata chalne par bhi angreji sarkar ne bahut savdhani se kaam liya, kyunki unhe dar tha ki khuli karwai se logon me aur bhi asantosh phail sakta hai. Yah ghatna batati hai ki 1857 se pehle bhi Bihar me angreji satta ke khilaf asantosh tatha sazishen chalti rahi thin. Exam point: 1845-46 ki Patna sazish ka uddeshya angrejon ko nasht karna tatha ek Muhammadan rajvansh ki punahsthapna karna tha.

qe: Sidhu and Kanhu, who led the Santhal rising, were inhabitants of which village near Birbait in the Damin area of the Santhal Parganas?
qh: सांथाल विद्रोह का नेतृत्व करने वाले सिधु तथा कान्हू संथाल परगनों के दामिन क्षेत्र में बिरबैत के पास किस गाँव के निवासी थे?
e: 1855-57 ka Santhal vidroh Bihar kshetra ke sabse bade adivasi sangharshon me se ek tha. Yah vidroh ka netritva char bhaiyon - Sidhu, Kanhu, Chand tatha Bhoirab - ne kiya, jo Santhal Parganas ke Damin kshetra ki Kajnuhal tatha aas-paas ki zameen ke nivasi the. Is kshetra me Damin yaani woh bhag shamil tha, jo seedhe sarkar ke prabandh me tha tatha jahan zamindaron ka asar kam tha. Sidhu tatha Kanhu ka gaon Bhagnadih tha, jo Birbait gaon ke paas basaa hua tha. Is vidroh ne Burdwan ke aas-paas se Bhagalpur tak ek bade kshetra ko apni chapet me le liya, aur ise dabaane me Company sarkar ko bahut bada kharch tatha sena lagaani padi. Exam point: Santhal vidroh ke nayak Sidhu tatha Kanhu Birbait ke paas base Bhagnadih gaon ke nivasi the; vidroh ka netritva Sidhu, Kanhu, Chand tatha Bhoirab char bhaiyon ne kiya.

qe: Which two nephews of Kunwar Singh were among his chief followers in the struggle of 1857?
qh: कुंवर सिंह के कौन-से दो भतीजे 1857 के संग्राम में उनके प्रमुख साथियों में शामिल थे?
oe: Thakur Dayal Singh and Bisheshwar Singh
oh: ठाकुर दयाल सिंह तथा बिशेश्वर सिंह
e: Bihar ke 1857 sangram ke sabse bade nayak Kunwar Singh ke saath unke parivar tatha ilaake ke zamindar, dono ke log shamil the. Unke do bhai Amar Singh tatha Reethnarayan Singh, tatha do bhatije Nishan Singh tatha Jaikrishna Singh unke mukhya saathiyon me the. Inke alawa Shahabad ke char zamindar - Narhan Singh, Joohan Singh, Thakur Dayal Singh tatha Bisheshwar Singh - tatha ek Muhammadan vakil tatha ek anya yuva Muhammadan bhi unke saath mile. Aapas me rishtedaar tatha ilaake ke prabhavshali logon ka yah samooh dikhata hai ki Kunwar Singh ke netritva me ek sthaniya sena khadi hui thi, jo Bhumihar, Rajput tatha Muhammadan, sabhi samudaayon ke logon se bani thi. Isi kaaran unka vidroh Bhojpur tatha aas-paas ke kshetron me lambe samay tak chala. Exam point: Kunwar Singh ke bhatije Nishan Singh tatha Jaikrishna Singh unke mukhya saathiyon me the, jabki Amar Singh tatha Reethnarayan Singh unke bhai the.

qe: Which hero of the Bihar rising of 1857-9 had earlier been suspected of involvement in the anti-British plot of 1845-6, though the Bengal Government did not approve of his arrest?
qh: बिहार के 1857-9 के विद्रोह के किस नायक पर पहले 1845-6 की अंग्रेज-विरोधी साजिश में शामिल होने का संदेह जताया गया था, हालाँकि बंगाल सरकार ने उसकी गिरफ्तारी को मंजूरी नहीं दी?
e: Patna ke Magistrate ne Bengal sarkar ke saath hui patrachaar me likha tha ki Jagdishpur ke Babu Kunwar Singh, jo Shahabad jile ke sabse prabhavshali zamindaron me the tatha Arrah tatha Shahabad ke anya nagaron ke logon me bahut lokapriya the, 1845-46 ki sazish me shamil hone ka sandeh hai. Aur bhi kaha gaya ki unki mohar wale patra mile the, jo unke shamil hone ka pramaan maane ja sakte the. Lekin Bengal sarkar ne unki giraftari ko manyata nahi di, kyunki sarkar ko dar tha ki isse logon me virodh bhadak sakta hai. Bahut saal baad, 1857 me wahi Kunwar Singh Bihar ke vidroh ke sabse bade nayak ban kar ubhre tatha unke netritva me angreji sarkar ko bhari chunauti mili. Yah baat dikhati hai ki 1857 se pehle hi Bihar me angreji shaasan ke khilaf bhoomika tayyar ho rahi thi. Exam point: Jagdishpur ke Babu Kunwar Singh par 1845-46 ki sazish me shamil hone ka sandeh tha, lekin Bengal sarkar ne unki giraftari ki manyata nahi di thi.
