qe: At Lucknow the Shah of Oudh presented Kunwar Singh with a robe of honour, twelve thousand rupees in cash and a firman for which district?
qh: लखनऊ में अवध के शाह ने कुंवर सिंह को खिलअत, बारह हज़ार रुपये नकद तथा किस जिले का फरमान भेंट किया?
e: August 1857 me Kunwar Singh Bihar chhod kar anya kshetron me bhi British sena ke khilaf ladte rahe; woh Rewa, Gwalior, Lucknow tatha Azamgarh jaise sthalon tak gaye. Lucknow me avadh ke shah ne unhe sammanit kiya tatha khilat yaani bhavya vastra, barah hazaar rupaye nakad tatha Azamgarh jile ka farman bhaint kiya. Farman yaani shahi aadesh-patra, jisse kisi kshetra ka prabandh tatha aay ka adhikar diya jata tha. Yah samman dikhata hai ki Kunwar Singh ki khyaati Bihar ki seema se bahar bhi phail chuki thi tatha anya riyasaton ke shasak unhe apna sahayak maan rahe the. Us samay British sarkar ke liye yah ek badi chunauti thi, kyunki unhe lagta tha ki Kunwar Singh Patna par hamla kar sakte hain. Exam point: Lucknow me avadh ke shah ne Kunwar Singh ko khilat, barah hazaar rupaye tatha Azamgarh jile ka farman diya tha.

qe: Kunwar Singh joined a band of his comrades at which place, about twenty-five miles from Azamgarh, on 17 March 1858?
qh: 17 मार्च 1858 को कुंवर सिंह आज़मगढ़ से लगभग पच्चीस मील दूर किस स्थान पर अपने साथियों की टोली से मिले?
e: 1858 ke aarambh me Kunwar Singh ki sena azadi ki ladai ka ek prabhavshali kendra ban chuki thi. Woh Rewa ki sena me shamil hone ki koshish karne Rewa gaye, phir Banda tatha Kalpi hokar Kanpur ki ladai me hissa liya tatha aage Lucknow pahunche. Azamgarh se pandrah meel ke aas-paas Atrauha naam ke sthal par 17 March 1858 ko woh apne saathiyon ki ek toli se mile. Iske kuchh hi din baad Colonel Milman ke netritva wali British sena ne un par hamla kiya, lekin woh khud har gayi tatha bhaag kar Azamgarh ke morche me chhup gayi. Kunwar Singh ke saathiyon ne peechha karke 26 March ko Azamgarh par adhikar kar liya, jisse ek mahatvapurna kshetra unke haath me aa gaya. Exam point: Kunwar Singh 17 March 1858 ko Azamgarh se pandrah meel door Atrauha me apne saathiyon se mile, aur 26 March ko unke saathiyon ne Azamgarh par adhikar kar liya.

qe: Wounded and with one arm lost in the fight against Brigadier Douglas's troops, Kunwar Singh crossed the Ganges the same night at which ghat?
qh: ब्रिगेडियर डगलस की सैनिकों से लड़ाई में घायल होकर और एक हाथ खोकर कुंवर सिंह उसी रात गंगा नदी किस घाट पर पार कर गए?
e: 21 April 1858 ko Kunwar Singh ki sena tatha Brigadier Douglas ki angreji sena ke beech bhari yuddh hua. Is ladai me Kunwar Singh bahut veerta se lade tatha bahut ghayal hone ke saath-saath unka ek hath bhi kat gaya, lekin unka sahas nahi toota. Usi raat woh ganga nadi paar kar Gaye tatha Shivapur ghat se hokar doosre kinare par pahunche; saath hi doosre kinare ke gaon ke logon ne unki sena ki bharpoor sahayata ki. Us samay woh assi saal se zyada ki umar ke the, isliye unke is sahas tatha hausle ne unke saathiyon ke manobal ko aur bhi badhaya. Is sangharsh ke baad woh apne thikane Jagdishpur ki or badhe, jahan unke saathiyon ne Captain Le Grand ki sena ko kadak jawab diya. Exam point: 21 April 1858 ki ladai me ghayal aur ek hath khone ke baad bhi Kunwar Singh usi raat Shivapur ghat se ganga paar kar gaye the.

qe: Kunwar Singh died how long after his victory over Captain Le Grand's troops at Jagdishpur?
qh: जगदीशपुर में कैप्टन ले ग्रां की सैना पर विजय पाने के कितने दिन बाद कुंवर सिंह का देहांत हो गया?
e: 23 April 1858 ko Jagdishpur me Captain Le Grand ki angreji sena ko Karari haar machi; is ladai me unke saathiyon ne angreji sena ke kai top bhi chheen liye tatha uski toli ke bahut se sipahi mar gaye. Lekin yah unki antim vijay sabit hui. Lambe samay ki thakan tatha nirantar ladai ne unhe tod diya tatha is vijay ke keval teen din baad hi, 26 April 1858 ko unka dehant ho gaya. Unki mrutyu ke baad bhi unke saathi hausla nahi hare; unke bhai Amar Singh tatha Joodhun Singh tatha anya saathiyon ne Bihar ke alag-alag hisson me sangharsh jari rakha tatha Jagdishpur me ek samantar sarkar tak chalayi. Isi kaaran angreji sarkar ko unke kshetra me kai mahine tak ashaanti rahi. Exam point: Captain Le Grand ki sena par vijay ke keval teen din baad, 26 April 1858 ko Kunwar Singh ka dehant ho gaya, lekin unke saathiyon ne sangharsh jari rakha.

qe: Kunwar Singh's brother Amar Singh was captured about the middle of December 1859 and died in which jail on 5 February 1860?
qh: कुंवर सिंह के भाई अमर सिंह दिसंबर 1859 के मध्य में पकड़े गए थे तथा 5 फरवरी 1860 को किस कारागार में उनका देहांत हुआ?
e: Kunwar Singh ke dehant ke baad unke bhai Amar Singh ne sangharsh ka netritva sambhala. Nana Saheb ke Nepal ki or bhaag jane ke baad Amar Singh tarai kshetra me gaye, taaki Nana Saheb ki sena ka netritva sambhal sake. Woh alag-alag sthalon par angreji sena se ladte rahe tatha unke saath anek gaon ke log bhi the; ant me December 1859 ke madhya me woh angreji sarkar ke haath pakad liye gaye. Unhe apne hi zile me mukadme ki sunwai ke liye Gorakhpur jail me rakha gaya, lekin 5 February 1860 ko pet kee bimari se unka dehant ho gaya; unka mukadma poori tarah shuru hi nahi ho saka tha. Is tarah 1857 ke vidroh ka yah sangharsh Bhojpur tatha purvanchal me 1860 tak chala. Exam point: Amar Singh December 1859 me pakde gaye tatha 5 February 1860 ko Gorakhpur jail me unka dehant ho gaya.

qe: Birsa, under whose leadership the Munda movement of Chotanagpur took shape, was a Munda of which village in Tamar thana?
qh: जिनके नेतृत्व में छोटानागपुर का मुंडा आंदोलन खड़ा हुआ, वे बिरसा तमाड़ थाने के किस गाँव के मुंडा थे?
e: Unnisvin sadi ke ant me Chotanagpur ke Ranchi tatha Singhbhum kshetra me kai krishi-sambandhi aandolan dabaye gaye the, lekin asantosh khatm nahi hui. 1831 se 1895 tak ke isi asantosh ne ek zyada bada roop liya, jiska netritva Birsa naam ke ek Munda yuva ne kiya. Birsa Tamar thana me base Chalkad gaon ka rahne wala Munda tha; Munda Chotanagpur ka ek pramukh aadivasi samuday hai, jo gaon ke mukhiya yaani Munda ke netritva me rehta tha. 1895 me Birsa tatha uske anuyayiyon ko giraftar kar liya gaya, lekin jail se riha hone ke baad usne apne kaam ko aur zyada tez kiya. Apni dharmik bhavna tatha lokapriyata ke kaaran woh aage chalkar Birsa Bhagwan ke naam se prasiddh hua tatha uske netritva me chala aandolan ko Ulgulan kaha gaya. Exam point: Birsa Tamar thana ke Chalkad gaon ka Munda tha; Munda Chotanagpur ka pramukh aadivasi samuday hai, aur Birsa ke netritva wale aandolan ko Ulgulan kaha jaata hai.

qe: Detachments of the Ramgarh Battalion at which two places revolted on 5 August 1857, following the example of the sepoys at Hazaribagh?
qh: हजारीबाग के सिपाहियों का उदाहरण अपनाते हुए रामगढ़ बटालियन की टुकड़ियों ने 5 अगस्त 1857 को किन दो स्थानों पर विद्रोह किया?
e: July 1857 me Hazaribagh me tainat saatvin tatha aathvin Native Infantry ki tukadiyon ne vidroh kar diya tatha Ramgarh battalion ke sainikon ne bhi unka saath diya. Ranchi to Ramgarh battalion ka headquarters tatha artillery ka sthal tha, tatha Chaibasa tatha Purulia me bhi usi battalion ki tukadiyan tainat thin. Isi silsile me 5 August 1857 ko Purulia tatha Chaibasa ki Ramgarh Battalion tukadiyon ne khule vidroh kar diya. Iske baad unke saathi 11 September ko Doranda se chal pade tatha Ghouriya me unhe Bhola Singh naam ke ek zamindar bhi mila; isi tarah vidroh ka daayra Ranchi, Hazaribagh, Palamau tatha Singhbhum tak phailta gaya. Alag-alag sthalon se uthe is vidroh ne angreji hukumat ke liye Chotanagpur me bahut badi chunauti khadi kar di. Exam point: Ramgarh Battalion ki Purulia tatha Chaibasa wali tukadiyon ne 5 August 1857 ko vidroh kiya; Ranchi Ramgarh battalion ka headquarters tha tatha Doranda ki tukadi 11 September ko wahan se chali.

qe: In Palamau the Bhogtas, under the leadership of which two of their chiefs, organized themselves into a large force and attacked Chainpur on 21 October 1857?
qh: पलामू में भोगता लोग किन दो सरदारों के नेतृत्व में एक बड़ी सेना बनाकर 21 अक्टूबर 1857 को चैनपुर पर हमला किया?
oe: Bhola Singh and Nadir Ali Khan
Tikait Unao Rao and Shaikh Bikari
oh: भोला सिंह तथा नादिर अली खान
टिकैत उनाओ राव तथा शेख बिकारी
e: Palamau kshetra me bhi 1857 ka vidroh bahut bhaari roop le chuka tha. Bhogta yaani Bhogta kisan samuday ke do sardaar, Pitambar tatha Lilambar, jinke saath Kharwar jaati ke log tatha Chero samuday ke log shamil ho gaye, mil kar ek badi sena banayi. Is sena ne 21 October 1857 ko Chainpur par hamla kiya tatha aage badh kar Shahpur pahunchi, jahan unhone Rani, yaani Raja Churaman ki patni, ki char topen bhi chheen lin tatha sthaniya police ko haraya. Vidrohiyon ne Lt. Graham ko Raghubir Dayal ke makan me gher liya, jo angreji sarkar ka sahayak tha. November me vidrohiyon ne Rajhara me coal company ke station par bhi hamla kiya tatha 2 December ko Manka tatha Chatarput ke thanon par hamla kiya, jisse poore kshetra me angreji prashasan ki kamar tutne lagi. Exam point: Palamau me Bhogta sardaar Pitambar tatha Lilambar ne Kharwar tatha Chero logon ke saath mil kar 21 October 1857 ko Chainpur par hamla kiya tatha aage Shahpur me Rani ki char topen chheen lin.

qe: Birsa came to be known as Birsa Bhagwan on account of which two qualities?
qh: किन दो गुणों के कारण बिरसा को बिरसा भगवान के नाम से जाना जाने लगा?
oe: His skill in trade and his large family
His religious zeal and his popularity
His skill in warfare and his wealth
His knowledge of English and his contacts with officials
oh: उसकी धार्मिक भावना तथा उसकी लोकप्रियता
अंग्रेजी का ज्ञान तथा अधिकारियों से संपर्क
e: Birsa ek sadharan Munda yuva tha, lekin uski dharmik bhavna tatha logon ke beech uski lokapriyata ne use logon ke dil me utaar diya. Yah log use Birsa Bhagwan ke naam se pukarne lage, yaani woh unke liye ek dharmik neta tatha rakshak ban gaya. British sarkar usko ek khatarnak vidrohi tatha upadravi samajhti thi, jabki aam logon ke liye woh unke dukh-dard ka saathi tha. Uska maksad tha samajik buriyon ka ant karna, tatha isi ke saath angreji hukumat tatha uske sahayakon ko hatane ki ichha bhi judi hui thi. Apni lokapriyata ke kaaran woh gaon-gaon ja kar logon ko ek kar sakta tha tatha alag-alag gaon ke log uske saath aandolan me shamil hote gaye. Exam point: Birsa apni dharmik bhavna tatha lokapriyata ke kaaran Birsa Bhagwan kehlaya; British sarkar use vidrohi maanti thi, lekin aam logon ke liye woh unke dukh ka saathi tha.

qe: The insurgents who left Doranda on 11 September 1857 were joined at Ghouriya by Bhola Singh, and probably intended to join Kunwar Singh's troops at which place?
qh: 11 सितंबर 1857 को दोरंडा से निकले विद्रोहियों से घौरिया में भोला सिंह मिले, और उनका विचार कुंवर सिंह की सैना से किस स्थान पर मिलने का था?
e: Hazaribagh tatha Ranchi ke vidroh ke baad Ramgarh Battalion ke vidrohi sipahi alag-alag dishaon me badhte rahe. Doranda ki tukadi 11 September 1857 ko wahan se chali tatha Ghouriya naam ke sthal par unhe Bhola Singh naam ke ek zamindar bhi mila, jo unke saath ho liya. Iske baad woh Kara tatha Ghandwa hote hue Chatra ki or badhe; kaha jaata hai ki unka irada Palamau se hokar jaane ka tatha Rohtasgarh ke paas Kunwar Singh ki sena se milkar ek saajha morcha banane ka tha. Isi tarah Chotanagpur tatha Bhojpur ke vidrohi aapas me sampark banaye rakhne ka prayas kar rahe the, jisse unka sangharsh ek bade roop me badal sake. Lekin 2 October 1857 ko Chatra ke paas angreji sena ke saath unka ghora mukabla hua, jisme unhe bahut nuksan uthana pada. Exam point: Doranda se nikle vidrohi Ghouriya me Bhola Singh se mile tatha unka irada Rohtasgarh ke paas Kunwar Singh ki sena se judne ka tha; raste me Chatra me unhe angreji sena se ladna pada.

qe: Which officer started for Palamau on 16 January 1858 with 140 Madras sepoys, a party of Ramgarh cavalry and a body of matchlockmen, and attacked the Palamau fort held by the insurgents?
qh: कौन-सा अधिकारी 16 जनवरी 1858 को 140 मद्रास सिपाहियों, रामगढ़ की घुड़सवार टुकड़ी तथा बंदूकधारियों के साथ पलामू के लिए रवाना हुआ और विद्रोहियों के कब्जे वाले पलामू किले पर हमला किया?
e: Palamau me vidroh ke phailne par angreji sarkar ne us kshetra ko dabane ke liye ek bada abhiyan chalaya. 16 January 1858 ko Captain Dalton apne saath ek sau chalis Madras ke sipahi, Ramgarh cavalry ki ek chhoti tukadi tatha matchlockmen yaani purani bandukon wale sainik lekar Palamau ki or rawana hue; Parganait Jagat Pal Singh ki command me yeh matchlockmen angreji sarkar ke sahayak the. Dalton 21 January ko Manka pahunche tatha raat me Lieutenant Graham bhi unse aa mile; agle din subah unhone Palamau ke kile par hamla kiya, jise vidrohiyon ne apne kabze me liya hua tha. Vidrohiyon ne kuchh samay tak bahut bahaduri se mukabla kiya, lekin ant me woh apne morche chhod kar alag-alag dishaon me nikal gaye. Isi tarah angreji sena ko Palamau ke vibhinn bhaagon me vidrohiyon ka peechha karna pada. Exam point: Captain Dalton 16 January 1858 ko 140 Madras sipahiyon tatha Ramgarh cavalry ke saath Palamau rawana huye tatha 21 January ko Manka pahunch kar agle din vidrohiyon ke kabze wale Palamau kile par hamla kiya.

qe: The underlying object of the Birsa movement was the internal purification of society by eradication of social evils, along with which other objective?
qh: बिरसा आंदोलन का मूल उद्देश्य सामाजिक बुराइयों के अंत द्वारा समाज की आंतरिक शुद्धि था, तथा उसके साथ कौन-सा अन्य उद्देश्य जुड़ा हुआ था?
oe: The spread of English education among the Mundas
The abolition of the village headman system
The migration of the Mundas to the plains
The removal of the alien government and of its supporters
oh: मुंडाओं में अंग्रेजी शिक्षा का प्रसार
मुंडाओं का मैदानी इलाकों में प्रवास
विदेशी सरकार तथा उसके समर्थकों को हटाना
e: Birsa andaolan ka mukhya adarsh tha samaj ka bhitar se sudhar yaani samajik buriyon ka ant. Isi ke saath-saath andaolan ka doosra bada maksad tha angreji hukumat tatha uske sahayakon, jaise zamindaron tatha anya labh-lene wale vargon ko hatana. Aadivasi kshetra me zamindar tatha bichauliyon ne unki zameen tatha upjau bhoomi par kabza badhaya tha, jisse log khud ko beghar tatha karz me dubta pate the. Birsa ki sena tatha samarthakon ne logon ki sahayata ki tatha ise lokapriyata mili, isliye yah andaolan bahut tezi se phailte gaye tatha kai gaon ke log uske saath jude. Isi tarah ek dharmik-samajik sudhar andaolan ne bhi angreji hukumat ke khilaf ek rajniti sangharsh ka roop le liya. Exam point: Birsa andaolan ka uddeshya samajik buriyon ke ant se samaj ki shudhhi ke saath-saath angreji hukumat tatha uske sahayakon ko hatana bhi tha.

qe: On 2 October 1857 the insurgents had a severe engagement with British troops under which officer at Chatra, and were defeated with heavy casualties?
qh: 2 अक्टूबर 1857 को विद्रोहियों का चतरा में किस अधिकारी के नेतृत्व वाली ब्रिटिश सैना से भीषण मुकाबला हुआ, जिसमें उन्हें भारी नुकसान के साथ हार मिली?
e: Chotanagpur kshetra me vidroh ka phailav tez hone par angreji sarkar ne bhi apni taiyariyan badhayin. Doranda, Ranchi tatha Hazaribagh se nikle vidrohi sipahi Chatra ki or badh rahe the, jahan unka sangathan ek badi sena ka roop le raha tha. 2 October 1857 ko Chatra ke paas Major English ke netritva wali British sena tatha Sikh sipahiyon ke saath unka bhishan mukabla hua, jisme vidrohiyon ko bahut bhaari nuksan uthana pada tatha woh bikhar gaye. Sikh sipahiyon ko Lt. Erie command kar raha tha tatha unke saath angreji sena ki anya tukadiyan bhi thin. Is haar ke baad bhi vidroh Poori tarah khatm nahi hua; uske neta alag-alag kshetron me samay-samay par sangharsh karte rahe tatha angreji sarkar ko kai mahine tak Chotanagpur me unka peechha karna pada. Exam point: 2 October 1857 ko Chatra ke paas Major English ki British sena se hui ladai me vidrohi haare tatha unhe bhaari nuksan hua; Sikh sipahiyon ki command Lt. Erie ke paas thi.

qe: In the baggage left behind by the insurgents of Palamau, British officers discovered letters written to Lilambar, Pitambar and Naldaut Nanji, and correspondence from which leader promising help?
qh: पलामू के विद्रोहियों द्वारा छोड़े गए सामान में अंग्रेजी अधिकारियों को लीलांबर, पीतांबर तथा नलदउत ननजी के नाम पत्र मिले, तथा सहायता का वादा करने वाले किस नेता का पत्राचार भी मिला?
e: Captain Dalton ke abhiyan me vidrohi apne morche chhod kar bhaag gaye the, lekin apna bahut saara saaman woh peeche chhod gaye. Is saaman ki talashi lene par angreji adhikariyon ko kuchh aham kagaz mile, jinme Lilambar, Pitambar tatha Naldaut Nanji ke naam likhe gaye patra shamil the. In patraon me Bihar ke anya hisson se bhi sampark ka pata chalta tha; sabse mahatvapurna baat yah thi ki unhe Amar Singh ka likha patra bhi mila, jisme unse jaldi sahayata bhejne ka vaada kiya gaya tha. Amar Singh Kunwar Singh ke bhai the tatha unke netritva me Bhojpur kshetra me vidroh chalta raha. Is tarah ke patraaon se saaf hota hai ki Bihar ke alag-alag kshetron ke vidrohi aapas me sampark banaye hue the tatha milkar ladne ki yojana banate the, chahe unke kshetra ek doosre se door the. Exam point: Palamau ke vidrohiyon ke chhode saaman me Lilambar, Pitambar tatha Naldaut Nanji ke naam patra tatha Amar Singh ka sahayata ka vaada karne wala patra mila, jisse saajha yojana ka pata chala.

qe: In the first Birsa movement of 1895, what punishment in default of payment of fine was awarded to Birsa along with rigorous imprisonment?
qh: 1895 के पहले बिरसा आंदोलन में, बिरसा को कठोर कारावास के साथ-साथ जुर्माना न देने पर कौन-सी सज़ा दी गई थी?
oe: An additional six months of rigorous imprisonment
An additional two years of transportation
An additional fine of five hundred rupees
An additional year of simple imprisonment
oh: छह महीने का अतिरिक्त कठोर कारावास
पाँच सौ रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना
एक वर्ष का अतिरिक्त साधारण कारावास
e: Birsa ke netritva me pehla bada aandolan 1895 me hua. Is saal August ki kisi raat me, jab Birsa tatha uske kuch anuyayi so rahe the, unhe chupke se giraftar kar liya gaya. Un sabhi logon ko do-do saal ke kathor yaani rigorous kaaravas ki saza di gayi, aur Birsa par pachaas rupaye ka jurmana bhi lagaya gaya; jurmana na dene par use chhah mahine ka atirikt kathor kaaravas bhugtna pada. Kathor kaaravas me kaidi ko mushkil kaam karne padte the, jabki sadharan kaaravas me aise kaam nahi hote the. Us samay Ranchi ke Deputy Commissioner ne khushi jatayi thi ki yah andaolan poori tarah dab gaya, lekin unka yah anuman galat sabit hua; jail se riha hone ke baad Birsa ne apne andaolan ko aur bhi tez kar diya. Exam point: 1895 me Birsa tatha uske anuyayiyon ko do saal ke kathor kaaravas ki saza mili tatha Birsa par pachaas rupaye ka jurmana laga, jise na dene par chhah mahine ka atirikt kathor kaaravas bhugtna pada.

qe: Which Jamadar of the Ramgarh Battalion evaded capture throughout the disturbances, though the Company's Government put a reward of one thousand rupees on his head?
qh: रामगढ़ बटालियन का कौन-सा जमादार इन उपद्रवों के दौरान पकड़ा नहीं जा सका, हालाँकि कंपनी सरकार ने उसके सिर पर एक हज़ार रुपये का इनाम रखा था?
e: Ramgarh Battalion ke sainikon ne Hazaribagh tatha Ranchi me vidroh ka netritva kiya tatha unme se kuch adhikari angreji sarkar ke haath na aaye. Jamadar Madhab Singh Ramgarh Infantry ki do companies ke saath vidroh kar ke Ranchi ki or badha tha tatha poore upadrav ke dauran woh angreji sarkar ke haath nahi aaya; uski giraftari ke liye Company sarkar ne ek hazaar rupaye ka inam tak rakh diya. Iske vipreet Ramgarh Battalion ke do anya adhikari, Subedar Jai Mangal Pande tatha Nadir Ali Khan, 3 October ko Major Simpson ke saamne pesh kiye gaye; un par 1857 ke Act XVII ke tahat mukadma chalaya gaya tatha dono ko maut ki saza sunayi gayi. In giraftariyon ke baad bhi vidroh Chotanagpur tatha Singhbhum me kuchh samay tak chalta raha. Exam point: Jamadar Madhab Singh vidroh ke dauran pakda nahi ja saka, chahe uske sir par ek hazaar rupaye ka inam tha; Ramgarh Battalion ke Subedar Jai Mangal Pande tatha Nadir Ali Khan 3 October 1857 ko pakad liye gaye tatha unhe maut ki saza mili.

qe: For a crusade of this kind Birsa organised a fighting force trained in the use of the bow and arrow and the sword; who was placed in charge of this training as Minister and Commander-in-Chief?
qh: इस प्रकार के संग्राम के लिए बिरसा ने धनुष-बाण तथा तलवार के प्रयोग में प्रशिक्षित लड़ाकू दल खड़ा किया; उस प्रशिक्षण का भार मंत्री तथा सेनापति के रूप में किसे सौंपा गया?
e: Birsa ne samjha ki is tarah ke sangram ke liye ek sashastra sena ki zaroorat hai, jisme logon ko dhanush-baan tatha talwar chalane ki acchi training di jaye. Isi kaam ke liye usne apne najdiki saathi tatha pramukh salahkar Gaya Munda ko senapati banaya. Birsa ka sapna ek nayi samajik vyavastha ka tha, jisme aadivasi logon ko unki zameen tatha samman wapas mile. Yah thik hai ki Birsa ne dhanush-baan ka istemal karne wali ek sena banayi. Us samay Birsa ke saath kiye gaye kai anya sahayak the, jaise Demka Munda, Panau Munda, Sundat Munda tatha Tripru Munda, jinhe mahatvapurna zimmedariyan di gayi thi. Dhyan rakhne wali baat yah hai ki Birsa ki sena ne talwar tatha dhanush-baan se ladne ki training li thi, lekin angrejon ke paas astra-shastra bahut aadhunik the. Exam point: Birsa ne dhanush-baan tatha talwar ke prashikshan wali sena banayi tatha uske pramukh salahkar Gaya Munda ko senapati banaya; anya sahayak the Demka Munda, Panau Munda tatha Sundat Munda.

qe: Subedars Jai Mangal Pande and Nadir Ali Khan of the Ramgarh Battalion were captured and tried under the provisions of which Act of 1857?
qh: रामगढ़ बटालियन के सूबेदार जयमंगल पांडे तथा नादिर अली खान पकड़े गए थे तथा उन पर 1857 के किस अधिनियम के प्रावधानों के अंतर्गत मुकदमा चलाया गया?
e: 1857 ke vidroh ko dabaane ke liye angreji sarkar ne kuchh vishesh kanoon bhi banaye, jinme unhe vidrohiyon par jaldi mukadma chalane tatha sakht saza dene ki shakti mili. Ramgarh Battalion ke do Subedar, Jai Mangal Pande tatha Nadir Ali Khan, vidroh ka netritva karne ke aarop me 3 October 1857 ko Major Simpson ke saamne pesh kiye gaye. Subedar yaani us samay ki deshi paidal sena me ek adhikari, jo ek company ke barabar ke sainikon ki command karta tha. Dono par 1857 ke Act XVII ke prabandhon ke tahat mukadma chalaya gaya tatha unhe maut ki saza sunayi gayi. Isi tarah vidroh ke dauran pakde gaye kai netaon tatha sipahiyon par alag-alag adalaton me mukadme chalaye gaye tatha unhe desh-nikale ya maut ki saza di gayi. Exam point: Ramgarh Battalion ke Subedar Jai Mangal Pande tatha Nadir Ali Khan par 1857 ke Act XVII ke tahat mukadma chal kar dono ko maut ki saza di gayi.

qe: Which place near Ranchi became the headquarters of the revolutionary force organised by Birsa, while training centres were started at Ranchi, Chakradharpur, Bandu and Tamar?
qh: बिरसा द्वारा खड़ी की गई क्रांतिकारी सेना का मुख्यालय रांची के पास किस स्थान पर बना, जबकि प्रशिक्षण केंद्र रांची, चक्रधरपुर, बांदू तथा तमाड़ में खोले गए?
e: Birsa ne apne andaolan ko ek sashastra roop dene ke liye ek niyamit sena banayi tatha uske liye prashikshan kendra khole. Ranchi ke paas Khunti is sena ka mukhyaalay bana, jabki Ranchi, Chakradharpur, Bandu, Tamar, Karra, Toipa, Basia tatha Sisai jaise sthalon par prashikshan kendra khole gaye. In kendraon me logon ko dhanush-baan tatha talwar chalane ki training di jaati thi tatha sena ke liye logon ko ikattha kiya jata tha. February 1898 se 24 December 1899 tak Birsa tatha uske updeshak saathi alag-alag sunsaan jagahon par raat ki baithkein karte tatha aage ki yojana banate the, jisse unka sangathan mazboot hota gaya. Isi tarah ek dharmik-samajik andaolan ne ek vyavasthit sena tatha prashikshan-kendraon ka roop le liya. Exam point: Birsa ki sena ka mukhyaalay Ranchi ke paas Khunti me bana tatha Ranchi, Chakradharpur, Bandu, Tamar jaise sthalon par training kendra khole gaye.

qe: Which two leading supporters of the rebels in the Chotanagpur area were captured at Kakraj in Lohardaga in March 1858 and hanged at Ranchi?
qh: छोटानागपुर क्षेत्र में विद्रोहियों के किन दो प्रमुख समर्थकों को मार्च 1858 में लोहरदगा के ककराज में पकड़ कर रांची में फाँसी दी गई?
oe: Tikait Unao Rao Singh and his diwan Shaikh Bikari
Thatur Biswanath Sahi of Barkargarh and Pandey Ganpat Rai of Bhownro
Raja Arjun Singh of Porhat and his brother
Pitambar Sahi and Lilambar Sahi of the Bhogta clan
oh: टिकैत उनाओ राव सिंह तथा उनके दीवान शेख बिकारी
बरकारगढ़ के ठाकुर विश्वनाथ साही तथा भौंरो के पांडेय गणपत राय
पोरहाट के राजा अर्जुन सिंह तथा उनके भाई
भोगता कुल के पीतांबर साही तथा लीलांबर साही
e: Chotanagpur tatha aas-paas ke kshetron me vidroh ko dabane ke liye angreji sarkar ne sakht kadam uthaye tatha vidrohiyon ke sahayakon ko pakadne ke liye kai muhim chalayin. Barkargarh ke Thatur Biswanath Sahi tatha Bhownro ke Pandey Ganpat Rai vidrohi sainikon ke pramukh samarthakon me the; unhone angreji sarkar ke khilaf morche banane me aham bhoomika nibhai thi. Kai gaon ke log inhe chhupaate the, isliye sarkar kuchh samay tak unhe nahi pakad payi. March 1858 me Lohardaga ke Kakraj naam ke sthal par Major Nation, jo aathvin Bengal Police Battalion ke Commandant the, ne unhe giraftar kar liya. Iske baad unhe Ranchi le jaaya gaya, jahan Commissioner ke compound ke uttar wale pedon par 16 tatha 21 April ko alag-alag din unhe phansi di gayi. Exam point: Barkargarh ke Biswanath Sahi tatha Bhownro ke Ganpat Rai ko March 1858 me Lohardaga ke Kakraj me pakda gaya tatha April 1858 me Ranchi me phansi di gayi.

qe: Birsa was captured on 3 February 1900 near which village, about two miles west of it, by pro-British watchmen who were paid a reward of Rs 500?
qh: बिरसा को 3 फरवरी 1900 को किस गाँव के पास, उससे लगभग दो मील पश्चिम में, सरकार-समर्थक चौकीदारों ने पकड़ लिया, जिन्हें पाँच सौ रुपये का इनाम मिला?
e: Angreji sarkar ne Birsa tatha uske saathiyon ko pakadne ke liye bahut prayas kiye, lekin unhe safalta nahi mili. Ant me kshetra ke kuch gaon ke sarkar-samarthak chaukidaron ne Birsa ka pata lagaya. Birsa apni patni tatha ek anya stri ke saath Sankra gaon se lagbhag do mile pashchim me jungle me the; jab teenon ek ped ke neeche aaram kar rahe the, tab chaukidaron ne chupke se jakar unhe pakad liya. Yah 3 February 1900 ki ghatna hai. Birsa ko giraftar karke sipahi police ki nigrani me Ranchi bheja gaya tatha wahan jail me rakha gaya, jabki uski patni ko Ranchi jane ki anumati nahi di gayi. Ranchi jail me kuchh hi mahine baad unhe pet ki bimari yaani cholera hua, jisse 1900 me hi unka dehant ho gaya. Exam point: Birsa 3 February 1900 ko Sankra gaon ke pashchim wale jungle se pakde gaye; pakadne wale chaukidaron ko paanch sau rupaye ka inam mila tatha Birsa ko Ranchi jail me rakha gaya.

qe: Raja Arjun Singh of which place, along with his brother, led a formidable rising of the Kols of Singhbhum during the disturbances of 1857-59?
qh: 1857-59 के उपद्रवों के दौरान किस स्थान के राजा अर्जुन सिंह ने अपने भाई के साथ सिंहभूम के कोलों का भयंकर विद्रोह खड़ा किया?
e: Singhbhum kshetra me Company sarkar ke khilaf asantosh purane samay se chali aa rahi thi tatha 1857 ke upadravon ne usse aur bhadka diya. Porhat ke raja Arjun Singh tatha unke bhai ke netritva me Kol logon ne angreji sarkar ke khilaf ek bhishan vidroh khada kiya. January 1858 ke madhya me unhone Company ki sena ko buri tarah haraya, jisme angreji sena ke lagbhag ek sau pachaas sipahi maidan me hi mare gaye. Iske baad Colonel Foster, jo Raniganj se Chaibasa pahunche the, ne Chakradharpur par vidrohiyon ko peeche dhakel diya tatha raaste me kai gaon jala diye. 1859 me Chaibasa ke Sheristadar Mewa Lal ki sahayata se Porhat ke raja ko giraftar kar liya gaya; uski jageerein zabt kar li gayi tatha unhe Banaras me rajya-bandi ke roop me rakha gaya, jahan unhe mahine ka char sau rupaye pension milta tha. Exam point: Porhat ke raja Arjun Singh tatha unke bhai ne Singhbhum me Kol vidroh ka netritva kiya tatha January 1858 me Company ki sena ko hara kar 150 sipahi maare; 1859 me unhe giraftar karke Banaras bheja gaya.

qe: After the capture of Birsa, eighty-seven of his followers were committed to session; what did the sessions court award to two of them?
qh: बिरसा की गिरफ्तारी के बाद उसके सत्तासी अनुयायियों को सेशन न्यायालय के सामने भेजा गया; सेशन न्यायालय ने उनमें से दो को कौन-सी सज़ा दी?
oe: A heavy fine with simple imprisonment
e: Birsa ki giraftari ke baad angreji sarkar ne uske bahut se saathiyon ko pakad liya. Ranchi tatha Singhbhum kshetra me unke mukadmon ki sunwai ke liye alag-alag adhikari niyukta kiye gaye. In mukadmon me Birsa ke sattasi anuyayiyon ko session yaani ghaur adalat me bheja gaya; inme se do ko mrityudand diya gaya tatha shesh ko alag-alag avadhi ke desh-nikale ya kaaravas ki saza di gayi. Kuchh kaidiyon ne appeal ki, jiske phal-swaroop kuch log riha ho gaye tatha kuch ki saza kam kar di gayi. Isi aadhaar par kai manki yaani vibhagiya mukhiyaon ko unki mankiship yaani mukhiyagiri se v1nchit kar diya gaya, jisse aadivasi samaj ki purani modi-shakti par chot pahunchi. Exam point: Birsa ke sattasi anuyayiyon ko session me bheja gaya, jinme se do ko mrityudand mila tatha shesh ko desh-nikale ya kaaravas ki saza; kuchh kaidi appeal par riha ho gaye.

qe: Which family of Patna, noted for its learning and piety, controlled the Wahabi movement's centre at Patna, prominent among its members being Maulvis Wilayat Ali, Inayat Ali, Shah Muhammad Husain and Abdullah?
qh: पटना का कौन-सा परिवार, जो अपनी विद्वत्ता तथा धार्मिकता के लिए प्रसिद्ध था, पटना स्थित वहाबी आंदोलन केंद्र का नियंत्रण करता था, जिसके प्रमुख सदस्यों में मौलवी विलायत अली, इनायत अली, शाह मुहम्मद हुसैन तथा अब्दुल्ला थे?
e: Wahabi aandolan Bharat me Abdu l Wahab of Najd ki shikshaon par chala; yah ek dharmik aandolan tha, lekin isme angreji hukumat ko hatane ka rajniti maksad bhi shamil tha. Patna me is andaolan ka ek mahatvapurna kendra 1828 se 1868 tak, yaani chalis saal tak, chalta raha. Is kendra ko Patna ke ek sampann tatha padhe-likhe Muhammadan parivar ke log chalate the, jinhe Sadikpore parivar ke naam se jana jata hai. Is parivar ke pramukh log the Maulvi Wilayat Ali, Inayat Ali, Shah Muhammad Husain tatha Abdullah, jinme se har ek ne aandolan me bada yogdan diya. Wilayat Ali apne chhote bhai Inayat Ali se rajniti samajh tatha anubhav me aage the, jabki Inayat Ali bahut joshila tatha utsahi the. Isi parivar ke prayason se Patna ka kendra Bengal tatha anya kshetron ke Wahabiyon ko dhan tatha naye logon ki sahayata deta raha. Exam point: Patna ka Wahabi kendra 1828 se 1868 tak Sadikpore parivar ke niyantran me raha, jiske pramukh log Wilayat Ali, Inayat Ali, Shah Muhammad Husain tatha Abdullah the.

qe: Inayat Ali took over the command of the Wahabi forces at Sittana; after his death in 1869, who of Surajgarh in Monghyr took charge of that colony?
qh: इनायत अली ने सिताना में वहाबी सैनिकों की कमान संभाली; 1869 में उनके देहांत के बाद मुंगेर के सूरजगढ़ से किसने उस बस्ती का प्रभार लिया?
e: Patna ke Sadikpore parivar ke log Wahabi aandolan ke kendra tatha Sittana ki basti, donon ko chalate the. Sittana yaani us samay ke uttar-pashchim seemant kshetra ki ek basti, jahan Wahabiyon ki sena tatha apna alag prabandh tha. Wilayat Ali ke dehant ke baad Inayat Ali phir se andaolan ka neta ban gaya tatha usne Sittana me Wahabi sena ki command sambhali. 1869 me Inayat Ali ka bhi dehant ho gaya; uske baad Monghyr ke Surajgarh se aaye M. Maqsud Ali ne Sittana ki us basti ka prabandh sambhala. Maqsud Ali ke dehant ke baad Wilayat Ali ke putra M. Abdullah ne netritva sambhala tatha Bihar aur Bengal se naye log tatha dhan Sittana pahunchne lage. Is tarah Patna ka kendra sadi ke aakhir tak Bengal tatha seemant kshetra ke Wahabiyon ke beech ek pul ka kaam karta raha. Exam point: Inayat Ali ke 1869 ke dehant ke baad Monghyr ke Surajgarh ke M. Maqsud Ali ne Sittana ki Wahabi basti ka prabandh sambhala, tatha unke baad M. Abdullah netritva me aaye.

qe: At a meeting held in 1908 under the presidentship of which Nawab was a Bihar Provincial Congress Committee formed with its headquarters at Patna?
qh: 1908 में किस नवाब की अध्यक्षता में हुई बैठक में बिहार प्रांतीय कांग्रेस कमेटी बनी, जिसका मुख्यालय पटना में था?
e: Unnisvin sadi ke ant me Bihar me Congress ke prati utsah ghatne laga tha, isliye prant ke kuch jaagruk tatha udar netaon ne ise phir se sakriya karne ke liye prayas shuru kiye. Isi kram me 1908 me ek baithak hui, jiski adhyakshta Nawab Sarfraz Husain Khan ne ki. Is baithak me Bihar Provincial Congress Committee ka gathan hua, jiska mukhyaalay Patna me rakha gaya tatha zilon me iski shakhayein banayi gayin. Province yaani prant-stariya Congress committee ka gathan hona is baat ka pramaan tha ki Bihar ab rashtriya rajniti me apni alag pehchan tatha apna sangathan bana raha tha. Isi committee ne aage chalkar Bihar me rajnitik sammelan tatha anya karyakram aayojit kiye, jisse yahan ke log rashtriya aandolan se jude. Exam point: 1908 ki baithak me Nawab Sarfraz Husain Khan ki adhyakshta me Bihar Provincial Congress Committee bani, jiska mukhyaalay Patna me tha tatha jilon me iski shakhayein thin.

qe: At a meeting held at Bankipore on 16 December 1916 it was decided to start a Home Rule League, and who was elected its President?
qh: 16 दिसंबर 1916 को बांकीपुर में हुई बैठक में होम रूल लीग शुरू करने का निर्णय हुआ, जिसके अध्यक्ष किसे चुना गया?
e: Bharat me jab Home Rule aandolan yaani swaraj ke liye aise aandolan ki lehar uthi, to uska asar Bihar me bhi dikha. 16 December 1916 ko Bankipore me ek baithak hui, jisme yah tay kiya gaya ki yahan bhi ek Home Rule League shuru ki jayegi. Is baithak me league ke liye padadhikari chune gaye; adhyaksh bane Mazhar-ul-Haque, upadhyaksh bane Sarfraz Husain Khan tatha Purnendu Narain Sinha, tatha mantri bane Chandrabansi Sahay tatha Baljnath Narain Singh. Mazhar-ul-Haque ne is avsar par ek prerna-dayak bhashan diya, jisme unhone league ke gathan ki zaroorat par zor diya. Home Rule League ka maksad tha deshi logon ko apne shasan ke adhikaron ke liye taiyari karna tatha unme rajnitik chetna jagana. Exam point: 16 December 1916 ki Bankipore baithak me Home Rule League banane ka nirnay hua tatha Mazhar-ul-Haque iske adhyaksh chune gaye.

qe: The bomb thrown at Muzaffarpur on 30 April 1908, which killed two European ladies, was in fact meant for which officer?
qh: 30 अप्रैल 1908 को मुजफ्फरपुर में फेंका गया बम, जिससे दो यूरोपीय महिलाओं की मृत्यु हुई, वास्तव में किस अधिकारी के लिए था?
oe: The Superintendent of Police of Muzaffarpur
Mr Kingsford, then district Judge of Muzaffarpur
Mr Pringle Kennedy, a leading pleader
oh: तत्कालीन मुजफ्फरपुर के जिला जज मिस्टर किंग्सफोर्ड
e: Bharat me krantikari rashtravad ki lehar ka asar Bihar par bhi pada. Bengal ke krantikari netaon ne anglesi hukumat ke khilaf gupt tatha hinsak sadhanon se sangharsh ka rasta chuna, tatha inke prayason ne Bihar ke yuvakon ko bhi prabhavit kiya. 30 April 1908 ko Muzaffarpur me ek bomb phenka gaya. Yah bomb asal me Mr Kingsford ke liye tha, jo us samay Muzaffarpur ke district Judge the tatha isse pehle Calcutta ke Presidency Magistrate ke roop me rajnitik karyakartaon ko bahut bhaari sazaein suna kar bahut badnaam ho gaye the. Lekin bomb ka nishana chook gaya tatha usse Mr Pringle Kennedy ki patni tatha putri, do European mahilaon ki mrutyu ho gayi; Kennedy Muzaffarpur Bar ke ek pramukh vakil the. Is ghatna ne poore desh me halchal macha di tatha krantikari aandolan ke prati logon ka dhyaan khincha. Exam point: Muzaffarpur me 30 April 1908 ko phenka gaya bomb asal me district Judge Mr Kingsford ke liye tha, lekin galti se Pringle Kennedy ki patni tatha putri ki mrutyu ho gayi.

qe: European indigo planters in north Bihar carried on cultivation under two systems; which one placed the cultivation under their direct management with ill-paid tenant-labourers?
qh: उत्तर बिहार में यूरोपीय नील-कारखानेदार दो पद्धतियों से खेती करते थे; किस पद्धति में खेती उनके सीधे प्रबंधन में अल्प-वेतन पट्टेदार मज़दूरों के ज़रिये होती थी?
e: Champaran me angreji neel-kaarhane dar yaani indigo planters ki kheti do badi paddhatiyon me chalti thi. Pehli paddhati Zerait thi, jisme kheti ka poora prabandh sakitdaroni ke apne haath me hota tha tatha woh tenant-labourers yaani pattedar mazdooron se kaam karwate the; in mazdooron ko bahut kam paisa milta tha, isliye woh hamesha asantusht rehte the. Doosri paddhati Assamiwar thi, jisme factory ke mukhiya asami yaani kisanon se neel ki kheti karwate the; asami us kisan ko kehte the, jo kisi zameen par kheti karne ka haq rakhta ho. Assamiwar paddhati ke andar hi tinkathia jaisa tarika sabse zyada prachalit tha, jabki Khushki tatha Kurtauli naam ke anya tarike bhi the. In tarikon me kheti ke bol ka poora bojh kisanon par dala jata tha tatha unke hit ki koi parvah nahi hoti thi. Exam point: Zerait paddhati me kheti planters ke seedhe prabandh me alpa-vetan pattedar mazdooron ke zariye hoti thi, jabki Assamiwar paddhati me asami kisanon se neel ki kheti karwayi jaati thi.

qe: The Indian National Congress held its twenty-seventh session at Patna in 1912 with which leader as its President?
qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस ने सन 1912 में अपना सत्ताईसवाँ अधिवेशन पटना में किया, जिसके अध्यक्ष कौन थे?
e: 1912 ka saal Bihar ke itihas me do kaaranon se yaadgar hai. Pehla, is saal lokon ki uchit maangon ke jawab me Bengal se alag kar ke Bihar ka ek alag prant banaya gaya. Doosra, isi saal Indian National Congress ka sattaiswa adhiveshan pehli baar Bihar ki dharti par hua, jo apni purani gauravmayi paramparaon ke liye pavitra maani jaati hai. Is adhiveshan ke adhyaksh the R. N. Mudholkar; adhiveshan ka aayojan Bihar ke netaon ne poore man se kiya, jisme Mazhar-ul-Haque tatha Sachchidanand Sinha jaise log aage the. Congress ke safal adhiveshan ne Bihar ke rajnitik jeevan ko nayi urja di tatha aage ke varshon me yahan ke netaon ne rashtriya aandolan ke alag-alag charnon me bhaag liya. Exam point: 1912 me Congress ka sattaiswa adhiveshan Patna me hua, jiske adhyaksh R. N. Mudholkar the; isi saal Bihar ek alag prant bana.

qe: Who were elected the Secretaries of the Home Rule League started at Bankipore in December 1916, along with a Vice-President and three other office-bearers?
qh: दिसंबर 1916 में बांकीपुर में शुरू हुई होम रूल लीग के सचिव कौन चुने गए, जबकि एक उपाध्यक्ष तथा तीन अन्य पदाधिकारी भी चुने गए थे?
oe: Chandrabansi Sahay and Baljnath Narain Singh
Hasan Imam and Purnendu Narain Sinha
oh: चंद्रबंसी सहाय तथा बलजनाथ नारायण सिंह
हसन इमाम तथा पूर्णेंदु नारायण सिन्हा
e: Bankipore me 16 December 1916 ko hue Home Rule League ke gathan me padadhikariyon ka chunav hua. League ke adhyaksh Mazhar-ul-Haque, upadhyaksh Sarfraz Husain Khan tatha Purnendu Narain Sinha, tatha mantri Chandrabansi Sahay tatha Baljnath Narain Singh chune gaye. Is tarah league ke pramukh padon par Bihar ke alag-alag kshetron tatha samudayon ke pramukh neta aaye, jisse sangathan ko vyapak samarthan mila. Adhyaksh ne apne bhashan me kaha ki swaraj ki taiyari ke liye aise sangathan ki zaroorat hai, jahan log apne rajnitik adhikaron ke baare me soch-samajh sakein. Aage Patna me February 1918 ki baithak me league ke kaam ko gaon-gaon tak pahunchane ka nirnay liya gaya tatha iske liye chanda ikattha karne ka karyakram bana. Exam point: Bankipore ki Home Rule League ke mantri Chandrabansi Sahay tatha Baljnath Narain Singh chune gaye, jabki adhyaksh Mazhar-ul-Haque tatha upadhyaksh Sarfraz Husain Khan tatha Purnendu Narain Sinha the.

qe: For the Muzaffarpur bomb outrage of 1908, which Bengali youth of seventeen was arrested and hanged on 11 August 1908?
qh: 1908 की मुजफ्फरपुर बम घटना में किस सत्रह वर्षीय बंगाली युवक को गिरफ्तार कर 11 अगस्त 1908 को फाँसी दी गई?
e: Muzaffarpur me 30 April 1908 ko hue bomb hamle ke baad angreji sarkar ne is ghatna me shamil krantikariyon ko pakadne ke liye kadi karwai ki. Is mumale me Khudiram naam ke ek Bangali yuva ko giraftar kiya gaya, jiski umar keval satrah saal thi; use 11 August 1908 ko phansi di gayi. Uske saathi Prafulla Chaki ne giraftari se bachne ke liye khud ko goli maar li. In dono ne Bengal ke us krantikari dal ke saath kaam kiya tha, jiski aguvai Barindra Kumar Ghosh tatha Bhupendra Nath Datta kar rahe the tatha jiske mukhpatra 'Yugantar' tatha 'Sandhya' jaise akhbaar the. Aise balidan ne us samay ke yuvaon ke man me andolan ke liye sahas tatha prerna bhari. Exam point: Muzaffarpur bomb mumale me satrah saal ke Khudiram ko 11 August 1908 ko phansi di gayi, jabki uske saathi Prafulla Chaki ne khud ko goli maar li.

qe: The most prevalent method under the Assamiwar system in Champaran, under which a tenant had to cultivate indigo on three kathas per bigha, was which one?
qh: चंपारण में असामीवार पद्धति के अंतर्गत सबसे प्रचलित तरीका कौन-सा था, जिसमें किसान को प्रति बीघा तीन कठ्ठा पर नील उगाना पड़ता था?
e: Champaran me Assamiwar paddhati ke tahat neel ki kheti karane ka sabse prachlit tarika tinkathia tha. Tinkathia ka arth hai teen kaththa, yaani kisan ko apni jot ke har bigha zameen ke teen kaththa hisse par neel ugana padta tha. Satta yaani likhit samjhauton ke mutabik kisan ko neel ka daam milna chahiye tha, lekin asal me ye samjhauta planters ke sabse zyada fayde ke liye banaye jate the tatha kisan ko bahut hi kam daam milta tha. Khet bigha ki jagah katha me tola jata tha, isliye teen kaththa ka hissa kisan ki jameen ka ek bada bhag hota tha, jispar woh apni roti ki fasalein nahi uga sakta tha. Yahi tinkathia vyavastha Champaran ke kisanon ke dukh ka sabse bada kaaran thi tatha isi ke khilaf 1917 ka satyagrah hua. Exam point: Assamiwar ka sabse prachalit tarika tinkathia tha, jisme kisan ko har bigha ke teen kaththa hisse par neel ugana padta tha; satta naam ke likhit samjhauton me kisan ko daam milna tay tha, par milta bahut kam tha.

qe: For the 1912 Patna session of the Congress, who was the Chairman of the Reception Committee and who was the General Secretary?
qh: कांग्रेस के 1912 के पटना अधिवेशन में स्वागत समिति के अध्यक्ष तथा महामंत्री क्रमशः कौन थे?
oe: Sir Ali Imam and R. N. Mudholkar
Sarfraz Husain Khan and Hasan Imam
Purnendu Narain Sinha and Chandrabansi Sahay
oh: सर अली इमाम तथा आर. एन. मुधोलकर
सरफ़राज़ हुसैन खान तथा हसन इमाम
पूर्णेंदु नारायण सिन्हा तथा चंद्रबंसी सहाय
e: 1912 me Congress ka sattaiswa adhiveshan Patna me hua, jo Bihar ke rajnitik jeevan ki ek badi ghatna thi. Is adhiveshan ke aayojan me sabse aage khade do logon ka naama mahatvapurna hai. Reception Committee yaani swagat samiti ke adhyaksh the Mazhar-ul-Haque, jo us samay Bihar ke sabse lokapriya tatha mane hue netaon me se ek the tatha jinhone hindu-muslim, dono samudayon ke logon ko saath le kar chalne ka sandesh diya. Adhiveshan ke General Secretary yaani mahamantri the Sachchidanand Sinha, jo Bihar ke ek bahut vidwan tatha sammanit vakil tatha rajnitik neta the. In dono ke alawa anek anya netaon ne bhi adhiveshan ko safal banane me yogdan diya tatha Bihar ke logon ne bahut utsah ke saath is adhiveshan me bhaag liya. Exam point: 1912 ke Patna adhiveshan me swagat samiti ke adhyaksh Mazhar-ul-Haque tatha mahamantri Sachchidanand Sinha the.

qe: When Annie Besant came to Patna in 1918 she was escorted from the station in a triumphal procession with arati, or waving of lights, on the way to whose residence?
qh: 1918 में एनी बेसेंट पटना आईं तो उन्हें स्टेशन से जुलूस के साथ आरती सहित किसके निवास तक ले जाया गया?
e: Home Rule League ka sandesh poore desh me pahunchane ke liye uske netaon ne alag-alag sthalon ki yatrayein ki. Annie Besant, jo Home Rule aandolan ki ek pramukh neta thi, Patna 18 April 1918 ko aayi. Unhe railway station se ek vijay-julus ke saath shahar me le jaaya gaya, jisme unka swagat arati yaani deepak ghumakar kiya gaya; yah julus Purnendu Narain Sinha ke nivas tak pahuncha. Isi tarah ke swagat dikhate hain ki us samay Home Rule ki baat Bihar ke padhe-likhe varg tatha shahar ke logon me kitni lokapriya ho gayi thi. Iske baad 25 July 1918 ko Mrs Besant ne Patna ki ek chhoti yatra ki, jisme unhone yahan ke Home Rulers ke vichar rajnitik sudharon ke baare me jaane; is mulaqat me Hasan Imam tatha Sachchidanand Sinha jaise logon se bhi baat hui. Exam point: 18 April 1918 ko Patna aayi Annie Besant ka julus arati ke saath Purnendu Narain Sinha ke nivas tak gaya; 25 July 1918 ki unki chhoti yatra me rajnitik sudharon par vichar-vimarsh hua.

qe: Sakharam Ganesh Deuskar of Karun, in the Deoghar subdivision of the district of Santhal Parganas, was a cultural guide of which category of workers?
qh: संथाल परगनों के देवघर अनुमंडल में करुन के सखाराम गणेश देवस्कर किस श्रेणी के कार्यकर्ताओं के सांस्कृतिक पथ-प्रदर्शक थे?
e: Bihar ke kai sthal krantikari gatividhiyon ke kendra ban gaye the. Deoghar bhi aisa hi ek kendra tha, jahan 'Sil' ki lodge ka istemal bomb banane tatha saathiyon ko prashikshan dene ke liye kiya jata tha. Santhal Parganas jile ke Deoghar anumandal me Karun naam ke sthal ke Sakharam Ganesh Deuskar khud ek utsahi rashtrabhakt karyakarta the tatha woh is shreni ke karyakartaon ke saanskrutik path-pradarshak maane jate the; yaani woh unhe vicharon tatha sanskriti ke madhyam se prerit karte the. Indunath Nandy tatha kuchh anya log magic lantern yaani projector ki sahayata se Bihar ke alag-alag gaon me is krantikari vichardhara ka prachar karte the. Ranchi bhi aisa hi ek kendra tha, tatha Patna tatha anya sthalon par Anushilan Samitis shuru ki gayi. Exam point: Deoghar anumandal ke Karun ke Sakharam Ganesh Deuskar krantikari karyakartaon ke saanskrutik path-pradarshak the; Deoghar me Sil ki lodge bombs banane ke kaam aati thi.

qe: Which method of indigo cultivation in Champaran was highly prejudicial to the ryots, under it a ryot mortgaged his entire holding, including the site of his house, for a long period?
qh: चंपारण में नील की खेती का कौन-सा तरीका रैयतों के लिए अत्यंत हानिकारक था, जिसमें रैयत अपने मकान की जगह सहित पूरी जोत लंबे समय के लिए बंधक रख देता था?
e: Champaran me neel ki kheti ke kai tarike prachalit the, jinme Kurtauli tarika kisanon ke liye sabse zyada nuksandeh tha. Is tarike me kisan apni poori jot, jisme uske ghar ki jagah bhi shamil hoti thi, lambe samay ke liye bandhak yaani mortgage rakh deta tha; is bandhak ko chhudane ke liye usse karz wapas karna padega, jo aksar uski poori zindagi se bhi lamba ho jata tha. Patna ke Commissioner ne 1885 me is tarike ke baare me likha tha ki hamare beech ek aisi vyavastha khadi ho rahi hai, jisme raiyat apni poori jot, yahan tak ki apne ghar ki jagah tak girvi rakh kar apne aap ko umar bhar ki ghulami me bech raha hai. Kurtauli Champaran me bahut zyada phaila hua nahi tha, lekin jahan tha, wahan kisanon par iska asar bahut bura pada. Exam point: Kurtauli tarike me raiyat apni poori jot, ghar ki jagah sahit, lambe samay ke liye bandhak rakh deta tha; Patna ke Commissioner ne 1885 me ise raiyat ki ghulami se badhne wali vyavastha kaha.

qe: What did the meeting held at Patna on 17 February 1918 decide to do for the Home Rule League?
qh: 17 फरवरी 1918 को पटना में हुई बैठक ने होम रूल लीग के लिए क्या करने का निर्णय लिया?
oe: To send a deputation to England
To open a branch in every district of Bihar
To organise village campaigns and to collect subscriptions
oh: इंग्लैंड भेजने के लिए एक प्रतिनिधिमंडल बनाना
बिहार के हर जिले में शाखा खोलना
गाँव-गाँव अभियान चलाना तथा चंदा इकट्ठा करना
e: Home Rule League ke gathan ke baad uske netaon ne aandolan ko shahar se nikal kar gaon tak pahunchane ka karyakram banaya. Isi silsile me Patna me 17 February 1918 ko ek baithak hui, jisme do mahatvapurna nirnay liye gaye. Pehla, yah ki February 1918 ke dauran gaon-gaon me abhiyan chala kar logon me swaraj ka sandesh pahunchaya jayega; doosra, is abhiyan ke kharch ke liye chanda yaani subscription ikattha kiya jayega. Gaon-tak pahunchne ka yah tarika aage chalkar Mahatma Gandhi ke aandolanon me bhi apnaya gaya, jisme neta khud gaon ja kar kisanon tatha anya logon se milte the. Isi tarah Home Rule League ne Bihar me rajnitik jagruti ka ek vyapak aadhaar taiyar kiya, jis par aage ke bade aandolan khade hue. Exam point: Patna ki 17 February 1918 wali baithak me gaon-gaon me abhiyan chalane tatha chanda ikattha karne ka nirnay liya gaya.

qe: Some men of which place of Bihar were implicated in the Rodda Arms case, while Anushilan Samitis were started at Patna?
qh: बिहार के किस स्थान के कुछ लोग रोड्डा आर्म्स केस में शामिल पाए गए, जबकि पटना में अनुशीलन समितियाँ शुरू की गईं?
e: Krantikari rashtravad ka doosra bada kendra Bengal ka us daur ka woh sangathan tha, jiske karyakarta hathyaron tatha anya saadhanon ke liye chori ki ghatnaon me lipt hote the. Bihar me Ranchi ek aisa kendra tha, jahan sarkar ke khilaf gupt gatividhiyon ka kaam chalta tha. Santhal Parganas ke Dumka sthal ke kuch log Rodda Arms case mein shamil paaye gaye; is mumale me hathyaron ki chori tatha unke vitaran ka mamla tha tatha isne angreji sarkar ko chaukanna kar diya. Isi samay Patna tatha anya sthalon par Anushilan Samitis shuru ki gayin, jahan yuvaon ko sharirik vyayam tatha desh-prem ki shiksha di jaati thi. Swami Satya Deva bhi is daur me Bihar ki yatra kar rahe the, jinki bhashanon ko sarkar sedition ke kareeb maanti thi tatha unke andolan par nazar rakhne ke liye adhikariyon ko kaha gaya. Exam point: Dumka ke kuch log Rodda Arms case me lipt paae gaye, Patna me Anushilan Samitis shuru ki gayi tatha Swami Satya Deva ki bhashanon par sarkar ki nazar thi.

qe: At the time of the Lucknow session of the Congress in December 1916, which leader of the Champaran ryots met Mahatma Gandhi and placed their grievances before him?
qh: दिसंबर 1916 में कांग्रेस के लखनऊ अधिवेशन के समय चंपारण के रैयतों के कौन-से नेता महात्मा गांधी से मिले तथा अपनी शिकायतें उनके सामने रखीं?
e: Champaran ke kisanon ki durdasha ka pata desh bhar tak pahunchane me sabse bada role ek kisan neta ka tha. December 1916 me Congress ka adhiveshan Lucknow me hua. Isi adhiveshan ke samay Champaran ke raiyat neta Raj Kumar Shukla ne Mahatma Gandhi se mulaqat ki tatha planters ke atyachar tatha neel ki kheti ki majboori ki pooori kahani unke saamne rakhi. Isi adhiveshan me Bihar ke ek anya neta, Braj Kishore Prasad ne ek prastav rakha, jisme sarkar se maang ki gayi ki neel ke raiyaton tatha European planters ke beech bane tanav tatha krishi-sambandhi dikkaton ki jaanch ke liye adhikariyon tatha gair-sarkari logon ki ek mishrit samiti banayi jaye. Yah prastav paas ho gaya, jisse Champaran ka mudda rashtriya manch par aa gaya. Exam point: Lucknow adhiveshan ke samay Raj Kumar Shukla ne Gandhi se milkar Champaran ke raiyaton ki shikayatein rakhi, aur isi adhiveshan me Braj Kishore Prasad ka prastav paas hua, jisme mishrit samiti banane ki maang thi.

qe: Mahatma Gandhi started from Calcutta for Champaran with Raj Kumar Shukla on which date, reaching Patna the next morning?
qh: महात्मा गांधी राज कुमार शुक्ल के साथ चंपारण के लिए कलकत्ता से किस तारीख को रवाना हुए, तथा अगली सुबह पटना पहुँचे?
e: Lucknow ke adhiveshan me Raj Kumar Shukla se mulaqat ke baad Gandhi ne Champaran aane ka vaada kiya tha. Is vaade ko poora karne ke liye woh Shukla ke saath 9 April 1917 ko Calcutta se rawana hue; badi yatra ke baad woh 10 April 1917 ki subah Patna pahunche. Usi raat dono log Muzaffarpur ki or chal pade, jahan woh professor J. B. Kripalani ke ghar thehre. Yah Bihar ki dharti par Gandhi ki pehli badi prakshadvaki yatra thi; isse pehle unke South Africa ke andolan ki khyaati thi tatha Bharat me unhe us samay tak bahut kam log jaante the. Champaran kshetra me pahunchte hi unhone kisanon ke bayan likhna shuru kar diye, jo aage chalkar sarkari jaanch ka aadhaar bane. Exam point: Gandhi 9 April 1917 ko Raj Kumar Shukla ke saath Calcutta se Champaran ke liye rawana hue tatha 10 April 1917 ki subah Patna pahunche; usi raat woh Muzaffarpur gaye.

qe: When the Champaran Magistrate ordered Gandhiji not to enter the villages, he insisted on his right to see things for himself despite the order under which provision?
qh: जब चंपारण के मजिस्ट्रेट ने गांधीजी को गाँवों में प्रवेश न करने का आदेश दिया, तब उन्होंने किस धारा के आदेश के बावजूद खुद हालात देखने के अपने अधिकार पर ज़ोर दिया?
e: Champaran pahunchne ke baad Gandhi ne kisanon ke bayan likhne tatha haalat dekhne ka kaam shuru kiya, lekin angreji sarkar unhe kshetra ka kaam-kaj dekhna nahi chahti thi. Isi kaaran Champaran ke Magistrate ne unhe adesh diya ki woh gaon mein pravesh na karein; yah adesh dhaara 144 ke tahat diya gaya tha. Dhaara 144 ek aisa aadesh hai, jise koi adhikari kisi kshetra me shaanti tatha vyavastha banaye rakhne ke liye lagata hai tatha iske tahat anek logon ke ikatthe hone par rok lagayi ja sakti hai. Gandhi ne is aadesh ko maanne se inkar kar diya tatha apne adhikar par zor diya ki woh khud ja ka haalaat dekhenge. Iske phal-swaroop unke khilaf mukadma chalaya gaya, jisme unhone 18 April 1917 ko Magistrate ke saamne apna bayan diya. Exam point: Champaran ke Magistrate ne dhaara 144 ke tahat Gandhi ko gaon me pravesh karne se rokne ka adesh diya, jise unhone maanne se inkar kar diya tatha khud ja kar haalaat dekhne ke apne adhikar par zor diya.

qe: In his statement before the Magistrate of Champaran on 18 April 1917, Gandhiji said he had disregarded the order in obedience to which 'law'?
qh: 18 अप्रैल 1917 को चंपारण के मजिस्ट्रेट के सामने दिए अपने बयान में गांधीजी ने कहा कि उन्होंने किस 'कानून' के पालन में उस आदेश की अवहेलना की थी?
oe: The highest law, the voice of conscience
The law of the Congress party
The law of the British Parliament
The law laid down by the planters
oh: सर्वोच्च कानून, यानी अंतःकरण की आवाज़
e: Champaran me dhaara 144 ka aadesh todne ke kaaran Gandhi ke khilaf mukadma chalaya gaya tatha unhone 18 April 1917 ko Magistrate ke saamne apna bayan diya. Is bayan me unhone saaf kaha ki woh is bayan ko kisi saza ko halka karne ke liye nahi de rahe hain, balki yah dikhane ke liye de rahe hain ki unhonne apne upar bheje gaye aadesh ki avhelna kanoon-virodh nahi, balki hamesha ki tarah ek sabse bade kanoon ke palan me ki hai; yah hai antahkaran ki awaaz yaani hriday ki sabse gehri bhavna. Isi vichar ne unke satyagrah ke tareeke ko alag banaya, jisme unhonne khule aam kanoon todkar saza bhugt kar apna paksh rakha. Is bayan ne poore desh me logon ke man me satyagrah ke prati samman tatha vishwas badhaya. Exam point: 18 April 1917 ke apne bayan me Gandhi ne kaha ki unhone aadesh ki avhelna 'sabse bade kanoon', yaani antahkaran ki awaaz, ke palan me ki hai.

qe: On 21 April 1917, which officer sent Gandhiji a written message that the Lieutenant-Governor had ordered the case against him to be withdrawn?
qh: 21 अप्रैल 1917 को किस अधिकारी ने गांधीजी को लिखित संदेश भेजा कि लेफ्टिनेंट-गवर्नर ने उनके खिलाफ मुकदमा वापस लेने का आदेश दिया है?
oe: The Superintendent of Police of Champaran
e: 18 April 1917 ko Gandhi ke bayan ke baad sarkar ke saamne ek badi dikkat khadi ho gayi, kyunki poore desh ka dhyaan Champaran par lag chuka tha. 21 April 1917 ko Magistrate Mr Heycock ne Gandhi ko likh kar bata diya ki Lieutenant-Governor ne unke khilaf chal rahe mumale ko wapas lene ka aadesh diya. Lieutenant-Governor us samay prant ke sabse bade sarkari adhikari hote the, isliye unka yah aadesh Bihar me sarkar ke rukh me bada badlav tha. Gandhi ke liye yah ek naitik vijay tha, kyunki unhe koi saza nahi hui tatha woh bina kisi rok-tok ke kisanon ke bayan lene ka kaam jaari rakh sake. Isi tarah ahinsak pratirodh ne sarkar ko jhukne par majboor kar diya tatha Champaran ka mumala poori duniya me charchit ho gaya. Exam point: 21 April 1917 ko Magistrate Mr Heycock ne Gandhi ko bataya ki Lieutenant-Governor ne unke khilaf mumala wapas lene ka aadesh diya; Gandhi ke liye yah ek naitik vijay tha.

qe: Gandhiji met the Lieutenant-Governor, Sir Edward Gait, at Ranchi in June 1917; what was the outcome of that meeting?
qh: जून 1917 में गांधीजी रांची में लेफ्टिनेंट-गवर्नर सर एडवर्ड गेट से मिले; उस मुलाकात का क्या परिणाम निकला?
oe: The withdrawal of the tinkathia system by an executive order
The transfer of the Champaran Magistrate
The appointment of a Committee of Enquiry into the agrarian conditions of Champaran
The immediate release of all indigo ryots from jail
oh: कार्यपालिका के आदेश से तिनकठिया व्यवस्था को हटाना
चंपारण की कृषि-दशाओं की जाँच के लिए एक जाँच समिति की नियुक्ति
नील के सभी रैयतों को तुरंत जेल से छोड़ना
e: Champaran me Gandhi ke kaam ka asar badhta dekh sarkar ne unse baat karne ka nirnay liya. Lieutenant-Governor Sir Edward Gait ke aamantran par Gandhi ne unse June 1917 me Ranchi me mulaqat ki. Is mulaqat ka sabse bada parinaam yah nikla ki Champaran ki krishi-dashaon kee jaanch tatha report dene ke liye ek Committee of Enquiry niyukta ki gayi. Isi jaanch samiti ki sifarishon par aage chalkar Champaran Agrarian Bill paas hua, jisse kisanon ki purani tatha teevr dikkaton ko kam karne me madad mili. Is tarah sarkar ne khule takrav ke badle jaanch ka raasta chuna, tatha Gandhi ko kisanon ke paksh me rakhne ka mauka mila. Yah mulaqat dikhati hai ki ahinsak tatha kanooni tareeke se chalaye gaye andaolan ne bhi sarkar ko jhukne par majboor kiya. Exam point: June 1917 me Ranchi me Lieutenant-Governor Sir Edward Gait se hui mulaqat ke baad Champaran ki krishi-dashaon ki jaanch ke liye Committee of Enquiry niyukta ki gayi.

qe: Mahatma Gandhi agreed to serve on the Champaran Committee of Enquiry on the condition that he did not claim to be what?
qh: महात्मा गांधी चंपारण जाँच समिति में इस शर्त पर शामिल हुए कि वे क्या होने का दावा नहीं करेंगे?
e: Sarkar ne Champaran ki jaanch ke liye jo Committee of Enquiry banayi, usme Mahatma Gandhi ko bhi sadasya banaya gaya. Lekin Gandhi ne apni sadasya-bharti par kuchh shartein rakhi. Pehli shart yah thi ki jaanch ke dauran unhe apne saathiyon se salah-mashwara karne ki poori chhoot hogi. Doosri shart yah thi ki samiti ka sadasya hone ke naate woh kisanon ke vakil yaani advocate hone ka dava nahi karenge; yaani woh kisanon ke pratinidhi ke roop me khud ko pesh nahi karenge. Teesri shart yah thi ki yadi jaanch ka parinaam santoshjanak nahi nikla, to woh kisanon ko aage kya karna hai, is baare me salah dene tatha unka maarg-darshan karne ke liye swatantra rahenge. In shartein se saaf hota hai ki Gandhi sarkari samiti me baithte hue bhi apne naitik tatha rajnitik paksh se poora juda rahe. Exam point: Gandhi ne samiti me shamil hone par yah shart rakhi ki woh kisanon ke vakil hone ka dava nahi karenge, apne saathiyon se salah karne ki chhoot chahenge, tatha parinaam asantosh-prad hone par kisanon ko salah dene ke liye swatantra rahenge.

qe: On the recommendations of the Committee of Enquiry appointed in 1917 was passed which Bill, described as a moral victory of the ryots?
qh: 1917 में नियुक्त जाँच समिति की सिफारिशों पर कौन-सा बिल पारित हुआ, जिसे रैयतों की नैतिक विजय कहा गया?
e: Champaran ki jaanch samiti ki report ke aadhaar par ek vidheyak yaani bill taiyar hua, jise Champaran Agrarian Bill kaha jata hai. Is bill ke kanoon ban jane se us kshetra ke bahut bade samuh ke logon ke purane tatha teevr dukh-dard ko kam karne me madad mili. Isi kaaran ise kisanon ki naitik vijay kaha gaya, kyunki lakhon kisanon ki dasha sudharne ka raasta khul gaya. Champaran me Mahatma Gandhi ka tarika poori tarah safal raha; yah satyagrah ke itihas me tatha Bihar tatha Bharat ke itihas me ek landmark yaani yaadgar mod sabit hua. Yahi tarika aage chalkar poore desh ke aandolanon me apnaya gaya, jisme kanoon todkar saza bhugtne tatha ahinsa ke raaste par chalne ka siddhant shamil tha. Exam point: 1917 ki jaanch samiti ki sifarishon par Champaran Agrarian Bill paas hua, jise raiyaton ki naitik vijay kaha gaya tatha jo satyagrah ke itihas ka yaadgar mod bana.

qe: Under Mahatma Gandhi's Champaran programme, in which school, about twenty miles east of Motihari, was weaving introduced?
qh: महात्मा गांधी के चंपारण कार्यक्रम के अंतर्गत मोतिहारी से लगभग बीस मील पूर्व में स्थित किस पाठशाला में बुनाई शुरू की गई?
e: Champaran me Gandhi ke kaam ka ek bada hissa gaon ke logon ki dasha sudharne par bhi tha. Unka manna tha ki bina theek tarah ki gaon-shiksha ke koi sthayi kaam sambhav nahi hai, isliye unhonne achhe shikshkon ki talaash ki tatha swayansevakon ko aamantrit kiya. Unki appeal par Bombay, Karnatak tatha Maharashtra se anubhavi samaj-sevak Bihar aaye. Alag-alag sthalon par pathshalayein shuru ki gayin - Motihari se lagbhag bees meel purb me Barharwa gaon ki pathshala, Nepal ki tarai me Madhubani ke paas Bhithanwa, tatha anya sthalon par bhi. Barharwa ki pathshala me bunai yaani weaving ki shiksha bhi di jaati thi, jisse gaon ke log apna rozgaar sudhar saken. Madhubani ki pathshala me lagbhag sau ladke padhte the, tatha wahan ek ladkiyon ki pathshala bhi kholi gayi, jisme karib chalis ladkiyan padhti thin. Exam point: Motihari se bees meel purb me Barharwa ki pathshala me bunai shuru ki gayi; Madhubani ki pathshala me karib sau ladke tatha ladkiyon ki pathshala me karib chalis ladkiyan padhti thin.

qe: In whose memory did Mahatma Gandhi write in 1923 that he treasured the memory of the faithful co-workers of Champaran and would never have a more faithful band to work with?
qh: महात्मा गांधी ने 1923 में किसे लिखे अपने पत्र में कहा था कि वे चंपारण के निष्ठावान सहयोगियों की स्मृति संजोए हुए हैं तथा उन्हें ऐसा निष्ठावान साथी-वर्ग फिर कभी नहीं मिलेगा?
e: Champaran me Mahatma Gandhi ke saath Bihar ke kai neta tatha karyakarta poori shraddha se jude the. Isi kaaran 1923 me apne ek patra me Gandhi ne likha ki woh Champaran ke nishthavan sahayogiyon ki smriti sanjoe hue hain tatha unhe kabhi bhi isse zyada nishthavan saathi-varg ka saath nahi mila tha; unhone yah bhi kaha ki yadi unhe poore Bharat me aisa saathi-varg mil jaye, to swaraj aane me zyada samay nahi lagega. Yah patra Janakdhari Prasad ko likha gaya tha. Champaran me jinhone Gandhi ke saath kaam kiya, unme Dr Rajendra Prasad, Anugrah Narain Sinha tatha Shri Krishna Singh jaise Bihar ke mahan neta shamil the, jo aage chalkar Bihar tatha desh ki rajniti ke mukhya stambh bane. Us samay ki isi sadbhavna ne poore desh me Champaran ke satyagrah ki khyaati phailayi. Exam point: 1923 me Janakdhari Prasad ko likhe patra me Gandhi ne Champaran ke nishthavan sahayogiyon ki smriti sanjone ki baat kahi; Champaran ke Gandhi ke saathiyon me Rajendra Prasad, Anugrah Narain Sinha tatha Shri Krishna Singh jaise neta shamil the.

qe: After the Champaran Satyagraha, by what name did Bihar come to be known throughout India during the later all-India campaigns?
qh: चंपारण सत्याग्रह के बाद आगे चले सभी अखिल भारतीय आंदोलनों में बिहार को पूरे भारत में किस नाम से जाना जाने लगा?
e: Champaran Satyagraha ke baad Mahatma Gandhi Bihari janata ke prati pranayak yaani idol ban gaye tatha unke saath milkar kaam karne wale log aajivan unke bhakt tatha shishya ban gaye. Isi karan aage chalkar jab bhi desh me koi bada Gandhivadi andolan chala, Bihar usme sabse aage raha. Itihas me isi karan Bihar ko 'Gandhi-province' yaani Gandhi ka prant kaha jaane laga. Yaha ke logon ne Gandhi ke bataye non-violent yaani ahinsak virodh ke raaste ko hard paristhitiyon me bhi nahi chhoda. Champaran ke kisanon ke liye 1917 me shuru hua ye rishta aage Non-Cooperation, Civil Disobedience tatha Quit India jaisi sabhi all-India campaigns me Bihar ki bhumika ka aadhaar bana. Exam point: Champaran ke baad Bihar ko poore desh me 'Gandhi-province' kaha jaane laga tatha aage ke sabhi all-India andolanon me Bihar sabse aage raha.

qe: In April 1919, while on his way to the Punjab, Mahatma Gandhi was arrested at which place, news of which along with the Jallianwala Bagh firing stirred the people of Bihar?
qh: अप्रैल 1919 में पंजाब जाते समय महात्मा गांधी को किस स्थान पर गिरफ्तार किया गया, जिसकी खबर तथा जलियाँवाला बाग की गोलीबारी ने बिहार की जनता को झकझोर दिया?
e: Rowlatt Act ek aisa kanoon tha jisne sarkar ko bina mukadma chalaye logon ko giraftar karne tatha bina vakil sunvai ke saza dene ki shakti de di. Iske virudh Gandhiji ne 30 March 1919 ko apna satyagraha shuru kiya, jisme tay kiya gaya ki pehle sarkar ko suchna di jayegi aur phir chune hue log us kanoon ki avagya yaani virodh karenge. Shuru me poore desh me hartal yaani kaam-bandh tatha upvas ka karyakram hua tatha ek rashtriya saptah manaya gaya. Patna, Muzaffarpur, Chapra, Champaran, Monghyr, Bhagalpur, Gaya, Jharia tatha Katras me hartal, julus tatha pradarshan hue. Isi beech Punjab jate hue Gandhiji ko Palwal me giraftar kar liya gaya tatha 13 April 1919 ko Amritsar ke Jallianwala Bagh me unarmed logon par goli chalayi gayi. In dono ghatnaon ne Bihar ki janata ko gahre roop se hila diya. Exam point: Punjab jate samay Gandhiji ki giraftari Palwal me hui thi tatha Rowlatt Act ke virudh satyagraha 30 March 1919 se shuru hua tha.

qe: Which conference of Bihar, meeting on 28 August 1920 under whose presidentship, passed a resolution supporting Mahatma Gandhi's non-violent non-cooperation declared on 1 August 1920?
qh: 1 अगस्त 1920 को घोषित महात्मा गांधी के अहिंसक असहयोग के समर्थन में 28 अगस्त 1920 को बिहार का कौन-सा सम्मेलन, किसकी अध्यक्षता में, प्रस्ताव पारित करने वाला पहला बड़ा मंच बना?
oe: Bihar Muslim Conference presided over by Syed Mahmud
Bihar Provincial Conference presided over by Dr. Rajendra Prasad
Bihar Provincial Conference presided over by Mazhar-ul-Haque
Bihar Kisan Sabha presided over by Swami Sahajanand Saraswati
oh: सैयद महमूद की अध्यक्षता वाला बिहार मुस्लिम सम्मेलन
डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद की अध्यक्षता वाला बिहार प्रांतीय सम्मेलन
मज़हरुल हक़ की अध्यक्षता वाला बिहार प्रांतीय सम्मेलन
स्वामी सहजानंद सरस्वती की अध्यक्षता वाली बिहार किसान सभा
e: Non-Cooperation Movement ka mukhya lakshya Punjab tatha Khilafat ke saath hue anyayon ke virudh virodh tha, tatha iski maang Swaraj yaani swarajya ki thi. Gandhiji ne 1 August 1920 ko ahinsak non-cooperation ki ghoshna ki. Congress ke vishesh session se pehle, 28 August 1920 ko Bihar Provincial Conference ki baithak hui, jiski adhyakshta Dr. Rajendra Prasad ne ki. Is sammelan ne Gandhiji ke non-cooperation ka samarthan karte hue prastav paarit kiya. Isse saaf hua ki Bihar ne Gandhiji ke naye tareeke ko sabse pehle apnane wale pranton me jagah banayi. December 1920 me Gandhiji ne Patna aakar ek rashtriya college tatha Bihar Vidyapeeth ki neev ki shila rakhi, jinka aage chalkar rashtriya karyakarta taiyar karne me bada yogdan raha. Maulana Abdul Bari ke rashtriya karyakarta ke roop me judne se andolan ko bal mila. Exam point: 28 August 1920 ko Dr. Rajendra Prasad ki adhyakshta me Bihar Provincial Conference ne Gandhiji ke non-cooperation ka samarthan kiya tha.

qe: In March-April 1921, a strike of policemen in Bihar spread from place to place and, along with Patna, covered which three districts?
qh: मार्च-अप्रैल 1921 में बिहार में पुलिसकर्मियों की हड़ताल एक स्थान से दूसरे स्थान तक फैली और पटना के साथ किन तीन जिलों में पहुँची?
e: Non-Cooperation Movement ka asar Bihar me rajya ki prashasnik vyavastha ke andar bhi dikha. March-April 1921 me yahan pulis karmachaariyon ki ek hadtal yaani strike shuru hui, jo Patna se aage badhkar Purnea, Monghyr tatha Champaran tak phail gayi. Pulis ki hadtal aisi cheez thi jo sarkar ke liye sabse chinta ka vishay hoti thi, kyunki kanoon-vyavastha banaye rakhne wali force hi andolan me khadi ho rahi thi. Iske pehle Government press Patna me tatha Giridih ki railway collieries me bhi hadtal hua tha. In ghatnaon ne dikhaya ki Bihari janata me angreji sarkar ke prati bharosa kam ho gaya tha tatha woh bhaybin yaani fearless hokar virodh kar rahi thi. Usi saal August 1921 me Gandhiji ne Bihar ki yatra ki, jis samay Congress Working Committee ki baithak Patna me hui. Exam point: March-April 1921 ki pulis hadtal Patna ke saath Purnea, Monghyr tatha Champaran tak phaili thi tatha August 1921 me Congress Working Committee ki baithak Patna me hui.

qe: What was the nature of the response in Patna when the Prince of Wales visited the city on 22 December 1921?
qh: 22 दिसंबर 1921 को प्रिंस ऑफ वेल्स के पटना आने पर यहाँ की जनता की प्रतिक्रिया कैसी थी?
oe: Silent prayer meetings only, with normal traffic continuing
An almost complete boycott, with the main thoroughfares empty and no vehicles plying for hire
A huge welcome procession along the main thoroughfares
A violent clash between the crowd and the police
oh: केवल मौन प्रार्थना सभाएँ, आम यातायात सामान्य
लगभग पूर्ण बहिष्कार, मुख्य सड़कें सूनी तथा किराये की गाड़ियाँ तक बंद
मुख्य सड़कों पर विशाल स्वागत जुलूस
भीड़ तथा पुलिस के बीच हिंसक झड़प
e: Non-Cooperation ke dauran angreji sarkar ke apekshit pradarshanon ka virodh karne ke liye Congress ne shahi yatraon ka bahishkar apnaya. Prince of Wales yaani wales ke rajkumar jab 17 November 1921 ko Bombay pahuncha, tab poore Bihar me hartal yaani kaam-bandh hua. Usi varsh 22 December 1921 ko woh Patna aaya, tab shahar me lagbhag poora bahishkar hua - mukhya sadkein khaali reh gayi, kiraye ki koi gaadi nahi chali tatha jis raste se uski savari nikal rahi thi, wahan bheed bhi nahi khadi rahi. Isi saal August me Gandhiji ki Bihar yatra hui tatha March 1922 me unki giraftari par prant bhar me virodh sabhaen hui. Shahi daura sarkar ki prestij ka sawaal hota tha, isliye aisa shaant lekin sampoorna bahishkar angreji sarkar ke liye bada jhatka tha. Exam point: 17 November 1921 ko Prince of Wales ke Bombay pahunchne par Bihar me hartal hua tatha 22 December 1921 ko Patna yatra ka lagbhag poora bahishkar hua.

qe: The Civil Disobedience Enquiry Committee of the Congress visited Bihar in which year, the same year in which Mahatma Gandhi was arrested and sentenced?
qh: कांग्रेस की सविनय अवज्ञा जाँच समिति बिहार किस वर्ष आई, उसी वर्ष जिसमें महात्मा गांधी गिरफ्तार कर सजा दिए गए?
e: Civil Disobedience Enquiry Committee ek aisi samiti thi jo Congress ne yah jaanchne ke liye banayi ki desh me savinay avajna yaani bina hinsa kanoon todne ka andolan kis had tak taiyar hai. Yeh samiti 1922 me Bihar aayi. Usi varsh March 1922 me Mahatma Gandhi ko giraftar kiya gaya tatha chhah saal ki saza sunai gayi, jiske virudh Bihar me prant-vyapi virodh sabhaen aur pradarshan hue. 1922 me hi Congress ka Gaya adhiveshan hua. Is dauraan Bihar me andolan ki raftaar dheemi hui, lekin logon ka vishwas kam nahi hua - unhon ne hard paristhitiyon me bhi ahinsa tatha satyagraha ke raaste ko nahi chhoda. Yeh baat aage 1930 ki Civil Disobedience Movement ka aadhaar bani. Exam point: Civil Disobedience Enquiry Committee 1922 me Bihar aayi, usi varsh Gandhi ji giraftar hue tatha Gaya me Congress adhiveshan hua.

qe: Which two organisational developments relating to Bihar took place at the Gaya session of the Congress, where the boycott of legislatures was decided to be continued?
qh: कांग्रेस के गया अधिवेशन में, जहाँ विधान मंडलों के बहिष्कार को जारी रखने का निर्णय हुआ, बिहार से जुड़े कौन-से दो संगठनात्मक विकास हुए?
oe: Dr. Rajendra Prasad was elected Secretary of the Congress, and the office of the AICC was shifted to Patna
Dr. Rajendra Prasad was elected Congress President, and Bihar Vidyapeeth was founded
Anugraha Narain Sinha was appointed General Secretary, and the Congress office was shifted to Gaya
Dr. Rajendra Prasad became Speaker, and the AICC office was shifted to Bombay
oh: डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद कांग्रेस के सचिव चुने गए तथा अखिल भारतीय कांग्रेस कमेटी का कार्यालय पटना लाया गया
डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद कांग्रेस अध्यक्ष चुने गए तथा बिहार विद्यापीठ की स्थापना हुई
अनुग्रह नारायण सिंह महासचिव बने तथा कांग्रेस कार्यालय गया लाया गया
डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद अध्यक्ष बने तथा अखिल भारतीय कांग्रेस कमेटी का कार्यालय बंबई लाया गया
e: Congress ka 37th adhiveshan Gaya me hua, jahan yeh tay hua ki legislature yaani vidhan mandalon ka bahishkar jaari rahega tatha Ahmedabad adhiveshan ke volunteer bharti yaani swayamsevak bharti wale prastav ki punah pushti ki jayegi. Is samay Bihar, Orissa, Andhra, Karnatak, Tamilnad tatha Gujerat un pranton me the jo 'no-change' yaani purani neeti me koi badlav nahi wali line par tike rahe. Gaya adhiveshan me Dr. Rajendra Prasad Congress ke Secretary chune gaye tatha AICC yaani All India Congress Committee ka karyalaya Patna shift kar diya gaya. Isse Patna poore desh ki rajnitik gatividhi ka ek mahatvapurn kendra ban gaya, jiska labh Bihar ko aage ke andolanon me mila. Exam point: Gaya adhiveshan me Dr. Rajendra Prasad Congress ke Secretary chune gaye tatha AICC ka karyalaya Patna shift hua.

qe: In 1923, Dr. Rajendra Prasad took part along with a batch of volunteers from Bihar in the flag satyagraha held at which place?
qh: 1923 में डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद ने बिहार के स्वयंसेवकों के एक दल के साथ किस स्थान पर हुए झंडा सत्याग्रह में भाग लिया?
e: Flag satyagraha ek aisa andolan tha jisme sarkar ke pravesh-ban ke bawajood satyagrahi apna jhanda lekar kisi sthan ya sabha tak pahunchte the tatha is kram me giraftari dena sweekar karte the. 1923 me Nagpur me aisa hi andolan hua, jisme Bihar ke ek dal ke sadasyon ke saath Dr. Rajendra Prasad ne bhi bhaag liya. Isi varsh January 1923 me Congress me matbhed ke baad Swaraj Party ki sthapna Deshbandhu C. R. Das ki adhyakshta me hui thi; yeh council-entry yaani vidhan mandalon me jaane ke paksh me thi, lekin Bihar me iska zyada asar nahi hua. Yahan Congressjanon ne sthanik nikayon yaani local body ke chunavon me bhaag liya tatha kaafi sithan jite. Nagpur ka yeh karyakram Bihar tatha Congress ke beech rahe mazboot sampark ko dikhata hai. Exam point: 1923 me Nagpur me hua jhanda satyagraha, jisme Bihar ke volunteers ke saath Dr. Rajendra Prasad shaamil hue.

qe: In February 1930, who reviewed the possible lines of civil disobedience in a speech at Patna, before the movement was launched?
qh: आंदोलन शुरू होने से पूर्व फरवरी 1930 में पटना में भाषण देते हुए किसने सविनय अवज्ञा की संभावित रीतियों की समीक्षा की?
e: 1930 ki Civil Disobedience Movement Bihar ke liye sabse ghatnapoorn varshon me se ek raha, aur isme Bihar ki bhumika bahut pramukh thi. Andolan chalu hone se pehle hi taiyari shuru ho gayi. February 1930 me Dr. Rajendra Prasad ne Patna me ek bhashan diya, jisme unhone savinay avajna yaani bina hinsa kanoon todne ki sambhavit ritiyon - kanoon ka ullanghan, kar na dena, videshi vastra tatha sharaab ki dukaanon ke aage picketing - ki sameeksha ki. Isi varsh April me Gandhiji ne namak kanoon todkar andolan ka aarambh kiya, kyunki namak par lagne wala kar gareeb se gareeb aadmi ko bhi chubhta tha. Bihar me namak banana mushkil tha kyunki yahan samudra nahi hai, isliye yahan andolan ka zor savinay avajna ke anya rupon par tatha chaukidari kar ke virodh par laga. Exam point: February 1930 me Dr. Rajendra Prasad ne Patna me savinay avajna ki sambhavit ritiyon par bhashan diya tha.

qe: Whose tour of the Saran, Champaran and Muzaffarpur districts from 31 March to 3 April 1930 became a source of great inspiration for the people of Bihar?
qh: 31 मार्च से 3 अप्रैल 1930 तक किसकी सारण, चंपारण तथा मुजफ्फरपुर जिलों की यात्रा बिहार की जनता के लिए बड़ी प्रेरणा का स्रोत बनी?
e: Civil Disobedience Movement se kuchh din pehle, 31 March se 3 April 1930 tak Jawaharlal Nehru ne Bihar ke Saran, Champaran tatha Muzaffarpur jilon ka daura kiya. Nehru us samay poore desh me yuvaon tatha kisanon ke beech apni chhap ban chuke the tatha unki sabhaen badi bheed khinchti thi. Isi daure se Bihar ke gaon-gaon me andolan ka sandesh pahuncha, jisse savinay avajna ke liye log apne aap taiyar hone lage. Iska natija yeh hua ki April 1930 ke pehle saptah tak yahan pachaas hazaar se bhi adhik Congress volunteers bharti ho gaye. Patna ke ek samachaar patra ne 9 April 1930 ko likha ki desh me nayi aasha ki lehar tatha naye balidan ka utsaah mahsoos ho raha hai. Isi josh ne 16 April 1930 ko Patna me satyagraha ka shubharambh sambhav banaya. Exam point: 31 March se 3 April 1930 tak Jawaharlal Nehru ne Saran, Champaran tatha Muzaffarpur ka daura kiya, jisse Bihar me andolan ki lehar phaili.

qe: By the first week of April 1930, how many Congress volunteers had been enrolled in Bihar for the Civil Disobedience Movement?
qh: अप्रैल 1930 के पहले सप्ताह तक बिहार में सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन के लिए कितने कांग्रेस स्वयंसेवक भर्ती हो चुके थे?
e: Savinay avajna ke liye sabse pehle volunteers yaani swayamsevak chahiye the, jo julus nikal sakein, namak bana sakein tatha giraftari dene ke liye taiyar rahein. Bihar me yeh kaam bahut tezi se hua. April 1930 ke pehle saptah tak hi yahan pachaas hazaar se adhik Congress volunteers bharti ho chuke the tatha unki sankhya lagatar badhti ja rahi thi. Patna ke samachaar patra ne 9 April 1930 ko likha ki nayi aasha ki lehar tatha naye tyag ka utsaah vatavaran me bhar gaya hai. Yeh sankhya is baat ka pramaan hai ki Bihar me Congress sangathan kandhe-kandhe par hazaron logon tak pahunch chuka tha tatha log giraftari ki parwah kiye bina andolan me judne ko taiyar the. Exam point: April 1930 ke pehle saptah tak Bihar me pachaas hazaar se adhik Congress volunteers bharti ho chuke the.

qe: After Patna inaugurated its satyagraha on 16 April 1930, in what condition did Dr. Rajendra Prasad see the volunteers at midnight on 17 April?
qh: 16 अप्रैल 1930 को पटना में सत्याग्रह शुरू होने के बाद 17 अप्रैल की मध्यरात्रि में डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद ने स्वयंसेवकों को किस हालत में देखा?
oe: Being released from jail after a court order
Asleep on the road with the police standing at a short distance from them
Marching with torches through the main streets
Manufacturing salt on the river bank
oh: अदालत के आदेश पर जेल से रिहा होते हुए
सड़क पर सोते हुए, जबकि पुलिस कुछ दूरी पर खड़ी थी
मशालों के साथ मुख्य सड़कों पर जुलूस निकालते हुए
e: 16 April 1930 ko Patna me satyagraha shuru hua tatha volunteers ek julus me shahar ke us chune hue sthan tak pahunche, jahan namak kanoon todkar namak bana kar us kanoon ki avagya ki jaani thi. Pulis ne unhe rok liya, lekin volunteers apni jagah se hile hi nahi - unka virodh poora ahinsak tatha dhairya se bhara tha. Baaki Bihar ke daure se lautne ke baad Dr. Rajendra Prasad ne 17 April ki aadhi raat ko un volunteers ko dekha - woh raaste par so rahe the tatha pulis unse kuchhi doori par khadi thi. Agle dinon me pulis ne volunteers par bahut nirdayi atyachar kiye tatha aage khadi agrani lines ko lathi-baton se ghayal kiya, lekin Bihar ke logon ne badle ki bhavna nahi apnayi. Yeh 16 se 21 April 1930 ka samay Patna ke sabse veer-poorn dino me gina jata hai. Exam point: 17 April 1930 ki aadhi raat ko Dr. Rajendra Prasad ne volunteers ko sadak par sote dekha tatha pulis kuchh doori par khadi thi.

qe: While trying to regulate the crowd in front of Patna College in April 1930, Prof. Abdul Bari was attacked by European officers with which two weapons?
qh: अप्रैल 1930 में पटना कॉलेज के सामने भीड़ को संभालने की कोशिश करते समय प्रो. अब्दुल बारी पर यूरोपीय अफसरों ने किन दो हथियारों से हमला किया?
oe: A baton and a hunter (riding whip)
e: Prof. Abdul Bari Patna College ke adhyapak the tatha Champaran ke baad rashtriya andolan se jude mahatvapurn karyakarta bane the. April 1930 me jab Patna me satyagraha chal raha tha, unhone Patna College ke saamne bheed ko shaant rakhne ka prayas kiya. Isi samay do European adhikari ghode sawaron ke saath wahan pahunche; unme se ek ne unhe poore zor se baton se teen baar maara - pehli maar usne kaha ki yeh uske liye hai, doosri Superintendent of Police ke liye tatha teesri bhaari maar sir par lagi, jisse unka sir soojh gaya. Doosre adhikari ne unhe hunter yaani sawari ki chabuk se do baar maara. Unhone 21 April 1930 ko apne bayan me yeh sab likha. Isi tarah Acharya Kripalani par bhi T. K. Ghose ki Academy ke paas lathi se hamla hua tatha Dr. Rajendra Prasad ke khilaf bhi pulis ne zor lagaya. Exam point: April 1930 me Patna College ke saamne Prof. Abdul Bari par baton ke teen vaar tatha hunter se do vaar kiye gaye the.

qe: A regular camp of volunteers was started at Bihpur in the Bhagalpur district during the Civil Disobedience Movement. What action did the Government take against it?
qh: सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन के दौरान भागलपुर जिले के बीहपुर में स्वयंसेवकों का नियमित शिविर शुरू हुआ; सरकार ने इसके विरुद्ध क्या कार्रवाई की?
oe: It declared the camp an unlawful assembly and broke it up, seizing the camp and the local Congress office
It allowed the camp on the condition that no slogans would be raised
It shifted the camp to a government building
It took no action as the camp was in a rural area
oh: शिविर को गैरकानूनी सभा घोषित कर तोड़ दिया तथा शिविर और स्थानीय कांग्रेस कार्यालय जब्त कर लिया
शर्त रखी कि नारे नहीं लगेंगे तो शिविर चलने दिया
शिविर को सरकारी भवन में स्थानांतरित कर दिया
ग्रामीण क्षेत्र होने के कारण कोई कार्रवाई नहीं की
e: Bihar me savinay avajna ke dauran Bhagalpur jile ke Bihpur me volunteers ka ek sthayi shivir yaani camp shuru hua, jahan barracks yaani lakdi-ke-ghar banaye gaye.
