Wahan volunteers drill yaani vyayam tatha parade karte, lathi chalana seekhte tatha unka poora dinvaas bugle yaani bigul ki awaaz par chalne wale niyam ke hisaab se chalta tha. Is tarah ka shivir sarkar ke liye chunauti tha. Isliye sarkar ne is shivir ko unlawful assembly yaani gairkanuni sabha ghoshit karke use todne ka faisla kiya; shivir tatha wahan ka local Congress office jabt kar liya gaya. Jab pulis shivir khaali kara rahi thi, bada jhunda ikattha ho gaya jisme Dr. Rajendra Prasad, Abdul Bari tatha anya neta maujud the. Bihpur tatha aas-paas ke ilaake me iska bada rosh hua. Exam point: Bihpur shivir ko sarkar ne gairkanuni sabha ghoshit karke toda tatha shivir aur Congress karyalaya jabt kar liya tha.

qe: In Monghyr district during the Civil Disobedience Movement, Congress work proceeded under the leadership of which two leaders, both of whom were arrested?
qh: सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन के समय मुंगेर जिले में कांग्रेस का काम किन दो नेताओं के नेतृत्व में चला, जिन दोनों को गिरफ्तार कर लिया गया?
oe: Shrikrishna Sinha and Nand Kumar Sinha
Dr. Rajendra Prasad and Prof. Abdul Bari
Anugraha Narain Sinha and Syed Mahmud
oh: श्रीकृष्ण सिंह तथा नंद कुमार सिंह
डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद तथा प्रो. अब्दुल बारी
अनुग्रह नारायण सिंह तथा सैयद महमूद
e: Savinay avajna ke dauran Monghyr jile me Congress ki gatividhiyan tezi se badh rahi thin tatha unka netritva Shrikrishna Sinha tatha Nand Kumar Sinha kar rahe the. Shrikrishna Sinha us samay Bihar Provincial Congress Committee ke Secretary the. Namak kanoon todna us ilaake me lagbhag ek sthayi aadat ban gaya tatha ek ke baad ek satyagrahi giraftar hote gaye. Isi kram me Shrikrishna Sinha tatha Nand Kumar Sinha dono ko bhi giraftar kar liya gaya, lekin unki giraftari se andolan dheema nahi hua, balki log aur adhik sankhya me aage aaye. Isi jile me aage chaukidari kar na dene ka sangharsh bhi zor pakadta gaya, jispar sarkar ne zapti - yaani sampatti ki kurchi - jaisi sakht karyavahi ki. Exam point: Monghyr me Congress ka netritva Shrikrishna Sinha (prantiya Congress committee ke sachiv) tatha Nand Kumar Sinha kar rahe the tatha dono giraftar hue.

qe: When Mahatma Gandhi returned disappointed from the Round Table Conference in London, he was refused even an interview by which Viceroy, after which the Congress had to resume the Civil Disobedience Movement?
qh: लंदन के गोलमेज सम्मेलन से निराश लौटने पर महात्मा गांधी को किस वायसराय ने मुलाकात तक देने से इनकार कर दिया, जिसके बाद कांग्रेस को सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन फिर शुरू करना पड़ा?
e: 5 March 1931 se 1 January 1932 ke beech andolan me ek thahraav aaya, kyunki Gandhi-Irwin samjhauta hua tha tatha Gandhiji London me ghoomti Golmej Sammelan yaani Round Table Conference me bhaag lene gaye the. Wahan se woh nirash hokar laute, kyunki Bharat ko poora rajnitik adhikar dene ki koi thos vyavastha nahi hui. Wapas aakar unhe Lord Willingdon se mulaqat tak hi nahi di gayi. Iske baad Congress ko savinay avajna andolan wahi se aage badhana pada jahan usne use chhoda tha. Is baar sarkar ne Gandhiji tatha anya netaon ko giraftar kar liya tatha Indian jeevan ki lagbhag har gatividhi ko apne kabze me lene wale bahut se ordinances - yaani turant banaye gaye karyapalak kanoon - jaari kar diye. Exam point: London se lautne ke baad Gandhiji ko Lord Willingdon ne mulaqat tak nahi di, jiske baad 1932 me savinay avajna andolan phir se shuru karna pada.

qe: What new feature did the Ordinances issued by the Government to break the renewed Civil Disobedience Movement contain?
qh: सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन को कुचलने के लिए सरकार द्वारा जारी अध्यादेशों में कौन-सी नई बात थी?
oe: Parents and guardians were to be punished for the offences of their wards
Salt-making was made a capital offence
Volunteers were to be deported to the Andamans without trial
Every newspaper was to obtain a government licence
oh: अभिभावकों तथा संरक्षकों को उनके आश्रितों के अपराधों के लिए दंडित किया जाएगा
नमक बनाना मृत्युदंड योग्य अपराध घोषित किया गया
स्वयंसेवकों को बिना मुकदमा अंडमान भेजा जाएगा
प्रत्येक समाचार पत्र को सरकारी लाइसेंस लेना होगा
e: Ordinance ek aisa kanoon hota hai jo sarkar ya vayasiraay jaldi me jaari karta hai aur jiska star vidhan mandal ke paarit kanoon ke barabar hota hai. Sabha ki manzoori ke bina chalna isi karan ordinance ko dabaane ka hathiyar kaha jata hai. 1932 me jab savinay avajna andolan phir shuru hua, tab sarkar ne bahut se ordinance jaari kiye, jo 'almost every activity of Indian life' yaani Bharat ke jeevan ki lagbhag har gatividhi ko apne dayre me lete the. Inka ek naya tatha kathor roop yeh tha ki ab walidain yaani maa-baap tatha guardians yaani sanrakshak apne ashriton ke aparadhon ke liye khud dande ke bhagi honge. Isse sarkar chahti thi ki parivar ke andar hi darr paida ho tatha koi bhi andolan me shamil na ho. Bihar me fir bhi andolan videshi kapde aur sharab ki picketing, kar na dene tatha anya rupon me 1934 tak chalta raha. Exam point: 1932 ke Ordinance ki nayi baat yeh thi ki ab maa-baap tatha sanrakshak apne ashriton ke apradhon ke liye dande ke bhagi honge.

qe: In Bihar the police resorted to firing during the renewed movement at Sheohar in Muzaffarpur district and at which place in Monghyr district, which the Congress session at Delhi on 24 April 1932 specially noted?
qh: बिहार में फिर शुरू हुए आंदोलन के दौरान पुलिस ने मुजफ्फरपुर जिले के शिवहर तथा मुंगेर जिले के किस स्थान पर गोली चलाई, जिसका उल्लेख 24 अप्रैल 1932 के दिल्ली कांग्रेस अधिवेशन ने विशेष रूप से किया?
e: 1932 me andolan phir shuru hone par sarkar ne bahut sakht karyavahi ki - giraftariyan, lathi charge tatha kai sthanon par goli chalayi gayi. Bihar me aise sthanon me Muzaffarpur jile ka Sheohar, Monghyr jile ka Tarapur tatha Begusarai shaamil the. In ghatnaon ke virudh 24 April 1932 ko Delhi me hui Congress ke varshik adhiveshan ne un sabhi satyagrahion ke balidan ki sarahana ki, jo maatrbhoomi ki seva me apna jeevan de chuke the; is prastav me Frontier Province tatha Bihar ke Tarapur ka vishesh roop se zikr kiya gaya. Is baat ne saabit kiya ki Bihar angreji dabav ke bawajood andolan me sabse aage khada tha. Ant me 1934 me Gandhiji ne kuchh paristhitiyon ke karan andolan sthagit kar diya tatha rashtriya netaon ne rachnatmak karyakramon par dhyan dene ka faisla kiya. Exam point: Monghyr jile ke Tarapur tatha Muzaffarpur jile ke Sheohar me goli chalayi gayi, jiska ullekh 24 April 1932 ke Delhi Congress adhiveshan ne kiya.

qe: In the elections to the Bihar Legislative Assembly held from 22 to 27 January 1937, out of the total 152 seats, how many did the Congress contest and how many did it capture?
qh: 22 से 27 जनवरी 1937 तक हुए बिहार विधान सभा के चुनावों में कुल 152 सीटों में से कांग्रेस ने कितनी सीटों पर चुनाव लड़ा तथा कितनी जीतीं?
e: Government of India Act 1935 se pranton ko kuchh had tak swashasan mila, lekin yah rashtriya apekshaon se kaafi kam tha. Iske bawajood Congress ne chunav ladne ka faisla kiya. Bihar vidhan sabha ke chunav 22 se 27 January 1937 ke beech hue tatha inme Congress ko zordar safalta mili. Kul 152 seats me se Congress ne 107 par chunav lada tatha 98 jeeti. Party ne paanchon saamaanya shahri seats jeeti tatha grameen 73 me se 63 par vijay pai. Anusoochit jaatiyon ki 15 seats me se 14, apne dwara ladi gayi 7 Muslim seats me se 5, majdooron ki 3 me se 2 tatha adivasi seats me se bhi adhiktar seats Congress ke khaate me gayin. Iske alawa vidhan parishad ke liye 8 Congress naamit sadasy avaksh yaani indirect chunav se chune gaye. Exam point: 1937 ke Bihar vidhan sabha chunav me Congress ne 107 seats par chunav lada tatha 98 jeeti, jisme anusoochit jaati ki 15 me se 14 seats shaamil thin.

qe: At its meeting held at Wardha on 8 July 1937, what decision did the Congress Working Committee take about the acceptance of office?
qh: 8 जुलाई 1937 को वर्धा में हुई बैठक में कांग्रेस कार्य समिति ने पद स्वीकार करने के विषय में क्या निर्णय लिया?
oe: The Working Committee decided to resign from all local bodies
The decision on office was left entirely to the Governors
Congressmen were permitted to accept office where invited, but office was to be used for furthering the Congress policy and the constructive programme
Congressmen were forbidden from accepting any office under the 1935 Act
oh: कार्य समिति ने सभी स्थानीय निकायों से त्यागपत्र देने का निर्णय लिया
पद स्वीकार करने का निर्णय पूरी तरह राज्यपालों पर छोड़ दिया गया
जहाँ आमंत्रित किया जाए वहाँ कांग्रेसजन पद स्वीकार कर सकेंगे, परंतु पद का उपयोग कांग्रेस की नीति तथा रचनात्मक कार्यक्रम को आगे बढ़ाने में होगा
कांग्रेसजनों को 1935 के अधिनियम के अंतर्गत कोई पद स्वीकार करना वर्जित है
e: 1937 ke chunavon me bhari safalta ke baad Congress ke saamne sawaal tha ki ministry yaani mantrimandal banaya jaye ya nahi, kyunki 1935 ka Act rashtriya apekshaon se kamzor tha. Is par British sarkar ke kuchh bayanon ke baad Congress Working Committee ne 8 July 1937 ko Wardha me baithak karke tay kiya ki jahan Congress ko aamantrit kiya jayega wahan Congressjan pad sweekaar kar sakte hain. Lekin iske saath ek shart lagayi gayi - pad isi liye sweekaar kiya jayega ki Congress ke chunav ghoshna patra me ki gayi niyatiyan laagu ki ja sakein tatha Congress ki neeti ke mutabik naye Act ka virodh tatha rachnatmak karyakram aage badhaya ja sake. Isi nirnay ke aadhaar par Bihar me 20 July 1937 ko Congress ministry bani tatha pad ko logon kee hit me kaam karne ka zariya banaya gaya. Exam point: Wardha me 8 July 1937 ko Congress Working Committee ne adhikarik roop se Congressjanon ko pad sweekaar karne ki anumati di, shart ke saath ki pad ka istemaal Congress ki niyati tatha rachnatmak karyakram ke liye hoga.

qe: When the Congress ministry was formed in Bihar on 20 July 1937, which three leaders became ministers along with the Premier?
qh: 20 जुलाई 1937 को बिहार में कांग्रेस मंत्रिमंडल बना; प्रधानमंत्री (प्रीमियर) के साथ कौन-से तीन नेता मंत्री बने?
oe: Anugraha Narain Sinha, Syed Mahmud and Jaglal Chaudhury
Ram Dayalu Singh, Abdul Bari and Baladeva Sahay
Rajendra Prasad, Mazhar-ul-Haque and Sachchidanand Sinha
Nand Kumar Sinha, Shrikrishna Sinha and Jaglal Chaudhury
oh: अनुग्रह नारायण सिंह, सैयद महमूद तथा जगलाल चौधरी
राम दयालु सिंह, अब्दुल बारी तथा बालदेव सहाय
राजेंद्र प्रसाद, मज़हरुल हक़ तथा सच्चिदानंद सिन्हा
नंद कुमार सिंह, श्रीकृष्ण सिंह तथा जगलाल चौधरी
e: Bihar me Congress ministry 20 July 1937 ko bani. Iske pradhan yaani Premier Shrikrishna Sinha bane. Unke saath anya mantri the - Anugraha Narain Sinha, Syed Mahmud tatha Jaglal Chaudhury. Vidhan sabha ke adhyaksh yaani Speaker ke liye Ram Dayalu Singh chune gaye tatha upadhyaksh yaani Deputy Speaker ke liye Prof. Abdul Bari. Sarkar ke mukhya vidhi salahkar yaani Advocate-General ke roop me Baladeva Sahay ki niyukti hui. Is tarah Bihar me Congress ne 1935 ke Act ke andar rehkar bhi apni sarkar banayi tatha yahan ke vikas tatha janta ke prashnon par kaam karne ka mauka mila. Ministry ne apne karyakaal me prashasan tatha vidhi vyavastha se jude kai mamlon me apna rukh spasht kiya. Exam point: 20 July 1937 ko bani Bihar ministry me Premier ke saath Anugraha Narain Sinha, Syed Mahmud tatha Jaglal Chaudhury mantri bane.

qe: How many major all-India non-violent campaigns did Mahatma Gandhi lead and direct between 1919 and 1944?
qh: 1919 से 1944 के बीच महात्मा गांधी ने कुल कितने बड़े अखिल भारतीय अहिंसक आंदोलनों का नेतृत्व तथा संचालन किया?
e: Swatantrata sangram ke dauran Gandhiji ne apne jeevan me chhah bade all-India yaani akhil bharatiya ahinsak andolan chalaye tatha unka nirdekshan kiya; ye andolan 1919 se 1944 ke beech hue. In andolanon ka aadhaar satyagraha yaani sach aur ahinsa par tika virodh tha, lekin har baar paristhiti ke hisaab se inka roop badalta raha - kabhi Rowlatt kanoon ke virudh hartal, kabhi Khilafat tatha Punjab ke anyay ke virudh non-cooperation, kabhi namak kanoon todkar civil disobedience aur ant me Quit India. In sabhi andolanon me ek all-India pattern yaani desh-vyapi dhancha tha, jisme mukhya maang aur siddhant ek jaise the. Kahin-kahin hui hinsa na in andolanon ka hissa thi aur na Gandhiji ne uski anumati di. Bihar ne har campaign me bhaag liya. Exam point: Gandhiji ke netritva me 1919 se 1944 ke beech kul chhah bade all-India ahinsak andolan hue tatha Bihar in sabme shamil raha.

qe: Which of the following was NOT one of the five famous boycotts of the Non-Cooperation Movement?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा असहयोग आंदोलन के पाँच प्रसिद्ध बहिष्कारों में शामिल नहीं था?
oe: Boycott of law courts and schools
Boycott of drink, drugs and foreign cloth
oh: शराब, नशीली चीजों तथा विदेशी कपड़े का बहिष्कार
चुनाव तथा विधान मंडलों का बहिष्कार
e: Non-Cooperation Movement me desh bhar me paanch prasiddh bahishkar yaani boycott chalaye gaye: pehla chunav tatha legislature yaani vidhan mandalon ka, doosra law courts yaani kachahriyon ka, teesra schools yaani vidyalayon ka, chauthe sharaab tatha nashile padarthon ka tatha paanchve videshi kapde ka. Railways yaani rail seva ka bahishkar in paanch me shamil nahi tha. Iske saath hi andolan ka positive yaani rachnatmak paksha bhi tha - khadi ka utpadan tatha prachar, gaon-gaon me panchayaton ki sthapna, Swaraj fund ka sangrah, chhua-chhoot yaani untouchability ka unmoolan tatha Congress sangathan ko mazboot karna. Bihar ne in sabhi shirshakon me poora yogdan diya. Railein angreji satta ka mahatvapurn sadhan thin, lekin Gandhiji ke karyakram me unka bahishkar shaamil nahi kiya gaya thha. Exam point: Non-Cooperation ke paanch bahishkar the - chunav aur vidhan mandal, kachahri, school, sharaab-nasha, tatha videshi kapda; rail-tar ka bahishkar isme shamil nahi tha.

qe: Which reformist group among the Adivasis attended the Gaya session of the Congress and afterwards took to no-tax at great sacrifice?
qh: आदिवासियों के किस सुधारवादी समूह ने कांग्रेस के गया अधिवेशन में भाग लिया तथा बाद में बड़े बलिदान के साथ कर-नहीं-दूँगा (नो-टैक्स) के रास्ते पर चला?
e: Tana Bhagat ek sudharvadi sampraday tha jo Chotanagpur ke Oraon aadivasiyon me 1914 ke aas-paas shuru hua. Iska sandesh tha ki purane andhvishwaso tatha nashile padarthon ko chhodo tatha bhoomi-par lagan yaani rent dene se inkar karo. Non-Cooperation ke samay yeh samuh Gandhiji ke vicharon ki taraf khincha. Tana Bhagaton ne Gaya me hui Congress adhiveshan me bhaag liya tatha iske baad no-tax yaani lagan tatha anya kar na dene ka rasta apnaya, jisme unhe kai kasht uthane pade. Isse saabit hota hai ki rashtriya andolan ka prabhav Bihar ke aadivasi samaj tak bhi pahuncha tatha aadivasi apni bhoomi tatha swabhiman ke sawal ko rashtriya andolan se jodne lage. Exam point: Tana Bhagat samuh ne Gaya adhiveshan me bhaag liya tatha iske baad no-tax andolan apnaya.

qe: When the volunteer camp and the local Congress office at Bihpur were seized, how many of the 250 chaukidars of that police station resigned?
qh: बीहपुर में स्वयंसेवक शिविर तथा स्थानीय कांग्रेस कार्यालय जब्त होने पर उस थाने के 250 चौकीदारों में से कितनों ने त्यागपत्र दे दिया?
e: Chaukidar gaon ke chowkidar hote the, jo gaon ki chowkasi tatha soochna pahunchane ka sarkari kaam karte the. Jab Bihpur me sarkar ne volunteers ke shivir tatha local Congress office ko jabt kiya, wahan ke 250 chaukidaron me se lagbhag 130 ne istifa yaani tyaagpatra de diya. Yeh ek bahut bada pradarshan tha, kyunki isse dikha ki sarkar ka nichla amla bhi Congress ki bhavna se prabhavit ho raha tha. Bihpur ki is karyavahi ki ninda Bhagalpur ke liberal logon ne bhi ki tatha virodh me vidhan parishad ke pandrah naye chune gaye sadasyon me se paanch ne apne pad se istifa de diya. Isse saabit hua ki sarkari dabav logon ko darane me asafal raha tatha loktantrik virodh nyay ke paksh me khada hua. Exam point: Bihpur ke 250 chaukidaron me se lagbhag 130 ne istifa diya tatha vidhan parishad ke paanch naye sadasy bhi virodh me istifa kar baithe.

qe: Who was appointed Advocate-General of Bihar when the first Congress ministry took office in July 1937?
qh: जुलाई 1937 में पहले कांग्रेस मंत्रिमंडल के कार्यभार संभालने पर बिहार का महाधिवक्ता (एडवोकेट-जनरल) किसे नियुक्त किया गया?
e: Advocate-General sarkar ka mukhya vidhi salahkar yaani chief legal adviser hota hai, jo sarkar ki aur se adalaton me sarkari paksh rakhata hai tatha kanoon se jude prashnon par salah deta hai. Bihar me 20 July 1937 ko Congress ministry banne ke baad Baladeva Sahay ko Advocate-General niyukt kiya gaya. Isi ministry me Ram Dayalu Singh vidhan sabha ke adhyaksh tatha Prof. Abdul Bari upadhyaksh chune gaye the. Ministry ko shuru se hi vidhi vyavastha se judi chunautiyon ka saamna karna pada. Usne Chief Secretary Mr Brett dwara jaari ek paripatra yaani circular ka sakht virodh kiya tatha apne paksh me dridh rahi, jiske karan woh paripatra wapas lena pada. Yeh pehla mauka tha jab Bihar me Congress ministry ne prashasnik vyavastha ke andar apni shakti dikhayi. Exam point: 1937 me Bihar me Congress ministry banne par Baladeva Sahay Advocate-General niyukt hue the.

qe: During the Non-Cooperation Movement in Bihar, the boycott of auctions held for the settlement of which two things became a notable feature in Monghyr and Bhagalpur?
qh: बिहार में असहयोग आंदोलन के दौरान मुंगेर तथा भागलपुर में किन दो चीजों के निपटान के लिए होने वाली नीलामियों का बहिष्कार एक प्रमुख घटना बना?
oh: घाट (नदी पार कराने वाली सेवा) तथा कांजी हाउस
नमक भंडार तथा अफीम की दुकानें
आबकारी दुकानें तथा ताड़ी के पेड़
e: Andolan ke waqt Bihar me kuch sthayi sarkari vyavasthayen bahishkar yaani boycott karne ka nishana bani. Jinme ek pramukh cheez thi ferry yaani nadi paar karane ki ghataat ki sewa tatha pound yaani kaanji haus - wo jagah jahan bhatke hue pashu pakadkar rakhe jate the tatha unhe chhudane ke liye malik ko shulk dena padta tha. Monghyr tatha Bhagalpur me in dono ke settlement yaani ijare-Theke ke liye sarkar jo neelami karti thi, usse logon ne bhaag lena shuru kar diya, jisse sarkar ko aay ka nuksaan uthana pada. Isi tarah Government press Patna me tatha Giridih ki railway collieries yaani koyla khanon me hadtal hua, jisse andolan ki pahunch mazdoor varga tak pahunchi. In sabhi kadamon se saabit hua ki Bihar me non-cooperation sirf shahron tak simit nahi tha. Exam point: Monghyr aur Bhagalpur me ferry tatha kaanji haus (pound) ki neelamiyon ka bahishkar non-cooperation ka pramukh kadam tha.

qe: Why did the Congress ministry in Bihar tender its resignation soon after assuming office in 1937, and when did it resume office?
qh: बिहार में कांग्रेस मंत्रिमंडल ने 1937 में कार्यभार सँभालने के कुछ समय बाद त्यागपत्र क्यों दिया तथा कब पुनः कार्यभार सँभाला?
oe: Over the dismissal of the Chief Secretary; it never resumed office
Over the Governor's refusal to agree with its viewpoint on the release of political prisoners; it resumed office in February 1938
Over the refusal of the British Government to grant complete independence; it resumed office in 1942
Over the arrest of Dr. Rajendra Prasad; it resumed office in 1939
oh: मुख्य सचिव की बर्खास्तगी के कारण; कभी पुनः कार्यभार नहीं सँभाला
राजनीतिक बंदियों की रिहाई पर राज्यपाल के पक्ष से सहमत न होने के कारण; फरवरी 1938 में पुनः कार्यभार सँभाला
पूर्ण स्वतंत्रता न देने के कारण; 1942 में पुनः कार्यभार सँभाला
डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद की गिरफ्तारी के कारण; 1939 में पुनः कार्यभार सँभाला
e: Bihar me Congress ministry banne ke baad uska pehla bada takraav rajnitik bandiyon yaani political prisoners ki rihai ke sawaal par hua. Ministry chahti thi ki aise bandiyon ko chhod diya jaye, lekin Governor is vishay par ministry ke drishtikon se sehmat nahi hua. Is par ministry ne tyaagpatra de diya tatha sarkar chalti rahi, jabki Congress vidhan mandal me bahumat me thi. Iske baad dono pakshon ke beech baat aage badhi tatha February 1938 me is vishay par samjhauta hua, jiske baad ministry ne phir se karyabhaar sambhaal liya. Is ghatna se pata chalta hai ki 1935 ke Act me provincial autonomy ka daayra bhi kitna simit tha, kyunki prantiya ministry ko governor ki marzi ke aage jhukna padta tha. Vidhan parishad tatha vidhan sabha ki sahayata se ministry ne aage apne kaam jaari rakhe. Exam point: Ministry ne rajnitik bandiyon ki rihai ke sawaal par Governor ki asehmati ke karan istifa diya tatha February 1938 me samjhauta hone par punah karyabhaar sambhala.

qe: On 16 October 1939, which Bihar Premier moved a resolution in the Assembly inviting the Government to declare that India was an independent nation entitled to frame her own constitution?
qh: 16 अक्टूबर 1939 को बिहार के किस प्रीमियर ने विधान सभा में प्रस्ताव रखकर सरकार से यह घोषणा करने को कहा कि भारत एक स्वतंत्र राष्ट्र है तथा अपना संविधान बनाने का हकदार है?
e: 1939 me dusra vishwa yuddh shuru hone par Bharatiya rashtravadiyon ne British sarkar se yeh maanga ki woh yuddh ke apne uddeshya saaf kare tatha Bharat me ek rashtriya sarkar banayi jaye. Viceroy Lord Linlithgow ke 17 October 1939 ke bayan ko Congress ne poora aur santoshjanak nahi maana. Isi virodh ke kram me Bihar me 16 October 1939 ko Premier Shrikrishna Sinha ne vidhan sabha me ek prastav rakha, jisme sarkar se kaha gaya ki woh saaf taur par ghoshit kare ki Bharat ek swatantra rashtra hai, jise apna samvidhan banane ka adhikar hai tatha bharat ke shasan ke sambandh me is ghoshna ko jitna jaldi sambhav ho, laagu kiya jaye. Yeh prastav doosre pranton ke Congress vidhan mandalon me paarit prastavon ke samaan tha tatha Bihar vidhan sabha me 73 ke mukable 6 maton se paarit hua. Exam point: 16 October 1939 ko Bihar ke Premier Shrikrishna Sinha ka prastav 73 ke mukable 6 maton se paarit hua, jisme Bharat ko swatantra rashtra ghoshit karne ki maang thi.

qe: Who was arrested in February 1940 under the Defence of India Rules for a speech delivered at Jamshedpur, adding to the national discontent in Bihar?
qh: फरवरी 1940 में जमशेदपुर में दिए गए एक भाषण के लिए डिफेंस ऑफ इंडिया रूल्स के तहत किसे गिरफ्तार किया गया, जिससे बिहार में राष्ट्रीय असंतोष और बढ़ गया?
e: Defence of India Rules yaani bharat raksha niyam aise kanoon the jo yuddh ke samay sarkar ko vishesh shaktiyan dete the, jaise bina mukadma kisi ko kaid karna ya kisi bhi bhashan ya lekh par rok lagana. 1940 me Bihar me 26 January ka Independence Day bade samaroh ke saath manaya gaya, jisme samachar patra mein vidyarthiyon ki pramukh bhumika rahi. Isi beech 13 February 1940 ko Jamshedpur me diye gaye ek bhashan ke liye Jaiprakash Narain ko Defence of India Rules ke tahat giraftar kar liya gaya. Isi samay se sarkar ne in niyamon ka bahut kathor tatha vistrit upyog karna shuru kiya, jisse vaatavaran aur tanavapurna ho gaya. Jaiprakash Narain us samay Bihar tatha desh ke yuva congress samajwadi netaon me sabse aage the. Exam point: 13 February 1940 ko Jamshedpur ke bhashan ke liye Jaiprakash Narain ko Defence of India Rules ke tahat giraftar kiya gaya tha.

qe: Which declaration of 9 September 1941, that the Atlantic Charter did not apply to India, aggravated discontent and distrust among the people of Bihar and elsewhere?
qh: 9 सितंबर 1941 की किस घोषणा ने, जिसमें कहा गया कि अटलांटिक चार्टर भारत पर लागू नहीं होता, बिहार तथा अन्यत्र की जनता में असंतोष और अविश्वास बढ़ा दिया?
e: Atlantic Charter ek aisi ghoshna patra thi jo doosre vishwa yuddh ke dauran America tatha Britain ke netaon ne milkar jaari ki, jisme un deshon ke logon ke apna shasan chunne ke adhikar ki baat thi. August Offer ke baad bhi gatirodh door nahi hua. Secretary of State for India Mr Amery ne 22 April 1941 ko House of Commons me jo bayan diya, usse tatha 9 September 1941 ko PM Winston Churchill ki is ghoshna se ki Atlantic Charter Bharat par laagoo nahi hota, logon me aakrosh tatha sarkar ke prati avishwas badh gaya. Patna ke District Magistrate ne apne Commissioner ko report bhi di ki England ke Prime Minister ke bhashan se Bharatiyon me vyapak asantosh hai tatha jo log ab tak yuddhee prayason ka samarthan karne me jhijhak rahe the, unhe iska bahana mil gaya. Isi tarah ka daba hua aakrosh 1942 me ek bade vidroh ke roop me phoot pada. Exam point: 9 September 1941 ko PM Churchill ki is ghoshna se ki Atlantic Charter Bharat par laagoo nahi, Bihar me asantosh tatha avishwas badha, jo 1942 ke andolan ka aadhaar bana.

qe: Before the August 1942 movement broke out, which leader in consultation with other leaders prepared a draft programme for the guidance of the people of Bihar?
qh: अगस्त 1942 का आंदोलन शुरू होने से पूर्व किस नेता ने अन्य नेताओं के परामर्श से बिहार की जनता के मार्गदर्शन हेतु कार्यक्रम का प्रारूप तैयार किया?
e: 1942 ka andolan azaadi ke liye Bharat ke sabse bade jan-andolanon me se ek tha. Us samay yuddh ka sankat badh chuka tha tatha Japanese senayein Bharat ki seema ke kareeb aane lagi thi; aise samay me rashtriya sarkar banane ki maang ko British sarkar ne thukra diya. Isi samay Gandhiji ne 'Quit India' yaani angrejon ko Bharat chhodne ka nara buland kiya. Andolan shuru hone se pehle hi Bihar me taiyari shuru ho gayi thi. Dr. Rajendra Prasad ne kuchh anya netaon ke saath paramarsh karke logon ke margdarshan ke liye karyakram ka ek draft yaani prarup taiyar kiya. Netaon ka anuman tha ki aane wala sangharsh bahut vishal roop lega, isliye pehle se hi logon ko bata diya jaye ki unhe kya karna hai tatha kya nahi karna hai. Is taiyari ke karan andolan chalu hone par Bihar me karyakram vyavasthit roop se aage badh sake. Exam point: Quit India andolan se pehle Dr. Rajendra Prasad ne anya netaon ke paramarsh se janta ke margdarshan ke liye karyakram ka prarup taiyar kiya tha.

qe: After the Hazaribagh escape, Yogendra Sukul, who was going towards north Bihar with a group, was arrested at which place by the Police Superintendent of Muzaffarpur?
qh: हजारीबाग से भागने के बाद उत्तर बिहार की ओर बढ़ रहे एक दल के साथ योगेंद्र सुकुल को मुजफ्फरपुर के पुलिस अधीक्षक ने किस स्थान पर गिरफ्तार किया?
e: Gaya zile me pahunchkar bhaagne wale chhah logon ne do toliyan banayi. Ek toli mein Jai Prakash Narain, Ramnandan Misra tatha Shaligram Singh the, jo Banaras ki taraf badhe; doosri toli mein Yogendra Sukul, Suraj Narain Singh tatha Gulab the, jo uttar Bihar ki or gaye. Gupt soochna milne par Muzaffarpur ke Police Superintendent ne Yogendra Sukul ko Akharaghat par giraftar kar liya. Uske baad 7 December ko unhe Patna laya gaya tatha wahan se Buxar jail bhej diya gaya. Unki toli ke do anya log Darbhanga ki or badh gaye tatha wahan chhupe roop se apna karyakram chalate rahe. Is tarah bhaagne ke baad ka safar lamba tatha khatarnaak tha, lekin saathiyon ne apna uddeshya nahi chhoda. Exam point: Muzaffarpur ke Police Superintendent ne Yogendra Sukul ko Akharaghat par giraftar kiya tatha 7 December ko Patna laakar Buxar jail bhej diya gaya.

qe: During the Second World War, which three sections of nationalists in Bihar raised their voices against recruitment and support for what they regarded as an imperialist war?
qh: द्वितीय विश्वयुद्ध के दौरान बिहार में राष्ट्रवादियों के किन तीन वर्गों ने भरती तथा साम्राज्यवादी युद्ध के समर्थन के विरुद्ध आवाज उठाई?
oe: Cricket clubs, student unions and trade guilds
Ahrar Party, Momins and the Muslim League
Congress, Congress Socialists and the Forward Bloc
Muslim League, Justice Party and the Unionist Party
oh: क्रिकेट क्लब, छात्र संघ तथा व्यापारी संगठन
अहरार पार्टी, मोमिन तथा मुस्लिम लीग
कांग्रेस, कांग्रेस सोशलिस्ट तथा फॉरवर्ड ब्लॉक
मुस्लिम लीग, जस्टिस पार्टी तथा यूनियनिस्ट पार्टी
e: 1939 me yuddh shuru hone par British sarkar ki yuddh neeti se Bihar me bhi vyapak aakrosh paida hua. Viceroy ke 17 October 1939 ke bayan ke baad rashtravadi netaon ne yuddh me sahyog dene se inkar kar diya tatha yuddh ke liye bharti ki muhim ka virodh kiya. Bihar me Congress, Congress Socialists tatha Forward Bloc - in teen dhaaraon ke netaon ne khulkar awaaz uthayi tatha is yuddh ko 'imperialist war' yaani samrajyavadi yuddh bataya, jo keval angreji satta ko bachane ke liye ladha ja raha tha. Is virodh ke kram me Bihar ministry ne 31 October 1939 ko tyaagpatra de diya tatha prant me sanvaidhanik gatirodh paida ho gaya. Isi ke saath Congress ka rukh rashtriya sarkar tatha poorna swatantrata ki maang par tika raha. Exam point: 1939 me Bihar me Congress, Congress Socialists tatha Forward Bloc ke netaon ne yuddh ki bharti ka virodh kiya tatha ise samrajyavadi yuddh bataya.

qe: When the Bihar Ministry resigned on 31 October 1939, the Governor issued a proclamation on 3 November 1939 under which section of the Government of India Act, assuming all legislative and administrative powers?
qh: 31 अक्टूबर 1939 को बिहार मंत्रिमंडल के त्यागपत्र देने पर राज्यपाल ने 3 नवंबर 1939 को भारत सरकार अधिनियम की किस धारा के अधीन उद्घोषणा जारी कर सभी विधायी तथा प्रशासनिक शक्तियाँ अपने हाथ में ले लीं?
e: 1935 ke Government of India Act ke andar pranton ko kuchh swashasan mila tha, lekin usme aisi vyavastha bhi thi jisse governor kisi bhi samay prantiya sarkar ko barkhast karke poora shasan apne haath me le sakta tha. Jab Bihar ministry ne 31 October 1939 ko tyaagpatra de diya, kyunki rashtriya maangon par British sarkar ka rukh saaf nahi hua tha, tab Governor ne 3 November 1939 ko section 93 yaani dhara 93 ke adheen udghoshna jaari ki tatha sabhi vidhayi tatha prashasnik shaktiyan apne naam kar lin. Iske karan ek sanvaidhanik gatirodh yaani constitutional deadlock paida ho gaya, jisme prantiya sarkar ke bina prashasan chal raha tha. Aise samay me governor hi kanoon banane tatha prashasnik faisle lene ka adhikari ban jata tha. Yeh ghatna is baat ka praman hai ki 1935 ka Act kitna bhi swashasan ka naam le, asli shakti angreji sarkar ke haath me hi thi. Exam point: ministry ke istifa ke baad 3 November 1939 ko Governor ne section 93 ke adheen udghoshna jaari karke saari shaktiyan apne paas le li tatha sanvidhanik gatirodh paida hua.

qe: The 53rd session of the Indian National Congress was held at Ramgarh on 19 and 20 March 1940 under the presidentship of which leader?
qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस का 53वाँ अधिवेशन 19 तथा 20 मार्च 1940 को रामगढ़ में किस नेता की अध्यक्षता में हुआ?
e: Varsh 1940 Bihar ke liye vishesh mahatvapurn tha, kyunki Congress ka 53vaan yaani 53rd adhiveshan Ramgarh me 19 tatha 20 March 1940 ko hua. Is adhiveshan ki adhyakshta Maulana Abul Kalam Azad ne ki. Apne swagat bhashan me Dr. Rajendra Prasad ne Bihar ki gauravshali parampraon ka smaran kiya tatha kaha ki aaj hum ek bade sankat ke saamne khade hain tatha hamein usse milne ke liye taiyar hona hoga. Isi adhiveshan me Jawaharlal Nehru ne ekmatra prastav - satyagraha sambandhi prastav - rakha, jo paarit hua, tatha Gandhiji ne apne bhashan me ahinsa tatha rachnatmak kaam ke mahatv par zor diya. Ramgarh us samay Bihar ke Chotanagpur kshetra me padta tha, jo aaj Jharkhand rajya me hai. Exam point: Congress ka 53vaan adhiveshan 19-20 March 1940 ko Ramgarh me Maulana Abul Kalam Azad ki adhyakshta me hua, jisme Nehru ne satyagraha par ekmatra prastav rakha.

qe: When Dr. Rajendra Prasad was arrested on 9 August 1942, he was taken to which jail amidst shouts of Quit India and Rajendra Babu ki jai?
qh: 9 अगस्त 1942 को डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद की गिरफ्तारी के बाद 'भारत छोड़ो' तथा 'राजेंद्र बाबू की जय' के नारों के बीच उन्हें किस जेल में ले जाया गया?
e: 9 August 1942 ki subah British sarkar ne Bombay me Mahatma Gandhi tatha Congress Working Committee ke sabhi sadasyaon ko giraftar kar liya, taaki mass civil disobedience shuru hone se pehle hi use rok diya jaye. Bihar me bhi isi din Dr. Rajendra Prasad ko giraftar kiya gaya; jab unhe le jaaya ja raha tha, log 'Quit India', 'Gandhiji ki jai' tatha 'Rajendra Babu ki jai' ke naare laga rahe the. Unhe Bankipur jail me rakha gaya. Iske thode hi samay baad Phulan Prasad Varma tatha do-teen dinon ke andar Shrikrishna Sinha, Anugraha Narain Sinha tatha prant ke anya neta bhi giraftar kar liye gaye. Congress ke karyalaya tatha uske sahyogi sangathanon ko gairkanuni ghoshit kar diya gaya tatha pulis ne un sabhi par kabza kar liya. Is tarah Bihar me andolan ke netritva ke khali hone par bhi janata ne ladna band nahi kiya. Exam point: 9 August 1942 ko giraftar kiye jane par Dr. Rajendra Prasad ko Bankipur jail me rakha gaya tatha iske kuchh hi dinon me Bihar ke sabhi pramukh neta giraftar ho gaye.

qe: On which night did six prisoners, including Jaiprakash Narain, escape from the Hazaribagh jail in a miraculous way in 1942?
qh: 1942 में जयप्रकाश नारायण सहित छह बंदियों ने किस रात्रि को चमत्कारिक ढंग से हजारीबाग जेल से भाग निकलने में सफलता पाई?
e: Hazaribagh jail me bandh kuchh Bihar ke svatantrata senaniyon ne apne ko matrbhoomi ki seva me lagane ka nishchay kiya tatha 9 November 1942 ki Diwali ki raat ko woh ek aise tarike se jail se bahar nikal gaye jo sabke liye ashcharyajanak tha. Ye chhah log the - Jai Prakash Narain, Ramnandan Misra, Yogendra Sukul, Suraj Narain Singh, Gulab Sonar tatha Shaligram Singh, jo Hazaribagh zile ki Congress committee ke secretary the. Is bhaagne ki yojna me sahyog karne ke shak yaani sandeh ke aadhaar par Ram Narain Singh, Krishna Ballabh Sahay tatha Sukhlal Singh ko Hazaribagh se hatakar Bhagalpur jail bhej diya gaya tatha bhaagne walon ki soochna dene par badi inaam rakhi gayi. Bhaagkar yeh log jungle tatha tedhe-medhe raaston se hokar Gaya zile mein pahunche tatha wahan do toliyon me bat gaye. Exam point: 9 November 1942 ki Diwali ki raat ko Jai Prakash Narain samet chhah log Hazaribagh jail se bhaag nikle, jinme Ramnandan Misra, Yogendra Sukul, Suraj Narain Singh, Gulab Sonar tatha Shaligram Singh shaamil the.

qe: In the circular letter addressed to 'All Fighters for Freedom' at the end of January 1943, what did Jai Prakash Narain declare was their objective?
qh: जनवरी 1943 के अंत में 'आल फाइटर्स फॉर फ्रीडम' को लिखे परिपत्र में जयप्रकाश नारायण ने किसे अपना लक्ष्य घोषित किया?
e: Bhoomigat avastha me Jaiprakash Narain ne January 1943 ke ant me 'All Fighters for Freedom' yaani azaadi ke sabhi senaniyon ko ek paripatra yaani circular patra likha. Isme unhone hinsa ke saadhan ke roop me uske maayne samjhaye tatha bataya ki angreji raj ko ukhaadne ke liye kya karna hoga. Unhone likha ki hamein apni shaktiyan taiyar, sangathit tatha anushasit karni hongi tatha yeh sirf koi chhipi hui goshthi ka kaam nahi hai - 'yeh janata ka poorna vidroh hai, aur yahi hamara lakshya hai.' Isi liye unhone gaon-gon me kisanon tatha aam logon ke beech, karkhaano, khano tatha railway me kaam karne walon ke beech, bhartiya sena tatha services me kaam karne walon ke beech gahan kaam karne ki salah di tatha vidyarthiyon se vishesh appeal bhi ki. Exam point: January 1943 ke apne paripatra me Jaiprakash Narain ne janata ke poorna vidroh ko apna lakshya bataya tatha students, mazdoor tatha kisanon ke beech kaam karne ki salah di.

qe: During the Ramgarh Congress session of 1940, an All-India Anti-Compromise Conference was held under the presidentship of which leader, in which leaders from Bihar took a prominent part?
qh: 1940 के रामगढ़ कांग्रेस अधिवेशन के दौरान किस नेता की अध्यक्षता में अखिल भारतीय समझौता-विरोधी सम्मेलन हुआ, जिसमें बिहार के नेताओं ने प्रमुख भूमिका निभाई?
e: Ramgarh adhiveshan ke samay kuchh rashtravadi netaon ko laga ki Congress ka rukh samjhauta ki taraf jhuk raha hai. Inme zyadatar log Forward Bloc se jude the, jo angreji samrajyavad ke saath poore asahyog ki baat karte the. Apni isi neeti ke aadhaar par ek andolan shuru karne ke uddeshya se unhone Congress adhiveshan ke dauran hi Ramgarh me ek 'All-India Anti-Compromise Conference' yaani akhil bharatiya samjhauta-virodhi sammelan aayojit kiya, jiski adhyakshta Subhas Chandra Bose ne ki. Is sammelan me Bihar ke Swami Sahajanand Saraswati, Shibhadra Yajee tatha kuchh anya netaon ne pramukh bhumika nibhayi. Is tarah Ramgarh adhiveshan jahan ek taraf satyagraha ki taiyari ka manch bana, wahin doosri taraf Congress ke andar ke sakht tatha samjhauta-virodhi dhaara ka bhi pradarshan bana. Exam point: Ramgarh me hui Anti-Compromise Conference ki adhyakshta Subhas Chandra Bose ne ki tatha Bihar ke Sahajanand Saraswati tatha Shibhadra Yajee usme pramukh the.

qe: On 11 August 1942, a huge procession of thousands marched in Patna with what immediate object, at which place did the police fire?
qh: 11 अगस्त 1942 को पटना में हज़ारों लोगों का विशाल जुलूस किस उद्देश्य से निकला, जिस स्थान पर पुलिस ने गोली चलाई?
oe: To burn foreign cloth in the main market
To hand over a memorandum to the Governor
To hoist the national flag on the Patna Secretariat building
To take out a protest march to Bankipur jail
oh: मुख्य बाजार में विदेशी कपड़ा जलाने के लिए
राज्यपाल को ज्ञापन सौंपने के लिए
पटना सचिवालय भवन पर राष्ट्रीय ध्वज फहराने के लिए
बांकीपुर जेल तक विरोध मार्च निकालने के लिए
e: Bihar me Quit India andolan ke dauran chatra yaani students ne sabse veer-poorn bhumika nibhayi. 11 August 1942 ki dopahar Patna me hazaron utsaahit logon ka vishal julus nikla, jisme students ke dal sabse aage the. Is julus ka uddeshya tha Patna Secretariat ke bhavan par rashtriya dhwaj yaani jhanda fahrana - wohi Secretariat jo Bihar me angreji naukarshahi ka mukhya pratik tha. Sarkar ne iske jawab me goli chalane ka aadesh de diya. Is din ko Bihar ke rashtriya andolan ke itihas me ek yaadgar din maana jata hai tatha ise 'Martyr's Day' yaani shahidi diwas ke roop me gina jata hai. Iske baad poore prant me swatah logon ka ek vishal aakrosh phoota, jisme angreji shasan ke pratikon par hamle hue tatha prashasan ko lampat karne ki koshish hui. Exam point: 11 August 1942 ko Patna me julus ka uddeshya Secretariat bhavan par rashtriya dhwaj fahrana tha tatha is mokee par rajdhaani ke Secretariat se goli chalayi gayi.

qe: After the Hazaribagh jail escape, what reward was announced by the Government for information about Jai Prakash Narain, Yogendra Sukul and Ramnandan Misra?
qh: हजारीबाग जेल से भागने के बाद जयप्रकाश नारायण, योगेंद्र सुकुल तथा रामनंदन मिश्र की सूचना देने पर सरकार ने कितना इनाम रखा?
e: Hazaribagh jail se chhah kaidiyon ke bhaag nikalne ke baad sarkar halaak ho gayi. Bhaagne walon ki soochna dene wale ko badi inaam rashi dene ka elaan kiya gaya - Jai Prakash Narain, Yogendra Sukul tatha Ramnandan Misra ke liye paanch-paanch hazaar rupaye tatha baaki teen logon ke liye do-do hazaar rupaye ki inaam rakhi gayi. Inaam ki yeh rashi is baat ka praman hai ki sarkar in netaon ko kitna bada khatra maanti thi tatha unhe pakadne ke liye kisi bhi had tak jaane ko taiyar thi. Iske bawajood sarkar unhe turant pakad nahi payi; yeh log jungle tatha pahadi raaston se hokar Gaya zile me pahunche tatha aage apna kaam karte rahe. Is tarah bhaagne ka yeh pura sambandh Quit India andolan ke bhoomigat charan ka mahatvapurn hissa bana. Exam point: Jai Prakash Narain, Yogendra Sukul tatha Ramnandan Misra ki soochna dene par paanch-paanch hazaar rupaye tatha anya teen bhaagne walon par do-do hazaar rupaye ka inaam ghosit kiya gaya tha.

qe: Jai Prakash Narain and his comrades, arrested in May 1943 and confined in the Hanuman-nagar jail, were soon rescued by a band of workers under the guidance of which two leaders?
qh: मई 1943 में गिरफ्तार होकर हनुमाननगर जेल में रखे गए जयप्रकाश नारायण तथा उनके साथियों को शीघ्र ही किन दो नेताओं के निर्देशन में कार्यकर्ताओं के एक दल ने छुड़ा लिया?
oe: Krishna Ballabh Sahay and Sukhlal Singh
Suraj Narain Singh and Sardar Nityanand Singh
Ram Manohar Lohia and Ramnandan Misra
oh: कृष्ण बल्लभ सहाय तथा सुखलाल सिंह
सूरज नारायण सिंह तथा सरदार नित्यानंद सिंह
राम मनोहर लोहिया तथा रामनंदन मिश्र
e: Nepal ki tarai me Jaiprakash Narain ne, Suraj Narain Singh tatha kuchh anya Bihar ke saathiyon ke sakriya sahyog se tatha Ram Manohar Lohia ke saath milkar Azad Dasta yaani guerilla toliyan banayi, jo angreji vyavastha ke khilaf kaam karti thin. British sarkar ne May 1943 me unhe giraftar kar liya tatha Hanuman-nagar jail me rakha. Lekin woh zyada din wahan nahi rah paye - Suraj Narain Singh tatha Sardar Nityanand Singh ke nirdeshan me kaam karne wale ek dal ne unhe chhuda liya. Yeh ghatna dikhati hai ki 1942 ke baad bhi Bihar tatha Nepal ki tarai ka sandarbh andolan ke liye zinda tha tatha sarkar ki sakht karyavahi ke bawajood saathi ek-doosre ki madad ko taiyar rahte the. Exam point: May 1943 me Hanuman-nagar jail me bandh Jaiprakash Narain tatha saathiyon ko Suraj Narain Singh tatha Sardar Nityanand Singh ke nirdeshan me kaam karne wale ek dal ne chhudaya.

qe: Which Bihar branch conference of the Muslim League, held at Chapra on 13 and 14 April 1940, supported the Lahore resolution, after which Pakistan Day was observed in Bihar on 19 April?
qh: मुस्लिम लीग की बिहार शाखा का कौन-सा सम्मेलन, जो 13 तथा 14 अप्रैल 1940 को छपरा में हुआ, लाहौर प्रस्ताव का समर्थन करने वाला बना, जिसके बाद 19 अप्रैल को बिहार में पाकिस्तान दिवस मनाया गया?
e: 1940 ke Lahore adhiveshan me Muslim League ne yeh siddhant ghosit kiya ki Musalman koi alpasankhyak nahi balki ek 'nation' yaani rashtra hain tatha unhein apna watan tatha rajya chahiye, jise Pakistan kaha gaya. Bihar ke kuchh Musalman neta Lahore adhiveshan me bhi shaamil hue. Bihar me Muslim League ki shakha ka sammelan Chapra me 13 tatha 14 April 1940 ko hua, jisme Lahore prastav ka samarthan kiya gaya. Iske baad 19 April 1940 ko Bihar ke kai sthanon par Pakistan Day manaya gaya tatha sabhaon me Lahore prastav ko padhkar paarit kiya gaya. Lekin Bihar ki Ahrar Party tatha Momin samuh ne in gatividhiyon ki ninda ki, kyunki do rashtriya dhaaron ka siddhant unhe manzoor nahi tha. Isse pata chalta hai ki Bharat ki tarah Bihar ki rajnitik me bhi is samay sampradayik daraar badh rahi thi, jabki Congress vibhajan ka virodh karti rahi. Exam point: 13-14 April 1940 ko Chapra me hui Muslim League ki Bihar shakha ke sammelan ne Lahore prastav ka samarthan kiya tatha 19 April 1940 ko Bihar me Pakistan Day manaya gaya.

qe: In the firing at the Patna Secretariat on 11 August 1942, how many rounds were fired at the approaching crowd, and how many students were killed?
qh: 11 अगस्त 1942 को पटना सचिवालय पर हुई गोलीबारी में आते हुए जुलूस पर कितनी राउंड गोलियाँ चलाई गईं तथा कितने विद्यार्थी शहीद हुए?
oe: About thirteen or fourteen rounds; seven students
oh: लगभग तेरह या चौदह राउंड; सात विद्यार्थी
e: 11 August 1942 ko Patna me Secretariat par jhanda fahrane ke liye aage badh rahi bheed par, District Magistrate ke aadesh par, Secretariat ke parisar se lagbhag terah ya chaudah round goli chalayi gayi. Is goli chalane ka samay dopahar ke lagbhag pauh chaar saptah paanch baje ke aas-paas tha. Is goli se sabse aage khade saat vidyarthi shaheed ho gaye tatha lagbhag pachees vidyarthi gambhir roop se ghayal hue tatha kuch ko halki chot lagi. Shaheed hone wale saat vidyarthiyon me Umakant Prasad Sinha, Ramanand Singh, Satish Prasad Jha, Jagatpati Kumar, Devi Pada Chaudhury, Rajendra Singh tatha Ramgovind Singh shaamil the, jo Patna ke alag-alag school tatha college ke chhatra the. Is balidan ne poore prant me aag si laga di. Exam point: 11 August 1942 ko Patna Secretariat se lagbhag terah-chaudah round goli chalayi gayi, jisme saat vidyarthi shaheed tatha lagbhag pachees ghayal hue.

qe: On suspicion of complicity in the Hazaribagh escape plot, which three leaders were removed to the Bhagalpur jail?
qh: हजारीबाग से भागने की योजना में शामिल होने के संदेह में किन तीन नेताओं को भागलपुर जेल भेजा गया?
oe: Shaligram Singh, Gulab Sonar and Suraj Narain Singh
Jai Prakash Narain, Ramnandan Misra and Yogendra Sukul
Ram Narain Singh, Krishna Ballabh Sahay and Sukhlal Singh
Rajendra Prasad, Anugraha Narain Sinha and Syed Mahmud
oh: शालीग्राम सिंह, गुलाब सोनार तथा सूरज नारायण सिंह
जयप्रकाश नारायण, रामनंदन मिश्र तथा योगेंद्र सुकुल
राम नारायण सिंह, कृष्ण बल्लभ सहाय तथा सुखलाल सिंह
राजेंद्र प्रसाद, अनुग्रह नारायण सिंह तथा सैयद महमूद
e: Quit India andolan ke dauran sarkar ko shak tha ki Hazaribagh jail se kaidiyon ke bhaagne ki yojna me kuchh bahar ke logon ka bhi haath tha. Isi sandeh ke aadhaar par Ram Narain Singh, Krishna Ballabh Sahay tatha Sukhlal Singh ko Hazaribagh se hata kar Bhagalpur jail bhej diya gaya. Yeh teenon Bihar ke jaane-maane Congress neta the, jo Congress sangathan tatha prashasan ke mahatvapurn kamon se jude rahe the. Is karyavahi se saabit hota hai ki sarkar ne sirf bhaagne walon par hi nahi, balki unke sambhavit sahayakon par bhi sakht karyavahi ki. Isi samay bhaag nikle neta alag-alag raste pakadkar Gaya zile me pahunche tatha vahan unme se kuch Uttar Bharat ki taraf badhe tatha kuch Banaras ki or. Exam point: bhaagne ki yojna me sandeh ke aadhaar par Ram Narain Singh, Krishna Ballabh Sahay tatha Sukhlal Singh ko Hazaribagh se Bhagalpur jail bheja gaya tha.

qe: After condemning the August Offer of 1940, which form of protest did the Congress adopt under Mahatma Gandhi's guidance, in which only chosen individuals offered disobedience?
qh: 1940 के अगस्त प्रस्ताव की निंदा के बाद महात्मा गांधी के मार्गदर्शन में कांग्रेस ने किस प्रकार का आंदोलन अपनाया, जिसमें केवल चुने हुए व्यक्ति ही अवज्ञा करते थे?
e: Viceroy ke 8 August 1940 ke bayan ko, jo August Offer yaani agast prastav ke naam se jaana jata hai, Congress ne ninda ke yogya bataya tatha kaha ki isse sanvaidhanik gatirodh door nahi hoga. Bihar me Congress vidhan mandal ke sadasyon ne 13 August 1940 ko baithak karke Viceroy ki is ghoshna ke khilaf virodh kiya. British sarkar ki Bharat-neeti ke virudh ek naitik virodh ke roop me Gandhiji ke nirdeshan me tay hua ki 'Individual Civil Disobedience' yaani vyaktigat savinay avajna shuru ki jaye, jisme bahut chune hue vyakti hi kanoon todkar giraftari dete the, taaki yuddh ke samay jan-savinay avajna se sarkar ko koi asuvidha na ho. Bihar ka is andolan me pratikriya tez tatha utsahapurna rahi. Congress ne ise lagbhag chaudah mahine chalane ke baad kuchh vyavaharik karyanon ke karan sthagit kar diya. Exam point: August Offer ki ninda ke baad vyaktigat savinay avajna shuru hui, jisme chune hue vyakti kanoon todte the tatha Bihar ne isme tez pratikriya dikhayi.

qe: Following the wide popular upheaval after 11 August 1942, which kinds of acts were committed by the agitators to paralyse the administration?
qh: 11 अगस्त 1942 के बाद फैले जन-आक्रोश में प्रशासन को ठप करने के लिए आंदोलनकारियों ने किस प्रकार के कार्य किए?
oe: Only peaceful fasts were observed in every district
Government buildings were occupied and run by elected panchayats everywhere
Roads were blocked and no other action was taken
Railway lines were uprooted, telegraph and telephone wires damaged and police stations and post offices attacked
oh: हर जिले में केवल शांतिपूर्ण उपवास किए गए
सरकारी भवनों पर कब्जा कर हर जगह निर्वाचित पंचायतें चलाई गईं
सड़कें जाम की गईं तथा और कोई कार्रवाई नहीं की गई
रेल लाइनें उखाड़ी गईं, तार तथा टेलीफोन काटे गए तथा थानों व डाकघरों पर हमले हुए
e: Saat vidyarthiyon ke balidan ke baad Bihar me ek vishal jan-virodh swatah shuru ho gaya. Is aakrosh ka roop kabhi-kabhi hinsak ho jata tha. Angreji satta ka sahara dene wali vyavastha ko lampat karne ke liye andolankaariyon ne railway ki patriyan ukhaad di, taar tatha telefon ki lines ko nuksan pahunchaya, thaanon par hamla kiya tatha kai jagah unhe jalaya, tatha dakgharon tatha anya sarkari bhavanon par kabza kar liya. In kaaryon ke karan prashasan ke amla ke saath takraar hui tatha kuch adhikaari bhi janta ke gusse ke aage kamzor pad gaye. Itihas me yeh saaf kaha gaya hai ki yeh hinsak ghatnaye swatah tatha bina kisi yojna ke hue; na Congress ne aur na uske netaon ne aise kaaryakram ki anumati di thi. Exam point: 11 August 1942 ke baad andolankaariyon ne rail patriyan ukhaadkar, taar-telefon todkar tatha thana-dakgharon par hamla karke prashasan ko lampat karne ki koshish ki.

qe: The 1942 movement in Bihar had a constructive aspect also; experiments in people's rule by building a structure of national government from the bottom, known by which name, were successfully made at Saharsa and Supaul?
qh: 1942 के बिहार आंदोलन का रचनात्मक पक्ष भी था; नीचे से राष्ट्रीय सरकार का ढाँचा खड़ा करके जन-शासन स्थापित करने के प्रयोग, जिन्हें किस नाम से जाना जाता है, सहरसा तथा सुपौल क्षेत्रों में सफलतापूर्वक किए गए?
e: Quit India andolan ke dauran Bihar me sirf virodh hi nahi hua; andolan ka ek rachnatmak paksha bhi tha. Iska uddeshya tha nichele star se rashtriya sarkar ka dhancha khada karke logon ka apna shasan yaani people's rule sthapit karna. Isi kram me Saharsa tatha Supaul kshetron me Panchayat Raj ke prayog safaltapurn dhang se kiye gaye, jisme gaon-walo ne apne sthitik nikaayon ke zariye karyabhaar sambhala tatha sabhi aam prashasan ke faisle swayam liye. Isse saabit hua ki sabse kathin dabav ke samay bhi Bihar ki janata ek vikalpik vyavastha chala sakti thi tatha sarkar ke bina bhi prashasan sambhav hai. Aise prayasun ne aage swatantrata ke baad panchayati vyavastha ke vichar ka aadhaar bhi majboot kiya. Exam point: 1942 ke Bihar andolan ke dauran Saharsa tatha Supaul me Panchayat Raj ke prayog - yaani nichle star se rashtriya sarkar ka dhancha - safaltapurn dhang se kiye gaye.

qe: In the House of Commons statement of early October 1942 about Bihar, it was disclosed that on how many occasions were mobs machine-gunned from the air, following an aeroplane crash on 18 September?
qh: अक्टूबर 1942 के आरंभ में बिहार के संबंध में हाउस ऑफ कॉमन्स के किस वक्तव्य में बताया गया कि 18 सितंबर की विमान दुर्घटना के बाद कितनी बार भीड़ पर हवा से मशीनगन चलाई गई?
e: 1942 ke andolan ko dabane ke liye angreji sarkar ne har tarah ke julum ka sahara liya. Shasan ke Secretary of State Mr L. S. Amery ne October 1942 ke shuruaat me House of Commons me bataya ki haal ke upadravon me bheedon par paanch baar havai jahaz se machine-gun chalayi gayi tatha 18 September ko Bihar me hue ek hawaee jahaz durghatna me pilot ki maut ho gayi tatha jahaz ke crew ke sadasyaon ko bheed ne maar diya, jiske baad sabotage yaani tod-phod rokne ke liye hawaee jahazon ka upyog aavashyak ho gaya. Is bayan ke sahaare sarkar ne yeh saabit karne ki koshish ki janta ke virodh ko dabane ke liye aise sakht tareeke zaroori the, lekin janta par iska ulta asar pada tatha virodh aur gehra hota gaya. Exam point: October 1942 me House of Commons me bataya gaya ki bheedon par paanch baar hawa se machine-gun chalayi gayi tatha 18 September ko Bihar me ek hawaee jahaz durghatna bhi hui.

qe: When intense Government repression drove the movement underground, many patriots of Bihar went to which region, where local people gave them sympathy and assistance?
qh: कठोर सरकारी दमन से आंदोलन भूमिगत हो जाने पर बिहार के अनेक देशभक्त किस क्षेत्र में चले गए, जहाँ के स्थानीय लोगों ने उन्हें सहानुभूति तथा सहायता दी?
e: October-November 1942 tak andolan me kuch thahraav aaya, lekin virodh poori tarah khatm nahi hua; kathor dabaav ne asantosh ko bhoomigat yaani underground bana diya. Is nayi avastha me Bihar ke bahut se deshbhakt sarhad paar karke Nepal ki tarai me chale gaye, jahan ke sthanik logon ne unhe sahanubhuti tatha sahayata di. Wahan unme se kuch logon ne hathiyar, goli-barood, bhale tatha anya astra-shastra bhi ikattha kiye, taaki aage sangharsh jaari rakha ja sake. Is tarah nepal ki tarai Quit India ke bhoomigat daur ka ek mahatvapurn adhda ban gaya. Isi kshetra me aage chal kar Jaiprakash Narain tatha unke saathiyon ne 'Azad Dasta' naam ki guerilla toliyan bhi banayi, jo sarkar ke liye chunauti ban gayin. Exam point: 1942 me sakht daman ke baad Bihar ke kai deshbhakt Nepal ki tarai me chale gaye, jahan unhe sahanubhuti tatha sahayata mili tatha unhone astra-shastra bhi ikattha kiye.

qe: As against the Congress demand of Quit India, the Muslim League raised which new slogan, with its Bihar Provincial unit becoming enthusiastic about it?
qh: कांग्रेस की 'भारत छोड़ो' मांग के विरुद्ध मुस्लिम लीग ने कौन-सा नया नारा दिया, जिसके प्रति बिहार की प्रांतीय इकाई उत्साहित हो गई?
e: Quit India andolan ke baad desh me sampradayik matbhed badhta gaya. Congress ki maang thi ki angrej Bharat chhod de, lekin Muslim League ne iske jawab me ek naya nara diya - 'Divide and Quit' yaani pehle desh ko baanto aur phir jao. Muslim League ki Pakistan ki maang zyada sakht hoti gayi tatha Bihar me bhi uski provincial unit is vichar ke prati utsaahit ho gayi. March 1943 me Mr Jinnah ne kaha ki 'Pakistan hamari apariwartaniya tatha na badalne wali rashtriya maang hai; hum united India ke aadhaar par kisi bhi samvidhan ko sweekar nahi karenge.' In bayanon ka Bihar par bhi bura asar pada tatha aage chal kar prant me sampradayik tanav badha. Exam point: Congress ke 'Quit India' ke mukable Muslim League ka nara 'Divide and Quit' tha tatha March 1943 me Jinnah ne Pakistan ko apariwartaniya rashtriya maang kaha.

qe: After the Quit India Movement, which revolutionary group of Bihar, named after its leader, was the most active in paralysing the Government and also worked in the Santhal Parganas?
qh: भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन के बाद बिहार का कौन-सा क्रांतिकारी दल, जो अपने नेता के नाम पर बना था, सरकार को ठप करने में सबसे सक्रिय रहा तथा संताल परगना में भी काम करता रहा?
oe: Suraj Dal, after Suraj Narain Singh
oh: योगेंद्र दल, योगेंद्र सुकुल के नाम पर
सूरज दल, सूरज नारायण सिंह के नाम पर
सियाराम दल, सियाराम सिंह के नाम पर
शालीग्राम दल, शालीग्राम सिंह के नाम पर
e: 1942 ke baad Bihar me bhoomigat kaam karne wale kai krantikari samooh bane. Inme sabse sakriya samooh Siyaram Dal ke naam se jaana gaya, jo apne neta Siyaram Singh ke naam par bana tha tatha jo sarkar ki vyavastha ko todne wali gatividhiyon me sabse aage raha. Isi tarah ke kuchh samooh Santhal Parganas me bhi kaam kar rahe the. Congress Socialists ke netaon ka bhi is karyakram me bada yogdan raha, jaisa ki Azad Dasta ke sangathan se pata chalta hai. In sabke saath-saath un Congressjanon ka bhi dhyan rakhna zaroori hai jo jailon se bahar the tatha jinhone shaant tatha rachnatmak kaam ke zariye rashtriya sangharsh ka utsaah zinda rakha. Exam point: Quit India ke baad Bihar me sabse sakriya krantikari samooh 'Siyaram Dal' tha, jo apne neta Siyaram Singh ke naam par bana tatha Santhal Parganas me bhi sakriya raha.

qe: Some months after the Hanuman-nagar jail episode, where was Jai Prakash Narain overtaken by the police, before being arrested at Mughalpura?
qh: हनुमाननगर जेल की घटना के कुछ महीनों बाद पुलिस ने जयप्रकाश नारायण को कहाँ पकड़ लिया, जिसके बाद मुगलपुरा में उन्हें गिरफ्तार किया गया?
e: Hanuman-nagar jail se chhootne ke baad Jaiprakash Narain phir bhoomigat jeevan me laut gaye tatha Nepal ki tarai tatha anya sthanon par apni gatividhiyan jaari rakheen. Kuchh hi mahine baad punjab me police ne unhe Amritsar me pakad liya tatha Mughalpura me unhe giraftar kar liya gaye. Iske saath Bihar me bhi kuchh krantikari samooh sarkar ko lampat karne wali gatividhiyon me lage rahe. Unke saathiyon me Nepal camp ke ek mukhya prashikshak bhi the, jo thodi hi der baad Sonbarsa me ladhte hue shaheed ho gaye. Isse saabit hota hai ki 1942 ke baad bhi angreji sarkar ke liye Bihar ke neta sabse bada saradard tha tatha woh unhe pakadne ke liye koshish karti rahi. Exam point: Hanuman-nagar jail ki ghatna ke kuchh mahine baad Jaiprakash Narain ko Amritsar me pakad kar Mughalpura me giraftar kiya gaya tatha Nepal camp ka ek mukhya prashikshak Sonbarsa me shaheed hua.

qe: Who succeeded Lord Linlithgow as Governor-General of India in mid-October 1943?
qh: अक्टूबर 1943 के मध्य में लॉर्ड लिनलिथगो के बाद भारत का गवर्नर-जनरल कौन बना?
e: Lord Linlithgow ne doosre vishwa yuddh ke shuruati varshon me Bharat ke Governor-General yaani vayasiraay ke roop me kaam kiya. October 1943 ke madhya me unki jagah Lord Wavell ne Governor-General ka pad sambhala. Us samay desh me sthit bahut gambhir tatha uljhi hui thi, kyunki ek taraf yuddh ka sankat tha, doosri taraf sanvaidhanik gatirodh tatha sampradayik matbhed jaise badi samasyaein maujud theen. Bihar me bhi 1942 ke andolan ke baad sarkari daman ka daur chal raha tha tatha Muslim League ki Pakistan ki maang ke karan sampradayik vaatavaran kharab ho raha tha. Isi karan aise samay me vayasaray ke badlav ko bahut mahatvapurn maana gaya. Exam point: October 1943 ke madhya me Lord Linlithgow ke sthan par Lord Wavell Bharat ke Governor-General bane, jab desh me yuddh, gatirodh tatha sampradayik tanav ki sthiti thi.

qe: Which of the following occasions of national importance began to be celebrated in Bihar in 1944 and 1945, along with the collection for the Kasturba Fund and the sale of khadi?
qh: 1944 तथा 1945 में कस्तूरबा फंड के संग्रह तथा खादी की बिक्री के साथ-साथ बिहार में कौन-से राष्ट्रीय महत्व के अवसर मनाए जाने लगे?
oe: Independence Day, Gandhi Day, National Week and the anniversary of 9 August 1942
Republic Day, Children's Day and the anniversary of Quit India
Hindu Mahasabha Day, Pakistan Day and the anniversary of the Lahore resolution
Martyr's Day, Flag Day and the anniversary of the Dandi march
oh: स्वतंत्रता दिवस, गांधी दिवस, राष्ट्रीय सप्ताह तथा 9 अगस्त 1942 की वर्षगांठ
गणतंत्र दिवस, बाल दिवस तथा भारत छोड़ो की वर्षगांठ
हिंदू महासभा दिवस, पाकिस्तान दिवस तथा लाहौर प्रस्ताव की वर्षगांठ
शहीद दिवस, ध्वज दिवस तथा दांडी मार्च की वर्षगांठ
e: 1944 tatha 1945 me rashtriya sainikon ki kramik rihai shuru hone lage. Iske saath hi rachnatmak karya tatha samajik seva phir se zinda ho gayi. Bihar me kasthurba fund ke liye sangrah tatha khadi ki bikri jaari rahi. Iske saath-saath rashtriya mahatva ke vishesh avsar - Independence Day, Gandhi Day, National Week tatha 9 August 1942 ki varshgath (yaani us din ki smriti) manaye jaane lage. Yeh sab karyakram un Congressjanon ke prayas the jo jailon se bahar the tatha jinhone janata ka utsaah zinda rakha. Aise ayojan se yeh saabit hua ki dabav ke baad bhi sangathan poori tarah khatm nahi hua tha tatha log rashtriya andolan ke liye taiyar the. Exam point: 1944-45 me Bihar me kasthurba fund sangrah tatha khadi bikri ke saath Independence Day, Gandhi Day, National Week tatha 9 August 1942 ki varshgath manayi jaane lagi.

qe: On 19 September 1945, the British Prime Minister Attlee and Lord Wavell made simultaneous announcements providing for elections to the Central and Provincial Legislatures in which season?
qh: 19 सितंबर 1945 को ब्रिटिश प्रधानमंत्री एटली तथा लॉर्ड वेवेल ने एक साथ घोषणाएँ कीं, जिसमें केंद्रीय तथा प्रांतीय विधान मंडलों के चुनाव किस मौसम में कराने की बात कही गई?
e: 19 September 1945 ko British pradhanmantri Mr Attlee tatha vayasiraay Lord Wavell ne ek saath ghoshnaein kar ke Bharat ki sanvaidhanik samasya ke samadhan ke liye kadam ghosit kiye. Isme yeh aasha jatayi gayi ki saare pranton me rajnitik neta hi mantriyal zimmedari sambhalenge tatha 1945-6 ki jade ki ritu me kendra tatha pranton ke vidhan mandalon ke chunav karaye jayenge. Wavell ne yeh bhi kaha ki uski sarkar jitni jaldi sambhav ho ek constitution-making body yaani samvidhan nirman samiti aayojit karne ka irada rakhti hai, tatha chunav ke nateejon ke prakashan ke baad ek Executive Council banane ki disha me kadam uthege jise mukhya Bharatiya dalon ka samarthan ho. Isi ghoshna ke baad chunavon ka daur shuru hua jisme Bihar me Congress ne zordar safalta pai. Exam point: 19 September 1945 ko Attlee tatha Wavell ki sanyukt ghoshna me 1945-6 ki jade ki ritu me kendra tatha prantiya vidhan mandalon ke chunav tatha samvidhan nirman samiti banane ka irada jataya gaya.

qe: By March 1946, in the Lower House of the Bihar Legislature of 152 members, how many seats did the Congress hold, and how many did the Muslim League hold?
qh: मार्च 1946 तक 152 सदस्यों वाली बिहार विधान सभा (निचले सदन) में कांग्रेस तथा मुस्लिम लीग के पास क्रमशः कितनी सीटें थीं?
e: March 1946 tak chunavon ka utsaah shaant ho gaya tatha Bihar vidhan sabha ke nichle sadan me dalon ki antim sthiti is prakar thi. Sadan me kul 152 sadasya the, jinme Congress ke paas 98 sithanein theen. Muslim League ke paas 34, Momins ke paas 5, Adivasis ke paas 3 tatha Independent yaani nirvalon ke paas 12 sithanein theen. Is sthiti ne saaf kar diya ki Bihar me Congress ka janadhar bahut vishal tha tatha prant ke rajnitik drishya par usi ka prabhutva tha. Isi bahumat ke aadhaar par 30 March 1946 ko Governor ne Shrikrishna Sinha ko mantrimandal banane ke liye aamantrit kiya, jisse Bihar me swatantrata se pehle ka aakhri Congress ministry bana tatha usne transfer of power tak prashasan sambhala. Exam point: March 1946 tak Bihar vidhan sabha ke 152 sadasya wale nichle sadan me Congress ke paas 98 tatha Muslim League ke paas 34 sithanein theen, jabki Momins 5, Adivasis 3 tatha nirval 12 sithanon ke saath the.

qe: The Cabinet Mission sent to India in 1946 consisted of which three members?
qh: 1946 में भारत भेजी गई कैबिनेट मिशन में कौन-से तीन सदस्य थे?
oe: Lord Wavell, Lord Mountbatten and Sir Stafford Cripps
Mr Attlee, Lord Pethick Lawrence and Mr A. V. Alexander
Sir Stafford Cripps, Lord Irwin and Mr Amery
Lord Pethick Lawrence, Sir Stafford Cripps and Mr A. V. Alexander
oh: लॉर्ड वेवेल, लॉर्ड माउंटबेटन तथा सर स्टैफर्ड क्रिप्स
श्री एटली, लॉर्ड पेथिक लॉरेंस तथा श्री ए. वी. अलेक्जेंडर
सर स्टैफर्ड क्रिप्स, लॉर्ड इरविन तथा श्री एमरी
लॉर्ड पेथिक लॉरेंस, सर स्टैफर्ड क्रिप्स तथा श्री ए. वी. अलेक्जेंडर
e: 1946 me sthit ko samjhkar British sarkar ne Bharat me ek Cabinet Mission bheji, jiska mukhya kaam sanvaidhanik gatirodh ka samadhan khojna tha. Is mission ke teen sadasya the - Lord Pethick Lawrence, jo Bharat ke Secretary of State the tatha mission ke adhyaksh the; Sir Stafford Cripps, jo Board of Trade ke president the; tatha Mr A. V. Alexander. Is mission ke prastavon ka Bihar ki rajnitik tatha sanvaidhanik sthiti par bhi gehra asar pada. Isi mission ne Union of India tatha samvidhan nirman samiti jaise vichar samne rakhe, jinpar aage ke saal me sanvaidhanik karyakram aage badha tatha Dr Rajendra Prasad jaise Bihar ke neta samvidhan nirman ki prakriya me pramukh bhumika nibhane wale bane. Exam point: 1946 ki Cabinet Mission me Lord Pethick Lawrence, Sir Stafford Cripps tatha Mr A. V. Alexander the, jisme Pethick Lawrence adhyaksh the.

qe: The opening session of the Indian Constituent Assembly was held at Delhi on 9 December 1946 under the presidentship of which leader, the most elderly member of the Assembly and a great son of Bihar?
qh: भारतीय संविधान सभा का प्रारंभिक अधिवेशन 9 दिसंबर 1946 को दिल्ली में किस नेता की अध्यक्षता में हुआ, जो सभा के सबसे वरिष्ठ सदस्य तथा बिहार के महान सपूत थे?
e: Samvidhan sabha ka pehla adhiveshan 9 December 1946 ko Delhi me shuru hua. Sabse umar-dar sadasya hone ke nate uske prarambhik adhiveshan ki adhyakshta Dr Sachchidanand Sinha ne ki. Woh Bihar ke mahatvapurn neta the tatha udarvadi rajniti ke liye jaane jaate the; isliye unhe Bihar ka mahaan sapoot kaha jaata hai. Us adhiveshan me Muslim League ke sadasya shaamil nahi hue, jisse sanvaidhanik kaam aasan nahi raha. Iske baad Dr Rajendra Prasad samvidhan sabha ke adhyaksh chune gaye tatha unhone samvidhan banane ki prakriya ka nirvahan kiya. Is tarah Bihar ke do bade netaon ko svatantra Bharat ke samvidhan nirman me sabse mahatvapurn bhumika nibhane ka avsar mila. Exam point: 9 December 1946 ko Delhi me samvidhan sabha ka pehla adhiveshan Bihar ke varshishth neta Dr Sachchidanand Sinha ki adhyakshta me shuru hua.

qe: Violent reactions in Bihar at the end of October 1946 followed outrages on the Hindu population of East Bengal affecting Dacca, Noakhali and Tipperah. Whose peace mission came to Bihar in March 1947 and again in April 1947 to restore harmony?
qh: अक्टूबर 1946 के अंत में बिहार में हुई हिंसक प्रतिक्रियाएँ पूर्वी बंगाल के हिंदू जनता पर हुए अत्याचारों की परिणति थीं, जिनसे ढाका, नोआखाली तथा तिपेरा प्रभावित हुए। सद्भाव बहाल करने के लिए मार्च 1947 तथा पुनः अप्रैल 1947 में किसका शांति मिशन बिहार आया?
e: Sampradayik samasya desh ki azaadi ke raaste ki sabse badi rukavat ban gayi. East Bengal me Hindu janata par hue atyacharon ne Dacca, Noakhali tatha Tipperah ko bahut prabhavit kiya. In ghatnaon ka asar Bihar par bhi pada tatha October 1946 ke ant me yahan vyapak sampradayik upadrav huye, jinme Musalman samuday ko bhari jaan-mal ki hani uthani padi. Dr Rajendra Prasad tatha Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru tatha anya netaon ne prabhavit kshetron ka daura kiya tatha Bihar sarkar ne turant kadam uthaye, jisse aur upadrav ruk gaye. Sabse bada kalyan-karya Mahatma Gandhi ka tha - unhone apne sandesh tatha shanti mission ke zariye March 1947 me tatha phir April 1947 me Bihar aakar janta ki bhhavnaon ko shaant karne ka kaam kiya. Exam point: October 1946 ke ant me Bihar ke sampradayik upadravon ke baad Dr Rajendra Prasad tatha Nehru ke daure ke saath Mahatma Gandhi ka shanti mission March 1947 tatha punah April 1947 me Bihar aaya.

qe: Lord Mountbatten came to India in March 1947 as successor to which Viceroy, and his plan of 3 June 1947 outlined the procedure for transfer of power?
qh: मार्च 1947 में लॉर्ड माउंटबेटन किस वायसराय के उत्तराधिकारी के रूप में भारत आए, तथा उनकी 3 जून 1947 की योजना ने सत्ता हस्तांतरण की प्रक्रिया निर्धारित की?
e: 20 February 1947 ko British pradhanmantri Mr Attlee ne ek mahatvapurn ghoshna ki, jisme unhone kaha ki British sarkar ka pakka irada hai ki June 1948 se pehle satta zimmedar Bharatiya haathon ko saunp di jayegi. Iske baad March 1947 me Lord Mountbatten Lord Wavell ke uttaradhikari ke roop me Bharat aaye tatha unhone satta hastantaran ki prakriya ko tez kar diya. 3 June 1947 ki apni yojna me unhone vartaman paristhitiyon me satta hastantaran ki prakriya ka ullekh kiya. Is yojna me desh ke vibhajan ka prastav sabse gambhir kami thi. All India Congress Committee ne 3 June 1947 ki yojna ko sweekar kiya, lekin yeh kaha ki isse desh ke kuchh bhaagon ka alag ho jana sambhav hai. Bihar me aam janmat ne vibhajan ka dukh jataya, phir bhi vyavaharikta ke saath isse sweekar kiya. Exam point: March 1947 me Lord Mountbatten Lord Wavell ke uttaradhikari bane tatha 3 June 1947 ki yojna ke zariye satta hastantaran ki prakriya tay hui, jisme vibhajan ka prastav bhi tha.

qe: Who was appointed Governor of Bihar and took the oath of office at midnight on 14 August 1947?
qh: 14 अगस्त 1947 की आधी रात को बिहार का राज्यपाल नियुक्त होकर किसने पद की शपथ ली?
e: Indian Independence Act ke aadhaar par 15 August 1947 ko Bharat swatantra hua tatha yeh din desh ke itihas ka svarnim din bana. Bihar me swatantrata diwas ka utsav apar kamp tatha josh ke saath manaya gaya; chhoti-chhoti matbhed bhulakar logon ne ek saath khushi manai ki Bharat ko azaadi mil gayi. Shri Jairamdas Daulatram ko Bihar ka Governor niyukt kiya gaya tatha unhone 14 August 1947 ki aadhi raat ko pad tatha gopniyata ki shapath li. Us samay prant me Congress ki sarkar thi, jiske mukhiya Shrikrishna Sinha the, aur yahi ministry sattantaran tak Bihar ka prashasan chalti rahi. Is tarah ek lambi aur balidan-bhari ladai ke baad Bihar bhi swatantra Bharat ka ek mahatvapurn ang bana. Exam point: 14 August 1947 ki aadhi raat ko Shri Jairamdas Daulatram ne Bihar ke Governor ke roop me shapath li tatha agle din prant bhar me swatantrata diwas dhoom-dham se manaya gaya.

qe: Which woman leader was arrested at Patna on 28 April 1944 along with other Congress workers who had been absconding?
qh: 28 अप्रैल 1944 को पटना में किस महिला नेता को अन्य फरार कांग्रेस कार्यकर्ताओं के साथ गिरफ्तार किया गया?
e: Quit India ke baad Bihar me kai Congress karyakarta bhoomigat ho gaye the tatha sarkar unhe pakadne ke liye lagatar koshish kar rahi thi. April 1944 me aise kuchh pramukh Congress karyakarta giraftar kar liye gaye. Isi kram me 28 April 1944 ko Patna me Sucheta Kripalani ko bhi giraftar kiya gaya. Sucheta Kripalani apne pati Acharya Kripalani ke saath rashtriya andolan me sakriya thin tatha unka yogdan Bihar tatha desh ke anya bhagon me raha. Mahila netaon ki yeh giraftari is baat ka praman hai ki 1942 ke baad bhi andolan me mahilaon ki bhumika kam nahi hui thi tatha woh purushon ke saath hi jail jane ke liye taiyar thin. Exam point: 28 April 1944 ko Patna me Sucheta Kripalani tatha kuchh anya farari Congress karyakarta giraftar kiye gaye the.

qe: In December 1945, out of the 10 seats for Bihar in the Central Assembly, how many general constituency seats did the Congress obtain?
qh: दिसंबर 1945 में केंद्रीय विधान सभा में बिहार की 10 सीटों में से कांग्रेस ने कितनी सामान्य निर्वाचन क्षेत्र की सीटें जीतीं?
e: 1945-6 ke chunavon ko Congress ne rashtriya andolan ko aage badhane ka sadhan maana. Party ka maksad sirf satta paana nahi tha; usne kaha ki chunav isliye lade ja rahe hain ki logon ki krantikari ichchha saabit ho tatha in chunavon se Bharat ki swatantrata ki ladai ko aage badhaya jaye. Bihar me Dr Rajendra Prasad tatha anya Congress netaon ke athak prayason se party ko safalta mili. December 1945 me kendra ki vidhan sabha me Bihar ki kul 10 sithanon me se Congress ne 6 saamaanya nirvachan kshetra yaani general constituency ki sithanein jeeti. Is safalta ne saabit kiya ki angreji sarkar ki sakht karyavahi ke bawajood Bihar ki janata ka vishwas Congress par sthir tha tatha woh swatantrata ke liye poori tarah taiyar thi. Exam point: December 1945 me kendra ki vidhan sabha me Bihar ki 10 sithanon me se Congress ne 6 saamaanya nirvachan kshetra ki sithanein jeeti.

qe: When the Governor of Bihar formally asked for Shrikrishna Sinha's assistance in forming a Ministry on 30 March 1946, at what time did Shrikrishna Sinha, Anugraha Narain Sinha and Syed Mahmud take the oaths of office?
qh: 30 मार्च 1946 को बिहार के राज्यपाल ने जब श्रीकृष्ण सिंह से मंत्रिमंडल बनाने में सहायता मांगी, तो श्रीकृष्ण सिंह, अनुग्रह नारायण सिंह तथा सैयद महमूद ने किस समय पद तथा गोपनीयता की शपथ ली?
e: 30 March 1946 ko Bihar ke Governor ne aupcharik roop se Shrikrishna Sinha se mantrimandal banane me sahayata maangi. Usi din subah 11 baje Shrikrishna Sinha, Anugraha Narain Sinha tatha Syed Mahmud ne pad tatha gopniyata ki shapath le li. Jaglal Choudhury ko jail se riha karke ministry ka chautha mantri banaya gaya, jisse yeh saabit hua ki ab sarkar banane ke liye Congress netaon ko jail se bahar aana pad raha tha. Kuchh hi dinon me mantri parishad ka vistar karke paanch aur sadasya shaamil kiye gaye, jisse ministry zyada vistrit tatha pratinidhik ban gayi. Kuchh ativadi tatvon tatha Muslim League ke sadasyaon ke alawa sabhi vargon ne is ministry ke gathan ka swagat kiya. Exam point: 30 March 1946 ko subah 11 baje Shrikrishna Sinha, Anugraha Narain Sinha tatha Syed Mahmud ne shapath li tatha Jaglal Choudhury jail se riha hokar chautha mantri bane.

qe: Which of the following was NOT one of the main recommendations of the Cabinet Mission?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी कैबिनेट मिशन की मुख्य सिफारिशों में शामिल नहीं थी?
oe: Immediate transfer of power to a single party government at the centre
A Union of India embracing British India and the Indian States, dealing with Foreign Affairs, Defence and Communications
Grouping of the provinces into sections A, B and C
oh: संविधान निर्माण करने वाली संस्था का गठन
केंद्र में तुरंत किसी एक दल की सरकार को सत्ता हस्तांतरण
ब्रिटिश भारत तथा देशी रियासतों को मिलाकर भारत संघ, जो विदेश, रक्षा तथा संचार जैसे विषयों को देखे
प्रांतों का समूहीकरण खंड ए, बी तथा सी में
e: Cabinet Mission ne apni sifarishen sabke samne rakhi. Iski mukhya sifarishen thin - pehli, ek Union of India yaani bharat sangh banaya jaye, jisme British India tatha deshi riyasaten dono shaamil hon tatha jo videsh, raksha tatha sanchar jaise vishayon ko dekhe; doosri, pranton ka samuhikaran yaani grouping A, B tatha C sections me kiya jaye; tatha teesri, ek samvidhan nirman karne wali sanstha yaani constitution-making body bulayi jaye. Kendra me turant kisi ek dal ki sarkar ko satta hastantaran ki sifarish is mission me nahi thi; sattain transfer aage ki prakriya me hui. Iski sifarishen kisi bhi varg ko poori tarah santusht nahi kar payin. Muslim League ne kendra me 10 saal ke liye sangh tatha chhah Muslim pranton ke alag samuhikran ko sweekar karne ki baat kahi, jabki Congress ne mission ke 16 May ke bayan ke deerghkalin prastav ko sweekar kiya. Exam point: Cabinet Mission ki sifarishon me bharat sangh, pranton ka samuhikaran tatha samvidhan nirman sanstha ka gathan shaamil thi; kendra me turant kisi ek dal ko satta hastantaran ki sifarish usme nahi thi.

qe: When the Muslim League withdrew its acceptance of the Cabinet Mission proposals and called upon Muslims to resort to direct action, on which date did the 'Great Calcutta Killing' take place?
qh: जब मुस्लिम लीग ने कैबिनेट मिशन के प्रस्तावों की स्वीकृति वापस लेकर मुसलमानों को सीधी कार्रवाई करने का आह्वान किया, तो 'ग्रेट कलकत्ता किलिंग' किस तिथि को हुई?
e: Samvidhan sabha ke chunavon me Congress ke bade bahumat ke baad Muslim League ne apna svikriti wapas le liya tatha Musalmanon se kaha ki jahan zaroorat ho wahan Pakistan ke liye seedhi karyawahi ki jaye. Isi avahan par 16 August 1946 ko Calcutta me danga bhadka, jisme bahut bhayankar hinsa hui tatha bade paimane par jaan-mal ki hani hui. Is ghatna ko us samay ke ek pramukh angreji samachar patra ne 'Great Calcutta Killing' ke naam se pukara. Bihar me us samay iska koi tatkalik asar nahi dikha, sirf ek-do chhoti ghatnayein hui. Lekin desh ke anya bhagon me sampradayik tanav badhta gaya, jiska asar aage chalkar Bihar par bhi pada tatha October ke ant me yahan vyapak sampradayik upadrav huye. Exam point: Muslim League ke seedhi karyawahi ke avahan par 16 August 1946 ko Calcutta me hui hinsa ko 'Great Calcutta Killing' kaha gaya, jabki Bihar me us samay koi bada tatkalik asar nahi dikha.

qe: In the afternoon of 15 August 1947, whose memorial did the Governor of Bihar lay the foundation stone of, at the spot in front of the Secretariat where the seven martyrs had sacrificed their lives?
qh: 15 अगस्त 1947 की दोपहर बिहार के राज्यपाल ने उसी स्थान पर, जहाँ सचिवालय के सामने सात शहीदों ने अपने प्राण न्योछावर किए थे, किस स्मारक की नींव रखी?
e: 15 August 1947 ko Bihar me swatantrata ka utsav bahut josh ke saath manaya gaya. Us din dopahar Governor Shri Jairamdas Daulatram ne Patna ke Secretariat ke saamne us sthan par shahid smarak ki neev ki shila rakhi, jahan 11 August 1942 ko saat vidyarthi swatantrata ke liye shaheed hue the. Is smarak ke zariye Bihar ne un balidanon ko sthayi samman diya, jinhone angreji goli ka saamna karke prant me andolan ki aag aur tez kar di thi. Yahi saat vidyarthi - Umakant Prasad Sinha, Ramanand Singh, Satish Prasad Jha, Jagatpati Kumar, Devi Pada Chaudhury, Rajendra Singh tatha Ramgovind Singh the. Yah kahawat ki shahidon ka rakt hi rashtra ki neev banta hai, Bihar ke sandarbh me poore roop se sahi sabit hui. Exam point: 15 August 1947 ki dopahar ko Governor ne Secretariat ke saamne us sthan par shahid smarak ki neev rakhi, jahan 11 August 1942 ko saat vidyarthi shaheed hue the.

qe: Mahatma Gandhi was released in May 1944 on grounds of health; his release marked the beginning of fresh negotiations which ultimately resulted in which Act passed by the British Parliament in 1946?
qh: मई 1944 में महात्मा गांधी को स्वास्थ्य के आधार पर रिहा किया गया; इस वर्णन के अनुसार उनकी रिहाई से शुरू हुई नई वार्ताओं का परिणाम 1946 में ब्रिटिश संसद द्वारा पारित कौन-सा अधिनियम बना?
e: May 1944 me Gandhiji ko unke swasthya ke aadhaar par riha kiya gaya. Andolan poori tarah khatm nahi hua tha tatha sarkar se unki vartayen bhi apne aap shuru ho gayin. Yeh rihai aise samjhauta yaani negotiation ki shuruaat maani jaati hai jiska antim parinam yeh hua ki British Parliament ne 1946 me ek aisa adhiniyam paarit kiya jisse Bharat ka rasta khul gaya. Isi ke baad March 1946 me Cabinet Mission Bharat aayi tatha Constituent Assembly ke chunavon ka rasta banaya gaya. Is tarah 1942 ke sakht daman ke bawajood rashtriya andolan apne lakshya ke bilkul kareeb pahunch chuka tha tatha Bihar ke neta jaise Dr Rajendra Prasad tatha Jaiprakash Narain aage ki vaartao tatha sanvaidhanik sadan me pramukh bhumika nibhane wale the. Exam point: May 1944 me Gandhiji ki rihai ke baad shuru hui vartao ka antim parinam 1946 me British Parliament dwara paarit Independence of India Act tha.

qe: Which of the following leaders were among the five more members added to the Bihar Council of Ministers in early April 1946?
qh: अप्रैल 1946 के आरंभ में बिहार के मंत्रिपरिषद में शामिल किए गए पाँच और सदस्यों में निम्नलिखित में से कौन थे?
oe: Sahajanand Saraswati, Shibhadra Yajee, Ramnandan Misra and two others
Ramcharitar Singh, Acharya Badrinath Varma, Krishna Ballabh Sahay, Pandit Binodanand Jha and Abdul Qaiyum Ansari
Rajendra Prasad, Sachchidanand Sinha, Shrikrishna Sinha, Syed Mahmud and Jaglal Choudhury
Jaiprakash Narain, Sucheta Kripalani, Suraj Narain Singh and two others
oh: सहजानंद सरस्वती, शिभद्र याजी, रामनंदन मिश्र तथा दो अन्य
रामचरितर सिंह, आचार्य बद्रीनाथ वर्मा, कृष्ण बल्लभ सहाय, पंडित बिनोदानंद झा तथा अब्दुल कयूम अंसारी
राजेंद्र प्रसाद, सच्चिदानंद सिन्हा, श्रीकृष्ण सिंह, सैयद महमूद तथा जगलाल चौधरी
जयप्रकाश नारायण, सुचेता कृपलानी, सूरज नारायण सिंह तथा दो अन्य
e: 30 March 1946 ko bane mantrimandal me shuru me Shrikrishna Sinha, Anugraha Narain Sinha, Syed Mahmud tatha Jaglal Choudhury shaamil the. Kuchh hi dinon me mantri parishad ka vistar kiya gaya tatha paanch aur sadasya mantri banaye gaye - Ramcharitar Singh, Acharya Badrinath Varma, Krishna Ballabh Sahay, Pandit Binodanand Jha tatha Abdul Qaiyum Ansari. Is tarah yeh ministry Bihar ka aakhri Congress ministry bana, jisne san 1947 me transfer of power yaani sattantaran tak prashasan chalaya. In mantriyon me kai voh bhi the jinhone Quit India andolan me jail ya bhoomigat jeevan jhela tha. Is vistar se ministry vistrit aadhaar wali ban gayi, jisse prant me shaant tatha vyavasthit roop se samvidhanik karyakram aage badha. Exam point: April 1946 me vistarit Bihar mantri parishad me Ramcharitar Singh, Acharya Badrinath Varma, Krishna Ballabh Sahay, Pandit Binodanand Jha tatha Abdul Qaiyum Ansari shaamil kiye gaye the.

qe: On which date did the Congress decide to join the proposed Constituent Assembly with a view to framing the constitution of a free, united and democratic India?
qh: कांग्रेस ने स्वतंत्र, संयुक्त तथा लोकतांत्रिक भारत का संविधान बनाने के उद्देश्य से प्रस्तावित संविधान सभा में शामिल होने का निर्णय किस तिथि को लिया?
e: Cabinet Mission ke bayan ke baad Congress ke saamne nirnay lena tha ki samvidhan nirman ki prakriya me shaamil hona chahiye ya nahi. Congress ne mission ke 16 May ke bayan me diye gaye deerghkalin prastav ko sweekar kiya tatha 26 June 1946 ko nirnay liya ki woh prastavit Constituent Assembly yaani samvidhan sabha me is uddeshya se shaamil hogi ki ek swatantra, sanyukt tatha loktantrik Bharat ka samvidhan banaya jaye. Is nirnay ke baad July 1946 me samvidhan sabha ke liye chunav huye, jisme Congress ke sadasya bade bahumat me chune gaye. Bihar se Congress ke naamit prastaviton me Dr Rajendra Prasad, prant ke Chief Minister, Finance Minister tatha Dr Sachchidanand Sinha jaise pramukh neta shaamil the. Iske baad Muslim League ne apna svikriti wapas le li tatha police action ka nara diya. Exam point: Congress ne 16 May ke bayan ke deerghkalin prastav ko sweekar karke 26 June 1946 ko Constituent Assembly me shaamil hone ka nirnay liya, jiska uddeshya swatantra, sanyukt tatha loktantrik Bharat ka samvidhan banana tha.

qe: On 12 April 1946 the Government lifted the ban on which party, and whose release from prison was celebrated with a hearty reception on his arrival at Patna?
qh: 12 अप्रैल 1946 को सरकार ने किस दल पर से प्रतिबंध हटाया, तथा किसकी रिहाई पर पटना पहुँचने पर उनका हार्दिक स्वागत किया गया?
oe: Congress Socialist Party; the release of Jai Prakash Narain
Forward Bloc; the release of Subhas Chandra Bose
Muslim League; the release of Muhammad Ali Jinnah
Hindustan Socialist Republican Army; the release of Bhagat Singh
oh: कांग्रेस सोशलिस्ट पार्टी; जयप्रकाश नारायण की रिहाई
फॉरवर्ड ब्लॉक; सुभाष चंद्र बोस की रिहाई
मुस्लिम लीग; मुहम्मद अली जिन्ना की रिहाई
हिंदुस्तान सोशलिस्ट रिपब्लिकन आर्मी; भगत सिंह की रिहाई
e: 12 April 1946 ko sarkar ne Congress Socialist Party par lagaye gaye pratibandh yaani ban ko hata liya. Isi kram me Jaiprakash Narain ki rihai hui, jiska asar Bihar tatha desh bhar me khushi ki lehar ke roop me dikha. Patna pahunchne par unka harsh ke saath swagat kiya gaya tatha kai sabhaon me unke bhashan logon ne bahut dhyan se sune. Lekin Forward Bloc sarkar se samjhauta karne ko taiyar nahi tha. March tatha April ke dauran Aurobindo Bose ne Monghyr, Patna, Muzaffarpur tatha Darbhanga zilon ka daura kiya tatha kai sabhaon me apne dal ka paksh rakha, tatha Bihar ke Forward Bloc ke pramukh neta Shibhadra Yajee bhi sakriya rahe. Exam point: 12 April 1946 ko Congress Socialist Party par se pratibandh hata tatha Jaiprakash Narain ki rihai par Patna me unka harsh ke saath swagat hua, jabki Forward Bloc ne samjhauta nahi kiya.

qe: In his speech of 15 March 1946, Mr Attlee said that the temperature of 1946 was not the temperature of which year, adding that the tide of nationalism was running high in India and all over Asia?
