qh: 15 मार्च 1946 के अपने भाषण में श्री एटली ने कहा कि 1946 का तापमान किस वर्ष का तापमान नहीं है, तथा यह भी कहा कि भारत तथा पूरे एशिया में राष्ट्रवाद की लहर ऊँची चल रही है?
e: Bharat me rashtriya andolan ki raftaar itni tez ho chuki thi ki angreji sarkar ko uski gambhirta samajh aa gayi thi. England me Labour Party ki nayi sarkar bani, jiske pradhan Mr Attlee the. 15 March 1946 ke apne bhashan me Attlee ne khud sweekar kiya ki 'aaj ka tatha 1920 ka vatavaran ek jaisa nahi hai' tatha yeh bhi kaha ki is samay Bharat tatha vastutah poore Asia me rashtravad ki lehar oonchi chal rahi hai. Is bayan se saaf ho gaya ki British sarkar ab sanvaidhanik raste se sahi samadhan nikalne ke liye majboor ho gayi hai. Isi kram me British sarkar ne March 1946 me Cabinet Mission ko Bharat bheja. Ye baat Bihar ke liye bhi mahatvapurn thi kyunki yahan ke logon ne har andolan me sabse aage rehkar apna balidan diya tha. Exam point: 15 March 1946 ke apne bhashan me Attlee ne kaha ki 1946 ka temperature 1920 ka temperature nahi hai tatha Bharat tatha poore Asia me rashtrvad ki lehar oonchi chal rahi hai.

qe: Which great scientist was among the prominent leaders of the Brahmo Samaj who visited Bihar along with Devendra Nath Tagore, Keshav Chandra Sen and Rabindranath Tagore?
qh: देवेंद्रनाथ ठाकुर, केशव चंद्र सेन तथा रवींद्रनाथ ठाकुर के साथ बिहार आने वाले ब्रह्म समाज के प्रमुख नेताओं में कौन-से महान वैज्ञानिक शामिल थे?
e: Brahmo Samaj ek dharmik tatha samajik sudhar andolan tha jo Bengal se shuru hokar Bihar tak pahuncha. Iske pramukh netaon me Maharshi Devendra Nath Tagore, Keshav Chandra Sen, Rabindranath Tagore tatha mahan vaigyanik Jagadish Chandra Bose shaamil the, jo Bihar aaye tatha yahan ke logon se mile. Inke alawa Trailakya Nath Sanyal, Nagendra Nath Chatterjee, Gurudas Chakravarti tatha Braj Gopal Neogy jaise Brahmo missionaries bhi Bihar ke zyadatar zilon me gaye tatha is vichar ka prachar kiya. Bihar me is panth ke anuyayi yaani converts ki sankhya kam thi, lekin unka prabhav padhe-likhe vargaon me vyapak tatha sthayi raha. Isi karan Brahmo vichardhara ne yahan ke Hindu samaj me udarvad tatha naveen soch ka sanchar kiya. Exam point: Mahan vaigyanik Jagadish Chandra Bose un pramukh Brahmo Samaj netaon me the jo Bihar aaye; Devendra Nath Tagore, Keshav Chandra Sen tatha Rabindranath Tagore bhi inme shaamil the.

qe: The Brahmo Samaj mandirs existed in almost all the advanced districts of Bihar. Which set of districts is correct in this context?
qh: ब्रह्म समाज के मंदिर बिहार के लगभग सभी विकसित जिलों में थे। इस संदर्भ में कौन-सा जिला-समूह सही है?
oe: Shahabad, Palamau, Manbhum and Santhal Pargana
Patna, Gaya, Bhagalpur, Muzaffarpur and Ranchi
oh: शाहाबाद, पलामू, मानभूम तथा संताल परगना
पटना, गया, भागलपुर, मुजफ्फरपुर तथा राँची
e: Brahmo Samaj ka prabhav Bihar me mukhya roop se un zilon me raha jo us samay shiksha tatha rajnitik drishti se viksit maane jaate the. Aise jilon me Patna, Gaya, Bhagalpur, Muzaffarpur tatha Ranchi ke naam pramukh hain. Yahan Brahmo mandir yaani upasana bhavan sthapit hue tatha Brahmo missionaries ne in kshetron me ghoom-ghoom kar prachar kiya. Haalanki is panth se jude parivaron ki sankhya hazaaron me hi thi tatha yeh andolan mukhya roop se Bangla-bhashi parivaron tak simit raha, phir bhi iska asar Bihar ke padhe-likhe vargaon par bahut gehra pada. Isi karan aage chalkar yahan ke samajik sudhar andolanon me Brahmo vicharon ki jhalak dikhti hai. Exam point: Bihar me Brahmo Samaj ke mandir mukhya roop se Patna, Gaya, Bhagalpur, Muzaffarpur tatha Ranchi jaise viksit zilon me the.

qe: Besides being a religious movement, the Brahmo Samaj was a great force for social reform in Bihar and declared war against which two things?
qh: धार्मिक आंदोलन होने के साथ-साथ ब्रह्म समाज बिहार में सामाजिक सुधार की बड़ी शक्ति था, जिसने किन दो चीजों के विरुद्ध मोर्चा खोला?
oe: The caste system and the seclusion of women under purdah
Child marriage and the dowry system
oh: जाति प्रथा तथा परदे में स्त्रियों का पृथक्करण
e: Brahmo Samaj ka dharmik paksha ek taraf tha, doosri taraf woh samajik sudhar ki ek badi shakti bhi tha. Bihar me isne jati-pratha yaani caste system tatha purdah ke karan striyon ke prithakkaran yaani seclusion ke virudh morcha khola. Iske saath hi isne bal-vivah yaani child marriage jaise kalank ke virudh aawaz uthai tatha vidhwa vivaah yaani widow remarriage ka samarthan kiya. In vicharon ke prachar ke liye Brahmo Samaj se jude logon ne kai shiksha tatha kalyan sansthayen bhi kholin, jinme Patna ka Ram Mohan Roy Seminary aur Ranchi ke Lalpur ka manasik aspatal tatha homyopathik dawa-khana jaise naam shaamil hain. Is tarah yeh andolan Bihar me ek naveen samajik chetna paida karne ka sadhan bana. Exam point: Bihar me Brahmo Samaj ne jati-pratha tatha purdah ke karan striyon ke prithakkaran ke virudh morcha khola tatha bal-vivah ka virodh karte hue vidhwa vivaah ka samarthan kiya.

qe: Among the welfare institutions set up by the Brahmo Samaj in Bihar, a charitable homeopathic dispensary was opened at one place and a mental hospital with a charitable homeopathic dispensary at another. Which were these two places?
qh: बिहार में ब्रह्म समाज द्वारा खोली गई कल्याणकारी संस्थाओं में एक स्थान पर दानवीर होम्योपैथिक औषधालय तथा दूसरे स्थान पर दानवीर होम्योपैथिक औषधालय सहित मानसिक चिकित्सालय खोला गया। ये दो स्थान कौन-से थे?
e: Brahmo Samaj ne apne dharmik vicharon ke saath-saath samajik seva ke kshetra me bhi bahut kaam kiya. Bihar me iski sabse pramukh sansthaon me Patna ka Ram Mohan Roy Seminary shaamil tha. Iske alawa Hazaribagh me ek daanveer homyopathik dawa-khana yaani charitable homeopathic dispensary tatha Ranchi ke Lalpur me ek manasik aspatal khola gaya, jiske saath ek daanveer homyopathik dawa-khana bhi juda hua tha. Isi tarah Patna Brahmo Samaj bhi is andolan ka mahatvapurn kendra raha. In sansthaon se saabit hota hai ki sudhar andolan keval vicharon tak simit nahi tha; usne shiksha tatha swasthya jaise vyavaharik kshetron me bhi logon ki madad ki. Exam point: Brahmo Samaj ne Hazaribagh me daanveer homyopathik dawa-khana tatha Ranchi ke Lalpur me manasik aspatal sahit homyopathik dawa-khana khola tha.

qe: Which important aspect of the work of the Arya Samaj in Bihar was aimed at checking the loss of Hindus to other religions?
qh: बिहार में आर्य समाज के कार्य का कौन-सा महत्वपूर्ण पक्ष हिंदुओं को अन्य धर्मों में जाने से रोकने की दिशा में था?
oe: Recruitment of sepoys for the Company army
Prevention of conversion from Hinduism to Islam or Christianity
Promotion of pilgrimage to foreign lands
oh: कंपनी की सेना के लिए सिपाहियों की भर्ती
हिंदू धर्म से इस्लाम या ईसाई धर्म में धर्मांतरण की रोकथाम
e: Unnisvin sadi ke ant me Swami Dayanand Saraswati dwara Punjab me shuru hua Arya Samaj andolan Bihar ke Hindu jeevan par bhi asar dala. Yeh ek aisa sudhar andolan tha jo Vedic kaal ke baad Hinduism me ja mile sabhi milaav yaani accretions ko hata kar use shuddh Vedic roop dena chahta tha. Iska ek mahatvapurn paksha Hinduon ko Islam ya Christianity me dharmantaran yaani conversion se rokna tha, kyunki us samay missionari sansthaen tatha anya karan se aise dharmantaran ho rahe the. Isi karan Arya Samaj ne shuddhi jaise karyakram apnaye tatha Hindu samaj ko sangathit karne par zor diya. Iska prabhav Bihar me vishesh roop se un vargon par pada jo shiksha tatha samajik drishti se peeche the. Exam point: Bihar me Arya Samaj ka ek mahatvapurn kaam Hinduon ka Islam ya Christianity me dharmantaran rokna tha, jiske liye usne shuddhi tatha sangathan par zor diya.

qe: Which of the following were the main contributions of the Arya Samaj to social reform in Bihar?
qh: बिहार में सामाजिक सुधार के लिए आर्य समाज के मुख्य योगदान कौन-से थे?
oe: Introduction of the English language in temples and courts
Compulsory military training for all castes
Abolition of the zamindari system and land revenue
Simplified marriage without dowry, widow remarriage, dispensing with purdah and education of women
oh: मंदिरों तथा अदालतों में अंग्रेजी भाषा का प्रचलन
सभी जातियों के लिए अनिवार्य सैनिक प्रशिक्षण
जमींदारी प्रथा तथा भू-राजस्व की समाप्ति
बिना दहेज सरल विवाह, विधवा पुनर्विवाह, परदा-प्रथा का त्याग तथा स्त्रियों की शिक्षा
e: Arya Samaj ne Bihar ke samajik jeevan me kai sudhar ke beej boye. Iske pramukh yogdan the - bina dahej ke saral vivah yaani simplified marriage, vidhwa punarvivah yaani widow remarriage, purdah ka tyag tatha striyon ki shiksha par vishesh dhyan. Samaj ne moorti-puja yaani idolatry ko thukra diya tatha Homa tatha prarthana ke zariye Vedic saralta ki wapasi par zor diya. Isne jati-pratha ke jatil roop ki alochana ki tatha char Varnon ki vyavastha ko aage badhane ki baat ki, jiske karan yeh andolan nichli jatiyon ko vishesh roop se bhaaya. Bihar me Dayanand Anglo-Vedic College tatha anek school isi andolan ki den hain, jinme Vedic shiksha ke saath aadhunik angreji shiksha bhi di jaati thi. Exam point: Arya Samaj ke mukhya samajik yogdan the - bina dahej saral vivah, vidhwa punarvivah, purdah ka tyag tatha stri-shiksha; iski sansthaon me Dayanand Anglo-Vedic College pramukh hai.

qe: The Theosophical movement had an influence on the English-educated intelligentsia of Bihar because of which two elements of its character?
qh: थियोसोफिकल आंदोलन का बिहार के अंग्रेजी-शिक्षित बुद्धिजीवियों पर इसकी किन दो विशेषताओं के कारण प्रभाव पड़ा?
oe: Its advocacy of cow sacrifice and temple destruction
Its insistence on the abolition of all scriptures and holy books
Its element of mysticism and its attempt at a rational and scientific explanation of the principles of Hinduism
Its support for British rule and its opposition to Indian languages
oh: सभी धर्मग्रंथों को समाप्त करने पर जोर
इसमें रहस्यवाद का तत्व तथा हिंदू धर्म के सिद्धांतों की तार्किक व वैज्ञानिक व्याख्या का प्रयास
ब्रिटिश शासन का समर्थन तथा भारतीय भाषाओं का विरोध
e: Theosophical movement ki shuruat 1875 me hui tatha iska mukhyaalay Banaras me tha. Bihar me iska prabhav yahan ke angreji-padhe buddhijeeviyon par is karan pada ki isme ek taraf rahasyavad yaani mysticism ka tatva tha tatha doosri taraf Hindu dharm ke siddhanton ki tarkik tatha vaigyanik vyakhya karne ka prayas tha. Isi mishran ne ise paddhe-likhe vargon ke liye aakarshak banaya tatha ek samay me iski kai shakhayen Bihar me sakriya thin. Iske alawa intelligentisia par Ramakrishna ki shikshaon tatha Sri Aurobindo ke mat ka bhi asar pada, tatha Ramakrishna Mission ki manav-seva ki gatividhiyon ne yahan ke logon ke dilon me jagah banayi. Exam point: Bihar me Theosophical movement ka prabhav rahasyavad tatha Hindu siddhanton ki tarkik-vaigyanik vyakhya ke karan pada tatha ek samay me iski kai shakhayen yahan sakriya thin.

qe: Which of the following humanitarian activities were to the credit of the Ramakrishna Mission in Bihar?
qh: बिहार में रामकृष्ण मिशन के खाते में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी मानवीय सेवाएँ थीं?
oe: Flood relief, famine relief, free medicine and help to poor students
Recruitment of volunteers for the army and police
Distribution of land among the zamindars
Opening of liquor shops for public revenue
oh: बाढ़ राहत, अकाल राहत, निःशुल्क दवा तथा निर्धन विद्यार्थियों की सहायता
सेना तथा पुलिस के लिए स्वयंसेवकों की भर्ती
सरकारी आय के लिए शराब की दुकानें खोलना
e: Bihar ke padhe-likhe Hindu samaj par Ramakrishna ke updesh tatha Swami Vivekananda ke sandesh ka gambhir prabhav pada. Yadyapi inke uchh naitik siddhant tatha buddhivad ke karan unka seedha prabhav kuchh hi logon tak simit raha, lekin kehna galat nahi hoga ki har angreji-padhe Hindu par Vivekananda ke sandesh ka asar pada. Isi kram me Ramakrishna Mission ne Bihar me manav-seva ke kai kaam apne naam kiye - baadh yaani flood relief tatha akal yaani famine relief ke samay logon ki madad, nihshulk dawa yaani free medicine ka vitaran tatha nirdhan vidyarthiyon yaani poor students ki sahayata. Isi tarah ke karyakramon se saabit hota hai ki dharmik sudhar andolanon ne Bihar me samajik seva ki ek aisi parampara shuru ki jo aage bhi jaari rahi. Exam point: Bihar me Ramakrishna Mission ne baadh tatha akal ke samay rahat, nihshulk dawa tatha nirdhan vidyarthiyon ki sahayata jaise manav-seva ke karya kiye tatha Vivekananda ke sandesh ka asar har angreji-padhe Hindu par pada.

qe: Socially speaking, the Muslims of Bihar recognised which two main divisions?
qh: सामाजिक दृष्टि से बिहार के मुसलमान किन दो मुख्य वर्गों में विभाजित थे?
e: Hinduon ke baad Bihar me sankhya ke hisaab se sabse bada ek samuday Mussalmanon ka tha. Dharmik drishti se dekha jaye to unme koi sudhar andolan nahi hua, lekin samajik drishti se woh do mukhya vargon me bante the - pehla Ashraf yaani uchh khandan tatha doosra Ajlaf. Ashraf varg me sabse pramukh Syed the, jo apne aap ko Paigambar ka vanshaj batate the; iske alawa Moghal, Irani, Afghan tatha Pathan jaise varg bhi isi shreni me aate the. Ajlaf varg ke log apne peshe yaani vocations ke naam par pehchane jaate the, jaise Momin, Kunjra, Jolha, Dhunia, Dhobi, Kalal, Chik tatha Lalbegi. Is varg-vyavastha se dikhata hai ki Bihar ke Muslim samaj me bhi uttaradhikar yaani ancestry tatha peshe ke aadhaar par samajik star tay hota tha. Exam point: Bihar ke Muslim samaj me do mukhya samajik varg the - Ashraf (Syed, Moghal, Irani, Afghan, Pathan) tatha Ajlaf (Momin, Kunjra, Jolha, Dhunia, Dhobi, Kalal, Chik, Lalbegi).

qe: Which of the following groups of Muslims of Bihar were named after their vocations and belonged to the Ajlaf category?
qh: बिहार के मुसलमानों के निम्नलिखित समूहों में कौन अपने पेशों के नाम पर पहचाने जाते थे तथा अजलफ श्रेणी में आते थे?
e: Muslim samaj ke do vargon me Ajlaf woh varg tha jo apne peshon yaani vocations ke naam par pehchana jaata tha. Is varg me Momin, Kunjra, Jolha yaani bunkar, Dhunia yaani dhunne wale, Dhobi, Kalal yaani sharab banane wale, Chik tatha Lalbegi jaise samuh shaamil the. Inme se bahut se log asal me Hinduon se daira yaani convert hue the, isliye woh kai Hindu vishwason ko bhi manate rahe, jaise bimari tatha atmaon se jude andhvishwas tatha kuch dharmik paramparaen. Iske ulat Ashraf varg me Syed, Moghal, Irani, Afghan tatha Pathan jaise log aate the, jinka samajik darja uncha maana jaata tha. Yeh dohra vibhajan Bihar ke Muslim samaj me peshe tatha vansh ke aadhaar par banayi gayi samajik star-vyavastha ko darshata hai. Exam point: Momin, Kunjra, Jolha, Dhunia, Dhobi, Kalal, Chik tatha Lalbegi jaise peshe ke naam wale samuh Ajlaf shreni me aate the, jabki Syed, Moghal, Irani, Afghan tatha Pathan Ashraf me gine jaate the.

qe: Which is the most important festival of the Shia Mussalmans, observed in memory of the marytrs Hassan and Hussain, the grandsons of the Prophet?
qh: शिया मुसलमानों का सबसे महत्वपूर्ण त्योहार कौन-सा है, जो पैगंबर के पौत्र शहीद हसन तथा हुसैन की स्मृति में मनाया जाता है?
e: Bihar me Muslim samuday me do mukhya dharmik dhaaren thin - Sunni tatha Shia, jinme Sunni logon ki sankhya Shia se kaafi adhik thi. Shia Mussalmanon ka sabse mahatvapurn tyohar 'Moharram' hai, jo Paigambar ke pautra yaani grandsons Hasan tatha Hussain ki shahadat ki smriti me manaya jaata hai. Vishay yah hai ki is avadhi me Bihar me bahut se Hindu bhi Moharram ke tyohar me shaamil hote the; unhon ne ise tab chhodna shuru kiya jab sampradayik tanav badhne laga tatha dono samudayon ke beech alagav yaani separatism par zor diya jaane laga. Is tarah ke sajha tyohar Bihar ke gauravshali saanskritik itihas ka hissa the, jinka aage chal kar rajnitik tatha sampradayik karanon se kam hona dukhdayi raha. Exam point: Shia Mussalmanon ka sabse bada tyohar Moharram hai, jo Hasan tatha Hussain ki shahadat ki smriti me manaya jaata hai; Bihar me pehle Hindu bhi isme shaamil hote the tatha sampradayik tanav badhne par yeh sajhedari chhut gayi.

qe: Because they, like other Sunnis, did not acknowledge the four Imams, the Wahabis of Bihar preferred to call themselves by which name?
qh: चूँकि बिहार के वहाबी अन्य सुन्नियों की तरह चार इमामों को नहीं मानते थे, इसलिए वे स्वयं को किस नाम से कहना पसंद करते थे?
e: Bihar me Wahabi ek badi sankhya me maujud samuh tha, jisme kuchh dhanvan vyapari bhi the, lekin zyadatar log nimn varg ke the. Wahabism asal me Sunni vishwas ki hi ek shakha mana jaata hai, lekin wahabi Sunni tatha Shia dono ke virodh me sakht rukh lete the. Apne aap ko woh 'Non-imitators' yaani anukaran na karne wale kehte the, kyunki anya Sunniyon ki tarah woh bhi char Imamon ko pramanik nahi maante the. Woh bahut sakht naitik jeevan ka palan karte the tatha mohammadan dharm ke zyada dhoom-dhaam wale rasmo-riwaz ko thukrate the. Iske saath hi unka mukhya dhyan jihad yaani dharm-yuddh par tha. In vicharon ke karan unka ek vishesh samuhik swaroop bana tatha Patna unka ek bada kendra raha. Exam point: Bihar ke Wahabi apne aap ko 'Non-imitators' kehte the, kyunki anya Sunniyon ki tarah woh char Imamon ko svikar nahi karte the.

qe: The purdah system in nineteenth century Bihar was recognised even by the British Courts, so that ladies of high rank gave their evidence through which arrangement?
qh: उन्नीसवीं सदी के बिहार में परदा प्रथा को ब्रिटिश अदालतों ने भी मान्यता दी थी, जिसके कारण उच्च वर्ग की महिलाएँ किस व्यवस्था के माध्यम से अपना साक्ष्य देती थीं?
oe: Only through a British officer after conversion
Through the double screen of the palanquin, examined on Commission or by the Judge himself
In an open court in front of the whole bar
By sending a written statement through the husband only
oh: धर्मांतरण के बाद केवल ब्रिटिश अफसर के माध्यम से
पालकी के दोहरे परदे के माध्यम से, आयोग पर अथवा स्वयं न्यायाधीश द्वारा परीक्षा किए जाने पर
पूरी अदालत तथा बार के सामने खुले रूप में
केवल पति के माध्यम से लिखित बयान भेजकर
e: Unnisvin sadi ke Bihar me purdah pratha bahut sakht thi. Striyon ka sarvajanik roop se dikhna mana tha tatha bahar jaate samay unhe poora parda karna padta tha. Itna hi nahi, purdah ko British adalaton ne bhi manyata di thi - uchh darje ki mahilaen ya to Commission par ya phir svayan Judge dwara pareeksha ki jaati thin, tatha unka sakshya paalki ke dohre parde yaani double screen ke through suna jaata tha. Aise samay me purdah dhan tatha darje ka prateek ban gaya tatha Rajput mahilaen bhi ise apnati thin. Haalanki nichli jatiyon me purdah kabhi nahi mana gaya, tatha uchh vargon me ise ek vishesh adhikar yaani privilege ke roop me dekha jaata tha. Exam point: Unnisvin sadi me British adalaton ne bhi purdah ko manyata di; uchh darje ki mahilaon ka sakshya paalki ke dohre parde ke through liya jaata tha tatha woh Commission par ya svayan Judge dwara pareeksha ki jaati thin.

qe: In his account of the district of Shahabad, who found ten or twelve Hindu ladies who had acquired the art of reading and writing?
qh: शाहाबाद जिले के अपने विवरण में किसने दस या बारह हिंदू महिलाओं को खोजा, जिन्होंने पढ़ना तथा लिखना सीख लिया था?
e: Unnisvin sadi me Bihar ki adhiktar mahilaen likhna-padhna nahi jaanti thin, lekin kuchh apvaad bhi the. Shahabad zile ke vivaran me Buchanan ne das ya barah Hindu mahilaon ko khoja tha, jinhone padhna-likhna seekh liya tha. Koranja me aisi lagbhag bees mahilaen thin jo apne naam par hastakshar yaani sign kar sakti thin tatha hisaab samajh leti thin, tatha Tiloudm me kuchh mahilaen itni shikshit thin ki woh sundar likhti thin tatha Tulsidas ki kavy rachnaon ko samajhti thin. Purnea ke Nathpur me ek vriddh mahila aisi thi jise masane yaani bladder se patthar nikalne me khyati prapt thi. In udaharanon se saabit hota hai ki unnisvin sadi me bhi Bihar me mahilaon ki ek chhoti lekin mahatvapurn shikshit tatha hunarmand pidi maujud thi. Exam point: Shahabad zile me Buchanan ne das ya barah Hindu mahilaon ko khoja, jinhone padhna-likhna seekha tha; Koranja ki lagbhag bees mahilaen hastakshar kar sakti thin tatha Nathpur (Purnea) ki ek vriddh mahila masane se patthar nikalne ke liye prasiddh thi.

qe: At Manihari in Bhagalpur, what restriction was placed on women in religious matters, though they could join the feast after the sacrifices?
qh: भागलपुर के मनिहारी में महिलाओं पर धार्मिक मामलों में क्या रोक थी, जबकि बलिदान के बाद होने वाले भोज में वे शामिल हो सकती थीं?
oe: They were not allowed to enter the village at all
They were not allowed to wear any ornaments
They were not allowed to pray or make offerings or be present at sacrifices
They were not allowed to eat cooked food of any kind
oh: वे गाँव में प्रवेश ही नहीं कर सकती थीं
वे कोई आभूषण नहीं पहन सकती थीं
वे प्रार्थना नहीं कर सकती थीं, न चढ़ावा दे सकती थीं और न बलिदान के समय उपस्थित रह सकती थीं
वे किसी भी प्रकार का पका भोजन नहीं ले सकती थीं
e: Unnisvin sadi ke Bihar me striyon ka dharmik jeevan purushon se alag tatha saral tha. Manihari (Bhagalpur) jaisi jagahon me mahilaon ko prarthana karne, chadhaava dene ya balidan yaani sacrifices ke samay upasthit rehne ki anumati nahi thi; unhain balidan ke baad diye jaane wale bhoj me shaamil hone ki chhoot thi. Iske ulat unke ghar ke andar unka dharmik sthan uncha tha - mahila ghar ki 'grahini' thi, jo pavitra paudhon ko paani deti, yagya ki agni ki raksha karti, bhojan ki shuddhata ka dhyan rakhti tatha jal tatha prarthana me lagi rehti thi. Is tarah bahari dharmik karyakramon se rokti hone ke bawajood mahila ghar ki dharmik vyavastha ki kendriya rakshak maani jaati thi. Exam point: Manihari (Bhagalpur) me mahilaon ko prarthana, chadhaava ya balidanon me upasthit hone ki anumati nahi thi, lekin balidan ke baad ke bhoj me woh shaamil ho sakti thin.

qe: In the traditional family system of Bihar, by which term, meaning the mistress of the household, was the woman known as the guardian of the home's religious routine?
qh: बिहार की पारंपरिक पारिवारिक व्यवस्था में उस स्त्री को किस शब्द से जाना जाता था, जिसका अर्थ गृहस्वामिनी होता है तथा जो घर की धार्मिक दिनचर्या की रक्षक मानी जाती थी?
e: Bihar ki paramparik parivar vyavastha me stri ka ek mahatvapurn tatha sammanjanak sthan tha. Usa samay 'grahini' yaani ghar ki swaminik chhoti nahi, balki ghar ki dharmik vyavastha ki kendriya rakshak maani jaati thi. Mahila pavitra paudhon ko paani deti thi, yagya ki agni yaani sacrificial fire ki raksha karti thi, bhojan ki shuddhata ka dhyan rakhti thi tatha jal tatha prarthana me vyast rehti thi. Isi karan kaha jaata hai ki stri hi ghar ki yajmani yaani priestess thi. Parivar vyavastha ke karan mahilaon ka prabhav aur bhi badh gaya tatha unme tatha purushon me kaam ka ek samvaibhik yaani equitable bantwara tha, jisse unhe apna samay vyarth nahi gavaana padta tha. Exam point: Bihar ki parivar vyavastha me stri 'grahini' yaani grihaswamini kehlati thi tatha ghar ke dharmik karma - pavitra paudhe, yagya-agni tatha bhojan ki shuddhata - ki rakshak maani jaati thi.

qe: As early as 1789, which Collector of Shahabad wrote to Lord Cornwallis that the Government should prohibit a practice at which humanity shuddered?
qh: 1789 में ही शाहाबाद के किस कलेक्टर ने लॉर्ड कॉर्नवालिस को लिखा कि सरकार को उस प्रथा को प्रतिबंधित करना चाहिए जिसे देखकर मानवता काँप उठती है?
e: Sati yaani pati ki chita par vidhwa ka jeevan samarpan ek purani parampara thi, jise dharmik mahatva diya jaata tha, lekin asal me iska palan bahut kam log karte the. Atharahvin sadi tak yeh ek abhishap ban gayi, khaas taur par poorvi Bharat me, jahan gair-ichchhuk vidhwaon ko bhi laalach tatha dabav me sati hone par majboor kiya jaata tha. 1789 me Shahabad ke Collector Mr M. H. Brooke ne Lord Cornwallis ko patra likhkar kaha ki yadyapi sarkar ki niti dharmik mamlon me dakhal na dene ki hai, phir bhi aise prayog ko rokna chahiye 'jise dekhkar maanavta kaanp uthti hai'. Lekin us samay sarkar is bhay se aage nahi badhi ki isse seb army me asantosh jaise gambhir parinam ho sakte hain. Exam point: 1789 me Shahabad ke Collector M. H. Brooke ne Lord Cornwallis ko likhkar sati jaise prayog par rok lagane ka sujhaav diya tha, jise dekhkar maanavta kaanp uthti hai.

qe: How many cases of sati were reported in the Patna division alone between 1815 and 1817?
qh: 1815 तथा 1817 के बीच केवल पटना प्रमंडल में सती के कितने मामले दर्ज हुए?
e: Sati pratha ka virodh samay ke saath badhta gaya kyunki iske aankde bahut chintajanak the. 1815 se 1817 ke beech keval Patna division yaani prant me sati ke 98 maamle darj huye tatha 1817 me ek karyapalak aadesh jaari karke un vidhwa maaon ko jalane par rok laga di gayi, jinke chaar se saat saal tak ke bachhe the. Dhyaan dene wali baat hai ki 1817 ka yeh aadesh ek circular order tha, jiska koi kanooni bal yaani legal sanction nahi tha; isliye iska palan poora nahi ho paya. In aankdon se saabit hota hai ki sati keval ek dharmik parampara nahi thi, balki ek samajik samasya ban chuki thi, jiske karan sarkar ko kadam uthana pada. Isi kram me aage chalkar 1829 me sati par poori tarah rok lagayi gayi. Exam point: 1815-1817 ke beech keval Patna prant me sati ke 98 maamle darj hue tatha 1817 me chaar-se-saat saal ke bachhon wali vidhwaon ke jalne par rok lagayi gayi.

qe: The abolition of sati became possible owing to a combination of which three forces?
qh: सती प्रथा की समाप्ति किन तीन शक्तियों के संयोग से संभव हो सकी?
oe: The campaign of the Wahabi movement, the support of the Muslim League, and the efforts of the army
The influence of the Dutch traders, the Portuguese missionaries and the French settlers
Measures adopted on the ground of administrative necessity, the attempts of Christian missionaries, and the growth of an enlightened public opinion as part of the Indian Renaissance
The pressure of the British Parliament, the support of the zamindars, and the orders of the Nawab of Bengal
oh: वहाबी आंदोलन का अभियान, मुस्लिम लीग का समर्थन तथा सेना के प्रयास
डच व्यापारियों का प्रभाव, पुर्तगाली मिशनरी तथा फ्रांसीसी बसने वाले
प्रशासनिक आवश्यकता के आधार पर उठाए गए कदम, ईसाई मिशनरियों के प्रयास तथा भारतीय पुनर्जागरण के अंग के रूप में प्रबुद्ध जनमत का विकास
ब्रिटिश संसद का दबाव, जमींदारों का समर्थन तथा बंगाल के नवाब के आदेश
e: Sati ke virodh me kai dhaaraen kaam kar rahi thin, lekin iska ant sirf ek karan se sambhav nahi hua. Sati ki samapti teen shaktiyon ke sangam se sambhav hui - pehla, Company sarkar dwara prashasnik aavashyakta ke aadhaar par utaye gaye kadam; doosra, Christian missionaryon ke prayas; tatha teesra, Bharatiya punarjagaran yaani Indian Renaissance ke ang ke roop me prabuddh janmat ka vikas. Iske vipreet ek rethivadi paksh bhi tha, jisne 1812, 1815 tatha 1817 ke circular orders ki revoke karne ki maang ko lekar sarkar ko petition diya. Is avsar par Raja Ram Mohan Roy ne ulta yaani vipakshi petition bheja tatha swayam sati ke sthal par jaakar logon ko samjhaya. Isi tarah ki sajha koshishon se aage chalkar sati par rok lagayi gayi. Exam point: Sati ki samapti teen shaktiyon ke sangam se sambhav hui - prashasnik aavashyakta ke aadhaar par utaye gaye kadam, Christian missionaryon ke prayas tatha punarjagaran ke ang ke roop me prabuddh janmat ka vikas.

qe: How did Raja Ram Mohan Roy personally intervene to prevent sati sacrifices, besides carrying on propaganda?
qh: प्रचार अभियान के अतिरिक्त राजा राम मोहन राय ने सती को रोकने के लिए व्यक्तिगत रूप से क्या किया?
oe: He went to the burning ghats himself and tried to prevent the sacrifices by earnest persuasion
He armed volunteers to stop the crowds by force
He filed cases in the Privy Council on behalf of widows
He appealed to the Governor-General to deploy troops at the ghats
oh: वे स्वयं श्मशान घाट पर जाते थे तथा गंभीर समझाइश से सती को रोकने का प्रयास करते थे
उन्होंने भीड़ को बलपूर्वक रोकने के लिए स्वयंसेवकों को हथियार दिए
उन्होंने विधवाओं की ओर से प्रिवी काउंसिल में मुकदमे दायर किए
उन्होंने गवर्नर-जनरल से घाटों पर सेना तैनात करने की अपील की
e: Sati ke virodh me Raja Ram Mohan Roy ka yogdan bahut mahatvapurn tha. Unhone keval lekh tatha petition tak hi apne ko simit nahi rakha; woh swayam shmashan ghaaton yaani burning ghats par jaate the tatha gambhir samjhais yaani earnest persuasion ke zariye sati ke prayogon ko rokne ka prayas karte the. 1818 me unhone sati ki samapti par apna pehla lekh yaani tract prakaashit kiya tatha 1820 me doosra tract nikala, jise unhone Marchioness of Hastings ko samarpit kiya tatha jisme striyon ke paksh me ek bhavuk appeal thi. 1823 me Lord William Bentinck ne is mamle ko jaldi nipatane ka nirnay kiya tatha 1829 me sati par rok lagayi gayi. Rethivadi paksh ne is rok ko khatm karne ke liye London tak appeal ki, lekin Ram Mohan Roy ke prayason ke karan woh appeal Privy Council dwara kharij kar di gayi. Exam point: Raja Ram Mohan Roy sati rokne ke liye swayam shmashan ghaton par jaate the tatha samjhais se use rokne ka prayas karte the; unhone 1818 tatha 1820 me sati-samapti par tract bhi prakashit kiye.

qe: In which place of Bihar did an abetted sati case take place in November 1929, even though the practice had been banned long ago?
qh: बिहार के किस स्थान पर नवंबर 1929 में सती की एक उकसाई गई घटना हुई, जबकि इस प्रथा पर बहुत पहले प्रतिबंध लग चुका था?
e: Sati par 1829 me rok lag jane ke baad bhi samay-samay par aise prayog hone ki khabren aati rahin, kyunki purani manyatayen samaj me gehri jamhi hui thin. Gaya zile me 1901 tatha 1903 me aise do maamle saamne aaye tatha Barh me November 1929 me ek abetted yaani ukasaayi gayi sati ki ghatna hui. Isi tarah 1930 me Hazaribagh zile me ek vidhwa ne khud ko jalane ka prayas kiya. Jo log aise balidan dete the, unhe shraddha tatha samman ki drishti se dekha jaata tha. Unnisvin sadi ke madhya me samaj ke ek varg me yeh pravritti bhi ubhri ki madhyakaaleen ya prachin sabhi riti-riwazon ko uchit thahraya jaye, jiske karan yeh dabi hui pratha phir se sir uthane lagi. Exam point: Barh me November 1929 me sati ki ek ukasaayi gayi ghatna hui; isse pehle Gaya zile me 1901 tatha 1903 me aise maamle darj huye tatha 1930 me Hazaribagh me ek vidhwa ne aatm-balidan ka prayas kiya.

qe: In 1835 there was a demand for an enactment on widow remarriage in which journal, before the Act of 1856 legalized it?
qh: विधवा पुनर्विवाह पर कानून बनाने की मांग 1835 में किस पत्रिका में उठाई गई थी, जिसके बाद 1856 का अधिनियम इसका वैधीकरण कर सका?
e: Raja Ram Mohan Roy vidhwa punarvivah yaani widow remarriage ke bhi samarthak the. 1835 me 'Samachar Darpan' naam ki patrika me is vishay par kanoon yaani enactment banane ki maang utrai gayi. Iske baad Pandit Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar tatha anya samajik karyakartaon ke lagatar prayason se 1856 ka Act aaya, jisne vidhwa punarvivah ko kanooni manyata di tatha punarvivahit vidhwaon ki santan yaani issue ko vaidh yaani legitimate ghoshit kiya. Yeh kanoon Bihar tatha anya pranton me un uchh jatiyon ke liye ek badi rahat tha jahan punarvivah par sabse sakht rok thi. Aise kanoon dikhate hain ki samajik sudhar en keval vicharon se nahi, balki sangathanit prayas tatha kanooni hastakshep se sambhav hua. Exam point: 1835 me 'Samachar Darpan' me vidhwa punarvivah par kanoon banane ki maang utrai gayi tatha Vidyasagar ke prayason se 1856 ka Act paarit hua, jisne punarvivah ko vaidh tatha uski santan ko legitimate kaha.
